en: 10. Indriya-yamaka 10.2 Pavatti-vāra 10.2.1.
Uppāda-vāra (The Chapter on Arising)
10.2.1.1 Present Chapter (Paccuppannavāra) 10.2.1.1.1 Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) Does the ear faculty arise for one in whom the eye faculty arises?
For those who are being reborn with eye-faculty but without ear-faculty,
the eye-faculty arises, but the ear-faculty does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with both eye-faculty and ear-faculty, both the eye-faculty and the ear-faculty arise for them.
Or, for whomsoever the ear faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with the ear faculty but without the eye faculty, the ear faculty arises, but the eye faculty does not arise for them.
For those who are being reborn with both the ear faculty and the eye faculty, the ear faculty [arises]...
The eye faculty arises and the nose faculty arises.
For one in whom the eye faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise?
For those who are being reborn possessing the eye faculty but lacking the nose faculty, the eye faculty arises for them, but the nose faculty does not arise for them.
The nose faculty arises. For those who are being reborn possessing both the eye faculty and the nose faculty, both the eye faculty and the nose faculty arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the nose faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with a nose but without eyes,
the nose faculty arises, but the eye faculty does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with both a nose and eyes, both the nose faculty and the eye faculty arise.
Does the femininity faculty arise for one in whom the eye faculty arises?
For those who are being reborn with the eye faculty but are not females, the eye faculty arises, but the femininity faculty does not arise.
For those who are being reborn as females with the eye faculty, both the eye faculty and [the femininity faculty arise].
Does the eye faculty arise for that person? Or rather, for whom the female faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise for them?
For women who are born blind at birth, the female faculty arises, but the eye faculty does not arise for them.
It arises. For those females who are born with eyes, both the female faculty (*itthindriya*) and the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arise.
Does the male faculty (*purisindriya*) arise for one in whom the eye faculty arises?
For those who are born with eyes but are not males, the eye faculty arises, but the male faculty does not arise for them.
The male faculty arises. For those males possessing eyes who are being reborn, both the eye faculty and the male faculty arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the male faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise for them?
For those males who are being reborn without the eye-faculty,
the male faculty arises, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them. For those males who are being reborn with the eye-faculty, both the male faculty and the eye-faculty arise.
Does the life-faculty arise for one in whom the eye-faculty arises? Yes.
Or rather, does the eye-faculty arise for one in whom the life-faculty arises?
For those who are reborn without eyes, the life-faculty arises, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them.
It arises. For those who are reborn with eyes, the life-faculty arises and the eye-faculty also arises.
Does the joy-faculty arise for one in whom the eye-faculty arises?
For those who are reborn with eyes but without joy, the eye-faculty arises, but the joy-faculty does not.
The faculty of mental joy arises in them. For those who possess the eye-faculty and are being reborn with mental joy, both the eye-faculty and the faculty of mental joy arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy arises, does the eye-faculty arise in that person? Yes, it does.
Does the faculty of equanimity arise for one in whom the eye-faculty arises?
For those who are born with the eye-faculty but without equanimity, the eye-faculty arises, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise.
For those who are born with the eye-faculty and with equanimity, both the eye-faculty and...
Does the eye faculty arise for that person for whom the equanimity faculty arises? Or conversely, for one for whom the equanimity faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise?
For those who are being reborn with equanimity but without eyes, the equanimity faculty arises, but the eye faculty does not arise for them.
The eye faculty arises. For those who are being reborn with equanimity and possessing the eye, both the equanimity faculty and the eye faculty arise.
For one in whom the eye faculty arises, does the faith faculty arise?
For those who possess the eye-faculty and are being reborn without roots,

the eye-faculty arises, but the faith-faculty does not arise for them. For those who possess the eye-faculty and are being reborn with roots, both the eye-faculty and the faith-faculty arise for them.
Or again, for whom the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of the eye arise for that person?
For those who are reborn with root-cause but without the eye-faculty, the faculty of faith arises, but the faculty of the eye does not arise for them.
For those who are reborn with root-cause and with the eye-faculty, both the faculty of faith and...
The eye faculty arises and the understanding faculty arises.
Does the understanding faculty arise for one in whom the eye faculty arises?
For those who are being reborn with eyes but are dissociated from knowledge, the eye faculty arises, but [the understanding faculty does not].
And for them, the faculty of wisdom arises. For those who are possessed of eyes and associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, both the eye-faculty and the faculty of wisdom arise.
But for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises, does the eye-faculty arise for that person?
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn without eye-faculty, the faculty of wisdom arises,
but the eye-faculty does not arise for them. For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn with eye-faculty,
both the faculty of wisdom and the eye-faculty arise.
Does the mind faculty arise for one in whom the eye faculty arises? Yes.
Or rather, does the eye faculty arise for one in whom the mind faculty arises?
For those who are being reborn with a mind but without eyes, the mind faculty arises, but the eye faculty does not arise for them.
The eye faculty arises. For those who are being reborn with eyes, both the mind faculty and the eye faculty arise. (Based on the eye faculty.
For whom the nose faculty arises, does the femininity faculty arise for them?
For those who are to be born with a nose but are not females, the nose faculty arises,
but the female faculty does not arise for them. For those who are to be born as females with a nose, both the nose faculty and the female faculty arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the femininity faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise for them?
For women who are being reborn without a nose, the femininity faculty arises, but the nose faculty does not arise for them.
For women who are being reborn with a nose, both the femininity faculty and the nose faculty arise.
Does the masculinity faculty arise in one in whom the nose faculty arises?

In those who are being reborn with a nose faculty but are not males, the nose faculty arises, but the masculinity faculty does not arise. In those who are being reborn with a nose faculty and are males, both the nose faculty and...
Does the nose faculty arise for that person? Or, conversely, for whom the male faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise for them?
For those males who are born without a nose, the male faculty arises, but the nose faculty does not arise for them.
It arises. For those males who are being reborn with a nose, both the male faculty and the nose faculty arise.
Does the life faculty arise for one in whom the nose faculty arises? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty arises, does the nose-faculty arise for them?
For those being reborn without a nose, the life-faculty arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a nose, both the life-faculty and the nose-faculty arise.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty arises, does the mental joy-faculty arise for them?
For those who are born with a nose but without mental joy, the nose faculty arises,
but the joy faculty does not arise for them. For those who are born with a nose and with mental joy, both the nose faculty and the joy faculty arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy arises, does the faculty of nose arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with mental joy but without a nose, the faculty of mental joy arises, but the faculty of nose does not arise for them.
For those who are being reborn with mental joy and with a nose, the faculty of mental joy [arises]...
The nose faculty arises and the equanimity faculty arises.
Does the equanimity faculty arise for one in whom the nose faculty arises?
For those who are born with the nose faculty but without equanimity, the nose faculty arises, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them.
The equanimity faculty arises. For those who are born with an equanimous mind and possess a nose, both the nose faculty and the equanimity faculty arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise for them?
For those who are reborn with equanimity but without a nose,
the equanimity faculty arises, but the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those who are reborn with equanimity and with a nose, both the equanimity faculty and the nose faculty arise.
For whom the nose faculty arises, does the faith faculty arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with the nose faculty but without roots, the nose faculty arises, but the faith faculty does not arise for them.
For those who are being reborn with the nose faculty and with roots, both the nose faculty and...
Does the faculty of faith arise for that person? Or, conversely, for whom the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of nose arise for them?
For those who are reborn with roots but without a nose, the faculty of faith arises, but the faculty of nose does not arise for them.
The nose faculty arises. For those who are reborn with roots and possessing a nose, both the faith faculty and the nose faculty arise.
Does the wisdom faculty arise for one in whom the nose faculty arises?
For those who are possessed of the nose faculty and are dissociated from knowledge at the moment of rebirth,

the nose faculty arises, but the wisdom faculty does not arise for them. For those who are possessed of the nose faculty and are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, both the nose faculty and the wisdom faculty arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises, does the faculty of nose arise for them?
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn without a nose, the faculty of wisdom arises, but the faculty of nose does not arise for them.
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn with a nose, [the faculty of wisdom arises].
The faculty of wisdom arises and the faculty of nose also arises.
For whom the faculty of nose arises, does the faculty of mind arise for that person? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the faculty of mind arises, does the faculty of nose arise for that person?
For those who are born with a mind but without a nose, the mind-faculty arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them.
For those who are born with a nose, both the mind-faculty and the nose-faculty arise. (Based on the nose-faculty.)
Does the female faculty arise in one in whom the male faculty arises? No.
Or rather, does the female faculty arise in one in whom the male faculty arises? No.
Does the life-faculty arise in one in whom the female faculty arises? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty arises, does the female-faculty arise for them?

For those women who are being reborn, the life-faculty arises, but the female-faculty does not arise for them. For those women who are being reborn, both the life-faculty and the female-faculty arise.
For whomsoever the female-faculty arises, does the joy-faculty arise for them?
For those women who are reborn without mental joy, the female faculty arises,
but the joy faculty does not arise for them. For those women who are reborn with mental joy, both the female faculty and the joy faculty arise.
Or again, for whom the faculty of mental joy arises, does the female faculty arise for them?
For those who are born with mental joy but are not females, the faculty of mental joy arises, but the female faculty does not arise for them.
For those who are born as females with mental joy, both the faculty of mental joy and...
Does the femininity faculty arise, and does the equanimity faculty also arise?
For one in whom the femininity faculty arises, does the equanimity faculty arise?
In the case of females who are reborn without equanimity, the femininity faculty arises for them, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them.
The equanimity faculty arises. In the case of females who are reborn with equanimity, both the female faculty and the equanimity faculty arise for them.
Or else, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises, does the female faculty arise for that person?
For those who are reborn with equanimity but are not females, the equanimity faculty arises,
but the female faculty does not arise. For those females who are reborn with equanimity, both the equanimity faculty and the female faculty arise.
Does the faculty of femininity arise for one in whom the faculty of faith arises?
For women who are being reborn without roots, the faculty of femininity arises, but the faculty of faith does not arise for them.
For women who are being reborn with roots, both the faculty of femininity and the faculty of faith arise.
Or again, for whom the faculty of faith arises, does the female faculty arise for them?
For those who are being reborn as non-females with roots of merit, the faculty of faith arises, but the female faculty does not arise for them.
For those who are being reborn as females with roots of merit, both the faculty of faith and...
The femininity faculty arises and the understanding faculty arises.
Does the understanding faculty arise for one in whom the femininity faculty arises?
For women who are being reborn dissociated from knowledge, the femininity faculty arises, but the understanding faculty does not arise for them.
The faculty of wisdom arises. For those females who are reborn associated with knowledge, both the female faculty and the faculty of wisdom arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises, does the female faculty arise for them?
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn as non-females, the faculty of wisdom arises,
but the female faculty does not arise for them. For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn as females,
both the faculty of wisdom and the female faculty arise.
Does the mind faculty arise for one in whom the female faculty arises? Yes.
Or rather, does the female faculty arise for one in whom the mind faculty arises?
For those who are conscious at birth and are not females, the mind faculty arises, but the female faculty does not arise for them.
The femininity faculty arises. For those females who are being reborn, both the mind faculty and the femininity faculty arise.
(Based on the femininity faculty.
For whom the masculinity faculty arises, does the life faculty arise for them? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty arises, does the masculinity-faculty arise for them?

For those males who are being reborn, the life-faculty arises, but the masculinity-faculty does not arise for them. For those males who are being reborn, both the life-faculty and the masculinity-faculty arise.
For whomsoever the masculinity-faculty arises, does the mental joy-faculty arise for them?
For those males who are reborn without mental joy, the male faculty arises,
but the joy faculty does not arise for them. For those males who are reborn with mental joy, both the male faculty and the joy faculty arise.
Or again, for whom the faculty of mental joy arises, does the male faculty arise for them?

For those who are males being reborn with mental joy, the faculty of mental joy arises, but the male faculty does not arise for them. For those who are males being reborn with mental joy, both the faculty of mental joy and...
The male faculty arises and the equanimity faculty arises.
For one in whom the male faculty arises, does the equanimity faculty arise?
For those males who are reborn without equanimity, the male faculty arises, but for them the equanimity faculty does not arise.
The equanimity faculty arises. For those males who are being reborn with equanimity, both the masculinity faculty and the equanimity faculty arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises, does the masculinity faculty arise for them?
For those males who are being reborn with equanimity, the equanimity faculty arises,
but the masculinity faculty does not arise for them. For those males who are being reborn with equanimity,
both the equanimity faculty and the masculinity faculty arise.
Does the faculty of masculinity arise for one in whom the faculty of faith arises?
For those males who are being reborn without roots, the faculty of masculinity arises, but the faculty of faith does not arise for them.
For those males who are being reborn with roots, both the faculty of masculinity and the faculty of faith arise.
Or again, for whom the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of masculinity arise for them?

For those who are being reborn as non-males with root-cause, the faculty of faith arises, but the faculty of masculinity does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn as males with root-cause, both the faculty of faith and...
The male faculty arises and the understanding faculty arises.
Does the understanding faculty arise for one in whom the male faculty arises?
For those males who are reborn dissociated from knowledge, the male faculty arises, but the understanding faculty does not arise for them.
The faculty of wisdom arises. For those males who are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, both the male faculty and the faculty of wisdom arise.
But for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises, does the male faculty arise for them?
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn as non-males, the faculty of wisdom arises,
but the male faculty does not arise for them. For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn as males,
both the faculty of wisdom and the male faculty arise.
Does the mind faculty arise in one in whom the male faculty arises? Yes.
Or rather, does the male faculty arise in one in whom the mind faculty arises?
In those who are being reborn as non-males with a mind, the mind faculty arises, but the male faculty does not arise for them.
The male faculty arises. For those males who are being reborn, both the mind faculty and the male faculty arise. (Based on the male faculty.
For whom the life faculty arises, does the joy faculty arise for them?
For those who are reborn without mental joy (*somanassa*), at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy during the course of existence (*pavatta*),
the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises, but the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) does not arise for them. For those who are reborn with mental joy,
at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy during the course of existence, the life-faculty and...
Does the faculty of mental joy arise for that person? Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy arises, does the life-faculty arise for them? Yes.
For whomsoever the life-faculty arises, does the faculty of equanimity arise for them?
For those being reborn without equanimity, and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity during the course of existence,
the life-faculty arises, but the equanimity-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with equanimity,
and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity during the course of existence, both the life-faculty and the equanimity-faculty arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises, does the life faculty arise for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the life faculty arises, does the faith faculty arise for that person?
For those being reborn without roots (ahetuka), and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith, the life faculty [arises] for them...

[In some cases] the life-faculty arises, but the faith-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a root-cause (sahetuka), at the moment of conception, and during the course of existence (pavatta) at the rising-moment of a consciousness associated with faith, both the life-faculty and the faith-faculty arise.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faith-faculty arises, does the life-faculty arise for them? Yes.
Does the faculty of wisdom arise in one in whom the life-faculty arises?

In those who are reborn dissociated from knowledge, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge, the life-faculty arises for them, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise for them. In those who are reborn associated with knowledge...
At the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge during its course, both the life-faculty and the wisdom-faculty arise for that person.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the wisdom-faculty arises, does the life-faculty arise for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the life-faculty arises, does the mind-faculty arise for that person?
For those who are mindless at the moment of rebirth, the life-faculty arises, but the mind-faculty does not arise for them.
For those with minds at the moment of rebirth, and during the phase of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence,
both the life-faculty and the mind-faculty arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) arises, does the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arise for that person? Yes. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whomsoever the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) arises, does the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise for that person? No.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty arises, does the joy-faculty arise for that person? No.
Does the faculty of mental joy arise for that person for whom the faculty of faith arises?

At the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy but dissociated from faith during the course of existence, the faculty of mental joy arises for them, but the faculty of faith does not arise for them. For those being reborn with mental joy, and during the course of existence...
At the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with joy and associated with faith, both the faculty of joy and the faculty of faith arise for them. Or, conversely,
for whomsoever the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of joy arise for them?

For those who are born with a cause but without mental joy (*somanassa*), and during the arising moment of a consciousness associated with faith but dissociated from mental joy while in the course of existence (*pavatta*),
the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) arises, but the faculty of mental joy does not arise for them.
For those who are born with mental joy, and during the arising moment of a consciousness associated with both faith and mental joy while in the course of existence...
For them, both the faculty of faith arises and the faculty of mental joy arises.
For one in whom the faculty of mental joy arises, does the faculty of wisdom arise?

[It does not] for those being reborn who are dissociated from knowledge by way of mental joy, nor during the course of existence for those whose consciousness is associated with mental joy but dissociated from knowledge.
At the moment of arising, the faculty of mental joy arises for them, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise for them.
For those who are reborn associated with mental joy and knowledge, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with both mental joy and knowledge,
both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of wisdom arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises, does the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) arise for them?

For those associated with knowledge who are being reborn without mental joy, and during the life-continuum at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge but dissociated from mental joy—
for them the faculty of wisdom arises, but the faculty of mental joy does not arise.

In those who are reborn with consciousness associated with knowledge and accompanied by joy, and during the arising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge and accompanied by joy while in the course of existence, both the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) arises and the faculty of joy (*somanassindriya*) arises.
For one in whom the faculty of joy arises, does the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) arise? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty arises, does the joy faculty arise for them?
For those who are conscious at birth but without joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from joy—
the mind faculty arises for them, but the joy faculty does not arise for them.

For those being reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy during the course of existence (*pavatta*), both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) and the mental-joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) arise. (Based on the mental-joy faculty.
For whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arises, does the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) arise for that person?
To those being reborn with equanimity and without roots, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity but dissociated from faith,
the faculty of equanimity arises, but the faculty of faith does not arise for them.
To those being reborn with equanimity and with roots, and during the course of existence at the moment of a consciousness associated with both equanimity and faith...
At the moment of arising, does the equanimity faculty arise for those for whom the faith faculty arises?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faith faculty arises, does the equanimity faculty arise for them? [It does not.

For those who are reborn with root-cause consciousness but without equanimity, and during the course of existence (pavatta) for one whose mind is associated with faith but dissociated from equanimity.
At the moment of arising, the faculty of faith arises for them, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise for them.
For those of a root-cause nature who are being reborn with equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with both faith and equanimity,
both the faculty of faith and the faculty of equanimity arise for them.
Does the faculty of wisdom arise in one in whom the faculty of equanimity arises?

In those who are reborn dissociated from knowledge while in a state of equanimity, and during the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity but dissociated from knowledge in the course of existence,
the faculty of equanimity arises, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise for them.

In those who are being reborn associated with equanimity and associated with knowledge, and during the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity and associated with knowledge in the course of existence,
both the equanimity faculty and the wisdom faculty arise. Or, conversely, for whomsoever the wisdom faculty arises, does the equanimity faculty arise for them?

For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn without equanimity, and during the arising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge but dissociated from equanimity in the course of existence,
the faculty of wisdom arises, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise for them.
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn with equanimity, and during the course of existence of a consciousness associated with both knowledge and equanimity...
At the moment of arising, both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of equanimity arise for them.
For whom the faculty of equanimity arises, does the faculty of mind arise for that person? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the faculty of mind arises, does the faculty of equanimity arise for that person?
For those who are endowed with mind and are being reborn without equanimity, and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity during the course of existence,
the mind faculty arises for them, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with equanimity,
and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity during the course of existence, both the mind faculty and the equanimity faculty arise for them.
[It] arises. (Based on the faculty of equanimity.
For one in whom the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of wisdom arise?

For those at the moment of rebirth who possess roots but are dissociated from knowledge, and during the course of existence for one with a consciousness associated with faith but dissociated from knowledge—
At the moment of arising, the faculty of faith arises for them, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise for them.
For those who are born with roots of merit and associated with knowledge, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with both faith and knowledge,
both the faculty of faith and the faculty of wisdom arise for them.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises, does the faculty of faith (saddhindriya) arise for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of mind (manindriya) arise for that person? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mind arises, does the faculty of faith arise for that person?
For those who are with mind and are without roots at the moment of rebirth, and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness dissociated from faith,
the mind faculty arises, but the faith faculty does not arise. For those who are with roots at the moment of rebirth,
and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness associated with faith, both the mind faculty and the faith faculty arise.
[It] arises. (Based on the faculty of faith.
For whom the faculty of wisdom arises, does the faculty of mind arise for that person? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the faculty of mind arises, does the faculty of wisdom arise for that person?

For those who are endowed with mind but dissociated from knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge,
the mind faculty arises, but the wisdom faculty does not arise for them. For those who are endowed with knowledge at the moment of rebirth,
and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge, both the mind faculty and [the wisdom faculty] arise.
And the faculty of wisdom arises. (Based on the faculty of wisdom. 10.2.1.1.2.
Positive Plane: Where the eye-faculty arises, does the ear-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or again: Wherever the ear faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise there? Yes.
Wherever the eye faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the eye faculty arises there, but the nose faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), both the eye faculty and the nose faculty arise there.
Or again: where the nose faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise there?
Yes. Where the eye faculty arises, does the femininity faculty ... pe ... the masculinity faculty arise there?
In the fine-material sphere, the eye faculty arises there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the eye faculty and the masculinity faculty arise there.
Or, where the male faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the eye faculty arises, does the life faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the life faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise there?

In the non-percipient beings and in the formless realm, the life-faculty arises there, but the eye-faculty does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the life-faculty and the eye-faculty arise there.
Wherever the eye-faculty arises, does the mental joy-faculty arise there? Yes. Or, wherever the mental joy-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the eye faculty arises, does the equanimity faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the equanimity faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise there?
In the immaterial plane, the equanimity faculty arises there, but the eye faculty does not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the equanimity faculty and the eye faculty arise there.
Where the eye-faculty arises, does the faith-faculty …pe… the understanding-faculty …pe… the mind-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the mind-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there?

In the immaterial plane, the mind-faculty arises there, but the eye-faculty does not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the mind-faculty and the eye-faculty arise there. (Based on the eye-faculty.)
Where the nose-faculty arises, does the female-faculty …pe… the male-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the male-faculty arises, does the nose-faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the nose-faculty arises, does the life-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or again, where the life-faculty arises, does the nose-faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the life-faculty arises there, but the nose-faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the life-faculty and the nose-faculty arise there.
Where the nose-faculty arises, does the mental joy-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the faculty of mental joy arises, does the faculty of nose arise there?

In the fine-material sphere, the faculty of mental joy arises there, but the faculty of nose does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of nose arise there.
Where the faculty of nose arises, does the faculty of equanimity arise there? Yes.
Or, where the equanimity faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the equanimity faculty arises there, but the nose faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the equanimity faculty and the nose faculty arise.
Where the nose faculty arises, do the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind-faculty arises, does the nose-faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind-faculty arises there, but the nose-faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the mind-faculty and the nose-faculty arise there. (Based on the nose-faculty.
Where the female-faculty arises, does the male-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the male faculty arises, does the female faculty arise there? Yes. …pe… Where the male faculty arises, does the life faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the life faculty arises, does the male faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the life-faculty arises there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the life-faculty and the masculinity faculty arise there.
Wherever the masculinity faculty arises, does the mental-joy faculty arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, wherever the mental-joy faculty arises, does the masculinity faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises there, but the male faculty (*purisindriya*) does not arise there. In the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), both the faculty of mental joy and the male faculty arise there.
Wherever the male faculty arises, does the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, wherever the faculty of equanimity arises, does the male faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the equanimity faculty arises there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the equanimity faculty and the masculinity faculty arise there.
Wherever the masculinity faculty arises, do the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, wherever the mind faculty arises, does the masculinity faculty arise there?
In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind faculty arises there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise there.
In the sense-sphere, both the mind faculty and the masculinity faculty arise there. (Based on the masculinity faculty.
Wherever the life faculty arises, does the mental joy faculty arise there?

In the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises there, but the mental joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) does not arise there. In the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms, both the life-faculty and the mental joy-faculty arise there.
Or else, where the mental joy-faculty arises, does the life-faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the life-faculty arises, do the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) … faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) … wisdom-faculty (*paññindriya*) … mind-faculty (*manindriya*) arise there?

In the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises there, but the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) does not arise there. In the fourfold and fivefold planes of existence, both the life-faculty and the mind-faculty arise there.
Or, conversely, where the mind-faculty arises, does the life-faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the life-faculty.

Where the mental joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) arises, does the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) ... pe ... the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) ... pe ... the understanding-faculty (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the mind-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty arises, does the joy faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the joy faculty.
Where the equanimity faculty arises, do the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty arises, does the equanimity faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the equanimity faculty.)
Where the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of wisdom arise there? Yes.
Or rather, where the faculty of wisdom arises, does the faculty of faith arise there? Yes.
Where the faculty of faith arises, does the faculty of mind arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty arises, does the faith faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the faith faculty.
Where the wisdom faculty arises, does the mind faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty arises, does the wisdom faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the wisdom faculty.)
10.2.1.1.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-puggalokāsa) In whom, and where, the eye-faculty arises, does the ear-faculty arise for that person there?
For those who are being reborn with the eye-faculty but without the ear-faculty, the eye-faculty arises there, but [the ear-faculty does not].
And for those beings, the ear faculty arises there. For those who are being reborn with both eyes and ears, the eye faculty arises and the ear faculty arises there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the ear faculty arises there, does the eye faculty arise there for that person?
For those who are to be born with the ear faculty but without the eye faculty,

the ear faculty arises there, but the eye faculty does not arise for them there. For those who are to be born with both the ear faculty and the eye faculty, both the ear faculty and the eye faculty arise there.
For whom, and where, the eye faculty arises, does the nose faculty arise for them there?
For those who are being reborn with the eye faculty but without the nose faculty, the eye faculty arises there, but the nose faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are being reborn with both the eye faculty and the nose faculty...
For those individuals, both the eye faculty and the nose faculty arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the nose faculty arises there, does the eye faculty also arise there for them?
For those who are being reborn with a nose but without eyes, the nose faculty arises there, but [the eye faculty does not].
And for them, the eye-faculty arises there. For those who are being reborn with both the nose-faculty and the eye-faculty, the nose-faculty arises there and the eye-faculty also arises there.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty arises there, does the female-faculty arise for that person there?
For those who are possessed of eyes and are being reborn as females, the eye faculty arises there,
but the female faculty does not arise there for them. For those who are possessed of eyes and are being reborn as females,
both the eye faculty and the female faculty arise there for them.
Or again, for whomsoever and wherever the femininity faculty arises, does the eye faculty arise there for them?
For women who are being reborn without eyes, the femininity faculty arises there for them, but the eye faculty does not arise there for them.
For women who are being reborn with eyes, [the eye faculty arises there for them].
The femininity faculty arises and the eye faculty also arises.
For whom, where the eye faculty arises, does the masculinity faculty arise there?
For those who are being reborn as non-masculine beings possessing the eye faculty, the eye faculty arises there, but not the masculinity faculty.
And for them, the male faculty arises there. For men who are possessed of eyes and are being reborn, both the eye faculty and the male faculty arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the male faculty arises there, does the eye faculty also arise there for them?
For those males who are being reborn without eyes, the male faculty arises there,
but the eye faculty does not arise there for them. For those males who are being reborn with eyes,
both the male faculty and the eye faculty arise there for them.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty arises at a certain place, does the life-faculty arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the life-faculty arises at a certain place, does the eye-faculty arise for them at that same place?
For those who are being reborn without eyes, the life-faculty arises there, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them there.
The eye faculty arises. For those who are being reborn with eyes, both the life faculty and the eye faculty arise there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty arises in a particular place, does the mental joy faculty arise for them there?
For those who possess the eye-faculty and are being reborn without mental joy, the eye-faculty arises there,
but the joy-faculty does not arise for them there. For those who possess the eye-faculty and are being reborn with mental joy, both the eye-faculty and the joy-faculty arise there for them.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises at a certain place, does the faculty of the eye (*cakkhundriya*) arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the faculty of the eye arises at a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for that person at that place?
For those who are possessed of eyes but are reborn without equanimity, the faculty of the eye arises for them at that place.

And yet, the equanimity faculty does not arise in them there. For those possessing the eye-faculty who are being reborn with equanimity, both the eye-faculty and the equanimity faculty arise in them there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises there, does the eye-faculty also arise in him there?
For those being reborn with equanimity but without eyes, the faculty of equanimity arises there,
but the faculty of eye does not arise for them there. For those being reborn with equanimity and with eyes,
both the faculty of equanimity and the faculty of eye arise there.
For whom and where the eye faculty arises, for them does the faith faculty arise there?
For those who are being reborn with the eye faculty but without roots, the eye faculty arises there, but the faith faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are being reborn with the eye faculty and with roots...
For those individuals, both the eye faculty and the faith faculty arise there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the faith faculty arises there, does the eye faculty also arise there for them?
For those who are reborn with roots-of-goodness but without the eye, the faith faculty arises there, but [the eye faculty does not].
And the eye-faculty arises for them there. For those who are being reborn with roots of merit and possessing eyes, both the faith-faculty and the eye-faculty arise for them there.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty arises there, does the wisdom-faculty arise for that person there?
For those who possess the eye-faculty but are dissociated from knowledge and are being reborn, the eye-faculty arises there,
but the wisdom-faculty does not arise there for them. For those who possess the eye-faculty and are associated with knowledge and are being reborn,
both the eye-faculty and the wisdom-faculty arise there for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises at a certain place, does the faculty of the eye arise for them there?

For those who are associated with knowledge but are being reborn without eyes, the faculty of wisdom arises there, but the faculty of the eye does not arise for them there. For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn with eyes...
For those [beings], both the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises there and the faculty of eye (cakkhundriya) arises there.
For whomsoever the faculty of eye arises in a particular place, does the faculty of mind (manindriya) arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mind arises in a particular place, does the faculty of eye arise for that person in that same place?
For those who are born with a mind but without eyes, the mind faculty arises there, but the eye faculty does not arise there for them.
For those who are born with eyes, both the mind faculty and the eye faculty arise there for them. (Based on the eye faculty.)
For whom, where the nose-faculty arises, does the female-faculty arise there for them?
For those who are being reborn with the nose-faculty but are not females, the nose-faculty arises there for them, but the female-faculty does not arise there for them.
For those who are being reborn with the nose-faculty and are females, [the female-faculty arises there for them].
Does the nose faculty arise and the female faculty also arise?
Or, conversely, in whomsoever and wherever the female faculty arises, does the nose faculty also arise there?
In women who are being reborn without a nose, the female faculty arises there, but the nose faculty does not arise for them.
In that case, the nose faculty arises. For those females who are born with a nose, both the female faculty and the nose faculty arise there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty arises in a particular place, does the male faculty also arise for them in that same place?
For those who are being reborn with a nose but who are not males,

the nose faculty arises there, but the male faculty does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with a nose and who are males, both the nose faculty and the male faculty arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the male faculty arises at a certain place, does the nose faculty arise for them there?
For males who are being reborn without a nose, the male faculty arises there, but the nose faculty does not arise for them there. For males who are being reborn with a nose...
In that case, the male faculty arises and the nose faculty also arises.
For whom and where the nose faculty arises, for that person and in that place, does the life-faculty arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom and where the life-faculty arises, for that person and in that place, does the nose faculty arise?
For those being reborn among those without a nose, the life-faculty arises there,
but the nose-faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn among those with a nose, both the life-faculty and the nose-faculty arise there.
For whom, where the nose faculty arises, does the mental joy faculty arise there?
For those possessing the nose faculty who are reborn without mental joy, the nose faculty arises there, but the mental joy faculty does not arise there for them.
For those possessing the nose faculty who are reborn with mental joy...
In those [beings], both the nose faculty arises and the mental joy faculty arises.
Or rather: in whomsoever the mental joy faculty arises at a certain place, does the nose faculty arise in that person at that place?
In those who are being reborn with mental joy but without a nose, the mental joy faculty arises there, but the nose faculty does not.
And the nose-faculty arises for them there. For those who are being reborn with mental joy and possessing the nose-faculty, both the joy-faculty and the nose-faculty arise there for them.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty arises there, does the equanimity-faculty arise for that person there?
For those who are reborn with a nose but without equanimity, the nose faculty arises there,
but the equanimity faculty does not arise there for them. For those who are reborn with a nose and with equanimity,
both the nose faculty and the equanimity faculty arise there for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity arises at a certain place, does the faculty of nose arise there for them?
For those who are being reborn with equanimity but without a nose, the faculty of equanimity arises there, but the faculty of nose does not arise there for them.
For those who are being reborn with equanimity and with a nose...
In that case, both the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arises and the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) arises.
For whom and where the nose faculty arises, does the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) arise for them there?
For those who are born with a nose but without roots (*ahetuka*), the nose faculty arises there, but the faith faculty does not.
In them, the faculty of faith arises there. For those who are being reborn with a nose and with roots, both the faculty of nose and the faculty of faith arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the faculty of faith arises there, does the faculty of nose arise there for them?
For those who are reborn with roots but without a nose, the faculty of faith arises there,
but the faculty of the nose does not arise for them there. For those who are reborn with roots and with a nose,
both the faculty of faith and the faculty of the nose arise there.
For whom, where the nose faculty arises, does the wisdom faculty arise there?
For those who are possessed of the nose faculty and are dissociated from knowledge at the moment of rebirth, the nose faculty arises there, but the wisdom faculty does not arise there for them.
For those who are possessed of the nose faculty and are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth...
In those [beings], both the nose faculty and the wisdom faculty arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the wisdom faculty arises in a certain place, does the nose faculty also arise in that person in that same place?
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn without a nose, the wisdom faculty arises there, but not the nose faculty.
And yet, the nose faculty does not arise in them there. For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn with a nose, both the wisdom faculty and the nose faculty arise there in them.
Does the mind faculty arise for one in whom the nose faculty arises there? Yes.
Or alternatively, for whomsoever the mind-faculty arises at a certain place, does the nose-faculty arise for them there?
For those who are being reborn with a mind but without a nose, the mind-faculty arises there, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are being reborn with a nose, both the mind-faculty and...
The nose faculty arises, and the nose faculty also arises. (Based on the nose faculty.
For whom the female faculty arises at a certain place, does the male faculty arise for that person at that same place? No.
Or rather, for whom the male faculty arises at a certain place, does the female faculty arise for that person at that same place? No.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty arises at a certain place, does the life faculty arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life faculty arises at a certain place, does the femininity faculty arise for them at that same place?
No; for those women who are being reborn, the life faculty arises there, but the femininity faculty does not arise for them there.
The femininity faculty arises. For those females who are being reborn, both the life faculty and the femininity faculty arise there.
Does the joy faculty arise for that person where the femininity faculty arises?
For those women who are reborn without the faculty of mental joy, the female faculty arises there,
but the faculty of mental joy does not arise for them there. For those women who are reborn with the faculty of mental joy, both the female faculty and the faculty of mental joy arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises at a certain place, does the faculty of femininity (*itthindriya*) arise for them there?

For those who are born with mental joy but are not females, the faculty of mental joy arises there, but the faculty of femininity does not arise for them there. For those females who are born with mental joy...
In that case, both the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises and the female faculty (*itthindriya*) arises.
For whomsoever the female faculty arises in a particular place, does the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for them there?
For those women who are reborn without equanimity, the female faculty arises there, but the faculty of equanimity does not.
In them, the equanimity faculty arises there. In the case of females who are reborn with equanimity, both the femininity faculty and the equanimity faculty arise in them there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises there, does the femininity faculty arise in them there?
For those who are reborn with equanimity and are not females, the equanimity faculty arises there,
but the female faculty does not arise for them there. For those who are reborn with equanimity and are females,
both the equanimity faculty and the female faculty arise there for them.
For whom and where the femininity faculty arises, for them does the faith faculty arise there?
For women who are being reborn without roots, the femininity faculty arises there, but the faith faculty does not arise for them there. For women who are being reborn with roots, for them there...
Does the femininity faculty arise and the faith faculty also arise?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faith faculty arises at a certain place, does the femininity faculty also arise there for them?
For those who are being reborn as non-feminine beings with roots of merit, the faith faculty arises there, but the femininity faculty does not.
In them, the female faculty arises there. In women who are reborn with roots of goodness, both the faith faculty and the female faculty arise there.
For one in whom the female faculty arises there, does the wisdom faculty also arise there?
For those women who are being reborn dissociated from knowledge, the female faculty arises there,
but the wisdom faculty does not arise there for them. For those women who are being reborn associated with knowledge, both the female faculty and the wisdom faculty arise there for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises at a certain place, does the female faculty arise for them there?
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn as non-females, the faculty of wisdom arises there, but the female faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn as females...
For those [beings], both the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) and the female faculty (itthindriya) arise there.
For whomsoever the female faculty arises in a particular place, does the mind faculty (manindriya) also arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty arises in a particular place, does the female faculty also arise for that person in that same place?
For those who possess mind and are being reborn as non-females, the mind faculty arises there, but the female faculty does not arise for them there.
For females who are being reborn, both the mind faculty and the female faculty arise there. (Based on the female faculty.)
For whomsoever the masculinity faculty arises at a certain place, does the life faculty arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life faculty arises at a certain place, does the masculinity faculty arise for them at that same place?
No; for those males who are being reborn, the life faculty arises there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise for them there.
The male faculty arises. For those males who are being reborn, both the life faculty and the male faculty arise there.
For whomsoever the male faculty arises in a particular place, does the mental joy faculty arise for that person in that same place?
For those males who are reborn without mental joy, the male faculty arises there,
but the faculty of mental joy does not arise for them there. For those males who are reborn with mental joy,
both the male faculty and the faculty of mental joy arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy arises at a certain place, does the faculty of masculinity arise for them there?

For those who are men and are being reborn with mental joy, the faculty of mental joy arises there, but the faculty of masculinity does not arise for them there. [However,] for those who are men and are being reborn with mental joy...
In them, both the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises and the male faculty (*purisindriya*) arises there.
For one in whom the male faculty arises in a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for that person in that same place?
For those males who are reborn without equanimity, the male faculty arises there, but [the faculty of equanimity does not].
And for them, the equanimity faculty arises there. For males who are being reborn with equanimity, both the masculinity faculty and the equanimity faculty arise there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises there, does the masculinity faculty also arise there for them?
For those males who are being reborn with equanimity, the faculty of equanimity arises there,
but the male faculty does not arise for them there. For those males who are being reborn with equanimity,
both the faculty of equanimity and the male faculty arise there.
For whom, wherever the male faculty arises, does the faith faculty arise there?
For males at the moment of rebirth who are rootless, the male faculty arises there, but the faith faculty does not arise there for them. For males at the moment of rebirth who possess roots... there.
Does the male faculty arise and the faith faculty also arise?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever and wherever the faith faculty arises, does the male faculty arise for that person there?
For those who are with roots (sahetuka) and are males being reborn, the faith faculty arises there, but the male faculty does not.
And for them, the male faculty arises there. For those males who are born with roots of merit, the faith faculty arises there and the male faculty also arises there.
For whomsoever the male faculty arises there, does the wisdom faculty arise for that person there?
For those males who are dissociated from knowledge at the moment of rebirth, the male faculty arises therein,
but the wisdom faculty does not arise therein for them. For those males who are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth,
both the male faculty and the wisdom faculty arise therein for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises at a certain place, does the faculty of masculinity arise for them there?

For those who are associated with knowledge but are not males, as they are being reborn, the faculty of wisdom arises there, but the faculty of masculinity does not arise for them there. For those who are associated with knowledge and are males, as they are being reborn...
In those [beings], both the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises there and the male faculty (purisindriya) arises there.
For whomsoever the male faculty arises in a certain place, does the mind faculty (manindriya) arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty arises in a certain place, does the male faculty arise for that person in that same place?
For those who are possessed of mind and are being reborn as males, the mind-faculty arises there, but the male-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are being reborn as males, both the mind-faculty and the male-faculty arise there. (Based on the male-faculty.)
For whom and where the life-faculty arises, for them does the joy-faculty arise there?
For those being reborn without joy, and during the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from joy in the course of existence,
the life-faculty arises there for them, but the joy-faculty does not arise there for them.

In those who are being reborn with mental joy, and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy during the course of existence, both the life-faculty and the mental-joy faculty arise therein.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental-joy faculty arises in a particular place, does the life-faculty also arise therein for them? Yes.
Does the equanimity faculty arise in that person at that place where the life-faculty arises?

For those who are reborn without equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, the life-faculty arises there for them, but the equanimity faculty does not arise there for them. [For those] with equanimity...

In those who are being reborn and in those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity, both the life-faculty and the equanimity-faculty arise therein.
Or rather: for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty arises therein, does the life-faculty also arise therein for them? Yes.
Does the faculty of faith arise in that person at that place where the life-faculty arises?

For those being reborn without roots and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith, the life-faculty arises there, but the faculty of faith does not arise there for them. [However, it does arise] for those with roots...

For those beings at the moment of rebirth-linking and during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness associated with faith, both the life-faculty and the faith-faculty arise therein. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the faith-faculty arises therein, does the life-faculty also arise therein? Yes.
For whom and in what [state] does the life-faculty arise, for that same person and in that same state does the wisdom-faculty arise?

For those being reborn dissociated from knowledge, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge, the life-faculty arises for them in that state, but the wisdom-faculty does not arise for them in that state. For those associated with knowledge...

For those beings at the moment of rebirth-linking and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge, both the life-faculty and the wisdom-faculty arise therein.
Or rather, for whomsoever the wisdom-faculty arises therein, does the life-faculty also arise therein for them? Yes, it does.
Does the mind faculty arise in that person at that place where the life faculty arises?
For those who are reborn without consciousness, the life faculty arises there, but the mind faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are reborn with consciousness, and during the moment of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence...
In those [beings], both the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises and the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) arises there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mind-faculty arises in a certain place, does the life-faculty arise for them in that same place? Yes. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises in a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for them in that same place? No.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises at a certain place, does the joy faculty arise for that person at that same place?
No. For whomsoever the joy faculty arises at a certain place, does the faith faculty arise for that person at that same place?
At the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with joy but dissociated from faith during the course of existence (pavatta), for those [beings], the joy faculty arises there.
But the faculty of faith does not arise for them there. For those being reborn with mental joy,
at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with both mental joy and faith during the course of existence, both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of faith arise for them there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of faith arises at a certain place, does the faculty of mental joy arise for them there?

For those who are born with roots of goodness but without mental joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith but dissociated from mental joy—
the faculty of faith arises for them there, but the faculty of mental joy does not.

It arises. For those who are being reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith and associated with mental joy during the course of existence (*pavatta*), both the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) and the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arise therein.
Does the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) arise for one in whom the faculty of mental joy arises therein?

For those who are associated with joy and dissociated from knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness associated with joy and dissociated from knowledge,
the faculty of joy arises therein, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise therein.

For those who are associated with joy and associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and for those during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness associated with joy and associated with knowledge...
At the moment of arising, both the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) and the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) arise for them there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises there, does the faculty of mental joy also arise for them there? [It does not.

For those associated with knowledge who are reborn without mental joy, and during the course of existence (*pavatta*) for one whose consciousness is associated with knowledge but dissociated from mental joy.
At the moment of arising, the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises in them there, but the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) does not arise in them there.
In those associated with knowledge who are being reborn with mental joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with both knowledge and mental joy,
both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of mental joy arise in them there.
For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises in a particular [state], does the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) arise for that person in that same state? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mind arises in a particular [state], does the faculty of mental joy arise for that person in that same state?
For those who are endowed with consciousness but are reborn without mental joy, and during the course of existence (*pavatta*) when a consciousness dissociated from mental joy is present.
At the moment of arising of those [beings], the mind faculty arises there, but the joy faculty does not arise there for them.

For those being reborn with joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with joy, both the mind faculty and the joy faculty arise there for them. (Based on the joy faculty.)
For whom and in what [state] does the equanimity faculty arise, for that same person and in that same state does the faith faculty arise?
For those being reborn without root-cause who possess equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity but dissociated from faith—
for them, the equanimity faculty arises there, but the faith faculty does not.

It arises. For those who are reborn with equanimity as the root-cause, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with both equanimity and faith, the faculty of equanimity arises and the faculty of faith also arises therein.
Or else, for whomsoever the faculty of faith arises in a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity arise for that person in that same place?

For those who are reborn with a root-cause but without equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith and dissociated from equanimity,
the faculty of faith arises therein, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise therein.
For those who are reborn with a root-cause and with equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with both faith and equanimity...
At the moment of arising, both the faculty of faith and the faculty of equanimity arise for them there.
For one in whom the faculty of equanimity arises at a certain place, does the faculty of wisdom also arise for that person at that place?

[It does not] for those being reborn who are dissociated from knowledge regarding equanimity, nor during the course of existence for those whose consciousness is associated with equanimity but dissociated from knowledge.
At the moment of arising, the equanimity faculty arises for them there, but the wisdom faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are reborn associated with equanimity and knowledge, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with both equanimity and knowledge,
both the equanimity faculty and the wisdom faculty arise for them there.
Or alternatively, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises at a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity arise for them at that same place?

For those associated with knowledge who are reborn without equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge but dissociated from equanimity—
the faculty of wisdom arises for them there, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise for them there.

It arises. For those who are reborn associated with knowledge and equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with both knowledge and equanimity, the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) arises and the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) also arises therein.
For whomsoever the faculty of equanimity arises in a particular place, does the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty arises at a particular place, does the equanimity faculty arise for them there?
For those who are possessed of mind and are being reborn without equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity—
the mind faculty arises for them there, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them there.

For those being reborn with equanimity, and at the moment of the arising of an equanimity-associated consciousness during the course of existence, both the mind faculty and the equanimity faculty arise therein. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whomsoever the faith faculty arises therein, does the wisdom faculty arise for that person therein?

For those who are endowed with roots, dissociated from knowledge, at the moment of rebirth-linking, and during the course of existence at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with faith and dissociated from knowledge,
the faculty of faith arises therein, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise therein for them.

For those who are endowed with roots, associated with knowledge, at the moment of rebirth-linking, and during the course of existence at [the arising moment of] a consciousness associated with both faith and knowledge...
At the moment of arising, both the faculty of faith and the faculty of wisdom arise in them there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises in a certain place, does the faculty of faith also arise in that person in that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the faculty of faith arises in a certain place, does the faculty of mind also arise in that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) arises at a certain place, does the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) arise for them there?

For those who are with mind but without roots (*ahetuka*) at the moment of rebirth, and during the course of existence (*pavatta*) at the rising-moment of a consciousness dissociated from faith—therein the mind-faculty arises for them, but the faith-faculty does not arise for them there. For those with roots...

For those being reborn and for those in the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith, both the mind-faculty and the faith-faculty arise therein. (Based on the faith-faculty.
For whomsoever the wisdom-faculty arises therein, does the mind-faculty also arise therein for that person? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever and wherever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) arises, does the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arise there for them?

For those at the moment of rebirth who possess a mind but are dissociated from knowledge, and during the course of existence at the rising moment of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge—the mind faculty arises there for them, but the wisdom faculty does not arise there for them. [However, it does arise] for those associated with knowledge.

For those who are being reborn, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge during the course of existence, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) and the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arise therein. (Based on the wisdom faculty. 10.2.1.1.4.
Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, for them the ear faculty does not arise?
For those who are being reborn without the eye faculty but with the ear faculty, the eye faculty does not arise, but it is not the case that the ear faculty does not arise for them.
For all those passing away, and for those being reborn without the eye faculty and without the ear faculty...
For them, neither the eye faculty nor the ear faculty arises. Or, for whom the ear faculty does not arise, does the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those who are without ears but with eyes at the moment of rebirth, the ear faculty does not arise, but it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them.

The eye faculty does not arise. For all those who are passing away, and for those being reborn who are without the ear faculty and without the eye faculty, neither the ear faculty nor the eye faculty arises.
For one in whom the eye faculty does not arise, does the nose faculty not arise?

For those who are being reborn without eye-faculty but with nose-faculty, the eye-faculty does not arise, yet it is not the case that the nose-faculty does not arise for them. For all those who are passing away,
and for those who are being reborn without eye-faculty and without nose-faculty, neither the eye-faculty nor the nose-faculty arises.
Or alternatively: for whom the nose faculty does not arise, does the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those who are being reborn without the nose faculty but with the eye faculty, the nose faculty does not arise, but the eye faculty does not fail to arise for them.
[This is so] for all those passing away, and for those being reborn without the nose faculty and without the eye faculty.
For them, neither the nose faculty nor the eye faculty arises.
For one in whom the eye faculty does not arise, does the female faculty not arise?
For women who are being reborn without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise, yet [the female faculty] does arise for them.

The femininity faculty does not arise. For all those who are passing away, for those who are being reborn without eye-faculty and who are not females, neither the eye-faculty nor the femininity faculty arises.
Or, conversely, for whom the femininity faculty does not arise, does the eye-faculty not arise for them?
For those women who are being reborn with eyes, the femininity faculty does not arise, yet the eye faculty does not fail to arise for them.
For all those passing away, and for those women who are being reborn without eyes,
neither the femininity faculty nor the eye faculty arises.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, for them the male faculty does not arise?
For men who are being reborn without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise, but it is not the case that the male faculty does not arise for them.
[This applies] to all those passing away, and to men who are being reborn without eyes.
For them, neither the eye faculty nor the masculinity faculty arises. Or, for whom the masculinity faculty does not arise, does the eye faculty not arise for them?
For males who are being reborn with eyes, the masculinity faculty does not arise, but [the eye faculty does arise]. No.
For them, the eye faculty does not arise. For all those who are passing away, and for those males being reborn who are without the eye faculty, neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty arises.
For one in whom the eye faculty does not arise, does the life faculty not arise?
For those who are being reborn without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise, but it is not the case that the life faculty does not arise for them.
