In the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) had not arisen there, but the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) had not failed to arise there. In non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*) and in the immaterial sphere (*arūpa*), neither the nose-faculty nor the eye-faculty had arisen there.
Where the eye-faculty had not arisen, had the femininity-faculty (*itthindriya*) ... pe ... the masculinity-faculty (*purisindriya*) not arisen there? Yes.
Or, conversely, where the masculinity-faculty had not arisen, had the eye-faculty not arisen there?

In the fine-material sphere, the male faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the eye faculty had not arisen there. In non-percipient beings and in the immaterial sphere, neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty had arisen there.
Where the eye faculty had not arisen, had the life faculty not arisen there? It had arisen.
Or, where the life faculty had not arisen, had the eye faculty not arisen there? There is none.
Where the eye-faculty had not arisen, had the joy-faculty not arisen there? Yes.
Or else, where the joy-faculty had not arisen, had the eye-faculty not arisen there? Yes.
Where the eye-faculty had not arisen, had the equanimity-faculty not arisen there?

In the formless realm, the eye faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty had not arisen there. In the case of non-percipient beings, neither the eye faculty nor the equanimity faculty had arisen there. Or conversely:
where the equanimity faculty had not arisen, had the eye faculty not arisen there? Yes.
Where the eye faculty had not arisen, had the faith faculty …pe… the understanding faculty …pe… the mind faculty not arisen there?

In the formless realm, the eye faculty did not arise there, but the mind faculty did not fail to arise there. In the case of non-percipient beings, neither the eye faculty nor the mind faculty arose there.
Or, conversely, where the mind faculty did not arise, did the eye faculty not arise there? Yes. (Based on the eye faculty.
Where the nose faculty did not arise, did the female faculty … [and so on] … the male faculty not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the male faculty (purisindriya) had not arisen, had the nose faculty (ghānindriya) not arisen there? Yes.
Where the nose faculty had not arisen, had the life faculty (jīvitindriya) not arisen there? It had arisen.
Or, where the life faculty had not arisen, had the nose faculty not arisen there? There is none.
Where the nose faculty had not arisen, had the mental joy faculty not arisen there?
In the fine-material sphere, the nose faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mental joy faculty had not arisen there.
In non-percipient beings and in the immaterial sphere, neither the nose faculty nor the mental joy faculty had arisen there.
Or, where the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) had not arisen, had the faculty of nose (ghānindriya) not arisen there? Yes.
Where the faculty of nose had not arisen, had the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) not arisen there?
In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the faculty of nose had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity had not arisen there.
It did not arise. In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) nor the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arose there.
Or, conversely: where the equanimity faculty did not arise, did the nose faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the nose faculty did not arise, did the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise there?

Or else, where the mind faculty had not arisen, had the nose faculty not arisen there? Yes. (Based on the nose faculty.
Where the female faculty had not arisen, had the male faculty not arisen there? Yes.
Or, where the male faculty (*purisindriya*) had not arisen, had the female faculty (*itthindriya*) not arisen there? Yes. ... [etc. ...
Where the male faculty had not arisen, had the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arisen there? It had arisen.
Or, where the life-faculty had not arisen, had the male faculty not arisen there? There is none.
Where the male faculty had not arisen, had the joy faculty not arisen there?
In the fine-material sphere, the male faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the joy faculty had not arisen there.
In non-percipient beings and in the immaterial sphere, neither the male faculty nor the joy faculty had arisen there.
Or, where the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) had not arisen, had the faculty of masculinity (*purisindriya*) not arisen there? Yes.
Where the faculty of masculinity had not arisen, had the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) not arisen there?

In the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the faculty of masculinity had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity had not arisen there.
It did not arise. In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the male faculty (*purisindriya*) nor the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arose there.
Or, where the equanimity faculty did not arise, did the male faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the male faculty did not arise, did the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the male faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mind faculty had not arisen there. In non-percipient beings, neither the male faculty nor the mind faculty had arisen there.
Or, conversely, where the mind faculty had not arisen, had the male faculty not arisen there? Yes. (Based on the male faculty.
Where the life faculty had not arisen, had the mental joy faculty not arisen there? No.
Or, where the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) had not arisen, had the faculty of life (*jīvitindriya*) not arisen there?

It had arisen. Where the faculty of life had not arisen, had the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) not arisen there? There is none.
Or, where the faculty of mind had not arisen, had the faculty of life not arisen there? It had arisen. (Based on the faculty of life.)
Where the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) had not arisen, had the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) not arisen there? Yes.
Or else, where the faculty of equanimity had not arisen, had the faculty of mental joy not arisen there? Yes.
Where the faculty of mental joy had not arisen, had the faculty of faith (saddhindriya) … pe … the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) … pe … the faculty of mind (manindriya) not arisen there? Yes.
Or, where the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen, had the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arisen there? Yes. (Based on the joy-faculty.
Where the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) had not arisen, had the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) …pe… the understanding-faculty (*paññindriya*) …pe… the mind-faculty not arisen there? Yes.
Or, where the mind-faculty had not arisen, had the equanimity-faculty not arisen there? Yes. (Based on the equanimity-faculty.)
Where the faculty of faith had not arisen, there the faculty of wisdom … pe … had the faculty of mind not arisen? Yes.
Or else, where the faculty of mind had not arisen, there the faculty of faith had not arisen? Yes. (Based on the faculty of faith.
Where the faculty of wisdom had not arisen, there the faculty of mind had not arisen? Yes.
Or, where the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen, had the wisdom-faculty (*paññindriya*) not arisen there? Yes. (Based on the wisdom-faculty.
10.2.1.2.6. Negative Person-Location Analysis:
For whom, wherever the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) had not arisen, for that person, had the ear-faculty (*sotindriya*) not arisen there? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the ear-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the eye-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the nose-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the eye-faculty not arisen for that person at that place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the nose faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the eye faculty had not arisen for them there.

For those of the fine-material sphere, the masculinity-faculty had not arisen there, but the eye-faculty had not [necessarily] arisen there for them.
It did not arise. For those of the Pure Abodes, non-percipient beings, and formless beings, neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty had arisen there.

For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the eye faculty had not arisen there,

Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the eye-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the mental joy-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mental joy-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the eye-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
For whom the eye faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the equanimity faculty not arisen for them at that place?
For those non-percipient beings (arūpa), the eye faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty had not arisen for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the eye faculty nor [the equanimity faculty] had arisen there.
And the equanimity faculty had not arisen.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the eye faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
For those immaterial beings, the eye faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mind faculty had not arisen for them there.
For those pure-abode beings and non-percipient beings, neither the eye faculty nor the mind faculty had arisen there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) not arisen for him there? Yes. (Based on the eye-faculty.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the female-faculty (*itthindriya*) ... pe ... the male-faculty (*purisindriya*) not arisen for him there? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the male-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the nose-faculty not arisen for him there? Yes.
For whom the nose faculty had not arisen at a certain place, for them the life faculty had not arisen at that place?

For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the life faculty had not arisen there for them. For those of the Pure Abodes, neither the nose faculty nor...
[It is] that which had arisen, yet the life-faculty (jīvitindriya) had not arisen.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the nose-faculty (ghānindriya) not arisen for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the mental joy-faculty (somanassindriya) not arisen for them there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the nose faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mental joy faculty had not arisen for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the nose faculty nor the mental joy faculty had arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the faculty of nose (*ghānindriya*) not arisen for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever the faculty of nose had not arisen at a certain place, had the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) not arisen for them there?

For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the faculty of nose had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity had not arisen for them.
In that case, the equanimity faculty did not arise. For those of the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose faculty nor the equanimity faculty arose there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty did not arise in a certain place, did the nose faculty not arise for them there? Yes.
For whom the nose faculty had not arisen at a certain place, for them the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty had not arisen at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mind faculty had not arisen for them there.
For those of the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, both the nose faculty and [the mind faculty] had not arisen there.
[It is] not that the mind-faculty did not arise, yet [it is] not that the nose-faculty did not arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mind-faculty did not arise at a certain place, for that person did the nose-faculty not arise at that place? Yes. (Based on the nose-faculty.
For whomsoever the female-faculty did not arise at a certain place, for that person did the male-faculty not arise at that place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the masculinity faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the femininity faculty not arisen for them at that same place? Yes. ... [etc.
... For whomsoever the masculinity faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the life faculty not arisen for them at that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the masculinity faculty had not arisen there, but the life faculty had not failed to arise for them.
In that case, the life-faculty had not arisen. For those of the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), neither the male faculty nor the life-faculty had arisen there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty had not arisen in a certain place, had the male faculty not arisen for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) also not arisen for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the male faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the joy faculty had not arisen for them there.
For those of the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), and those of the immaterial sphere (*arūpa*), both the male faculty and...

[Is it the case that] neither the faculty of mental joy nor [the faculty of masculinity] had arisen? Or, conversely, for whomsoever and wherever the faculty of mental joy had not arisen, had the faculty of masculinity not arisen for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever and wherever the faculty of masculinity had not arisen, had the faculty of equanimity not arisen for them there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the male faculty had not arisen there,
but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty had not arisen for them there. For those in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings,
neither the male faculty nor the equanimity faculty had arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) not arisen for them there? Yes.

For whomsoever the masculinity faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arisen for them there?

For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the masculinity faculty had not arisen there; yet it is not that [the other faculties] had not arisen for them.

In that case, the mind faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen. For those who are beings of the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*) and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the male faculty (*purisindriya*) nor the mind faculty had arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mind faculty had not arisen in a certain place, had the male faculty not arisen for them there? Yes, it had. (Based on the male faculty.)
For whomsoever the life-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, for that person had the mental joy-faculty not arisen at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental joy-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, for that person had the life-faculty not arisen at that place?
[It was not so] for those in the second moment of consciousness in the Pure Abodes, nor for non-percipient beings; for them, the mental joy-faculty [had not arisen].

It has not arisen for them, yet it is not the case that the life-faculty (jīvitindriya) has not arisen for them there. At the moment of the arising of the rebirth-consciousness of the Suddhāvāsa deities, neither the joy-faculty (somanassindriya) nor the life-faculty has arisen for them there.

For whomsoever the life-faculty has not arisen at a certain place, has the equanimity-faculty (upekkhindriya) … pe … the faith-faculty (saddhindriya) … pe … the understanding-faculty (paññindriya) … pe … the mind-faculty (manindriya) not arisen for them at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the life-faculty not arisen for them there?
For non-percipient beings, the mind-faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the life-faculty had not arisen for them there.
At the moment of the arising of the rebirth-consciousness of the Pure Abodes, for them the mind-faculty [had not arisen] there...
The life-faculty had not arisen, and [the mind-faculty] had not arisen. (Based on the life-faculty.

For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy had not arisen at a certain place, for that person at that place, had the faculty of equanimity … pe … the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the mind-faculty not arisen?
For those in the Pure Abodes while their second consciousness is occurring, the faculty of mental joy had not arisen there.

And yet, the mind faculty had not arisen for them there. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the joy faculty nor the mind faculty had arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mind faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the joy faculty not arisen for them there? Yes, it had. (Based on the Joy Faculty.)

For whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arisen for them at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the equanimity faculty not arisen for them at that place? Yes. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whomsoever the faith faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arisen for them at that place? Yes.

Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) not arisen for that person at that place? Yes. (Based on the faith-faculty.
For whomsoever the understanding-faculty (*paññindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, had the mind-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, had the understanding-faculty not arisen for that person at that place? Yes. (Based on the understanding-faculty.)

And the femininity faculty will arise.
For whom the femininity faculty will arise, will the equanimity faculty arise for them?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna.
For those [women], the femininity faculty will arise, but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them.
For others, both the femininity faculty and the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise, will the femininity faculty arise for them?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there;

and for those men who, after showing a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final nibbāna—equanimity faculty will arise in them, but femininity faculty will not arise in them. For others, both equanimity faculty and [femininity faculty]...
Will the femininity faculty arise, and will the faith faculty also arise?
For one in whom the femininity faculty will arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for one in whom the mind faculty will arise, will the femininity faculty arise?
For those who will be reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere and attain final nibbāna there,
and for those men who will display a few more existences in that very same state and then attain final nibbāna, the mind faculty will arise,
but the female faculty will not arise. For others, both the mind faculty and the female faculty will arise.
(With the female faculty as the basis.
For whom the male faculty will arise, will the life faculty arise for them? Yes.
Or, for whom the life faculty will arise, will the male faculty arise for them?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who, as that very female state,
will manifest only a few more existences before attaining final Nibbāna— the life-faculty (jīvitindriya) will arise,
but the male-faculty (purisindriya) will not arise. For others, both the life-faculty and the male-faculty will arise.
Will the faculty of mental joy arise in one for whom the male faculty will arise?

For those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna, the male faculty will arise, but the faculty of mental joy will not arise for them. For others...
For those [beings], both the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise and the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) will arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will arise, will the masculinity faculty arise for them?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who, by this very same state of existence, [will pass away] after some time...
For those who, having been shown existence, will be reborn with joy and attain final Nibbāna, the faculty of joy (somanassindriya) will arise,
but the male faculty (purisindriya) will not arise for them. For others, both the faculty of joy and the male faculty will arise.
For whom the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise, for that person will the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise?

For those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state and having been reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), will attain final Nibbāna—the male faculty will arise for them, but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them. For others...

For those persons, both the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) and the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will arise. Or rather, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise, will the masculinity faculty also arise for them?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) or the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who, by that very same state [of existence], will attain final Nibbāna...
For those who, having shown several existences and being reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna,
the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) will arise, but the male faculty (purisindriya) will not arise for them. For others, both the faculty of equanimity and the male faculty will arise.

For whom the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise, for that person will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) ... pe ... the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the mind faculty (*manindriya*) arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the mind faculty will arise, for that person will the male faculty arise?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) or the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who, by this very state [of existence], [will attain final Nibbāna].
For those who will attain final nibbāna after showing a few more existences, the mind faculty will arise, but the male faculty will not arise for them.
For others, both the mind faculty and the male faculty will arise. (Based on the male faculty.)
For whom the life-faculty will arise, for them will the mental joy-faculty arise?

For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after this consciousness, the life-faculty will arise, but the mental joy-faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the life-faculty and...

For whom mental joy faculty (somanassindriya) will arise, will life faculty (jīvitindriya) also arise? Yes. Or rather, for whom mental joy faculty will arise, will equanimity faculty (upekkhindriya) also arise? Yes.
For whom life faculty will arise, will equanimity faculty also arise?
For those whose consciousness immediately following it will arise as a final consciousness associated with mental joy,
the life faculty will arise, but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the life faculty and the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise, will the life faculty arise for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the life faculty will arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for that person? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise, will the life faculty arise for that person? Yes. (Based on the life faculty.)
For whom the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will arise, for them will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise?

For those whose final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise immediately after their present consciousness, the faculty of mental joy will arise, but the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them. For others, both the faculty of mental joy...
[If] the equanimity faculty will arise for someone, will the joy faculty also arise for that person?
For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after their current consciousness, the equanimity faculty [will arise].
[For some] the equanimity faculty will arise, but the joy faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the equanimity faculty and the joy faculty will arise.
For one whose joy faculty will arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for that person? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, will the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) arise for them?

For those whose final consciousness immediately following [the present] consciousness will be associated with equanimity (*upekkhā*), the mind-faculty will arise, but the joy-faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the mind-faculty and...
The faculty of mental joy will arise, and the faculty of mental joy will also arise. (Based on the faculty of mental joy.
For whom the faculty of equanimity will arise, for that person will the faculty of faith ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the faculty of mind will arise, for that person will the faculty of equanimity arise?
For those whose consciousness immediately following will arise as a final consciousness associated with mental joy, the mind faculty will arise, but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them.
For others, both the mind faculty and the equanimity faculty will arise. (Based on the equanimity faculty.)
For whom the faculty of faith will arise, for that person the faculty of wisdom …pe… the faculty of mind will arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the faculty of mind will arise, for that person the faculty of faith will arise? Yes. (Based on the faculty of faith.
For whom the faculty of wisdom will arise, for that person the faculty of mind will arise? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, will the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arise for that person? Yes. (Based on the wisdom faculty.
10.2.1.3.2. Positive Plane:
Wherever the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) will arise, will the ear faculty (*sotindriya*) arise there? Yes.
Or, where the ear faculty will arise, will the eye faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the eye faculty will arise, will the nose faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the eye faculty will arise there, but the nose faculty will not arise there. In the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the eye faculty and the nose faculty will arise there.
Or, where the nose-faculty will arise, will the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the eye-faculty will arise, will the femininity-faculty … pe … masculinity-faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the eye-faculty will arise there, but the masculinity-faculty will not arise there. In the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the eye-faculty and the masculinity-faculty will arise there.
Or, where the male faculty will arise, will the eye faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the eye faculty will arise, will the life faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the life faculty will arise, will the eye faculty arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings and in the formless realm, the life-faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty will not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the life-faculty and the eye-faculty will arise there.
Wherever the eye-faculty will arise, will the mental joy-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, wherever the mental joy-faculty will arise, will the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the eye-faculty will arise, will the equanimity-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the equanimity-faculty will arise, will the eye-faculty arise there?
In the immaterial plane, the equanimity-faculty will arise, but the eye-faculty will not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the equanimity-faculty and the eye-faculty will arise.
Where the eye-faculty will arise, will there the faith-faculty … pe … the understanding-faculty … pe … the mind-faculty arise? Yes.
Or else, where the mind-faculty will arise, will the eye-faculty arise there?

In the immaterial plane, the mind-faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty will not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the mind-faculty and the eye-faculty will arise. (Based on the eye-faculty.)
Where the nose-faculty will arise, will the female-faculty ... pe ... or the male-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, conversely, where the male-faculty will arise, will the nose-faculty arise there? Yes.
Where the nose-faculty will arise, will the life-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the life-faculty will arise, will the nose-faculty arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the life-faculty will arise there, but the nose-faculty will not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the life-faculty and the nose-faculty will arise there.
Where the nose-faculty will arise, will the mental-pleasure faculty arise there? Yes.
Or again, where the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will arise, will the faculty of nose (ghānindriya) arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the faculty of mental joy will arise there, but the faculty of nose will not arise there. In the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of nose will arise there.
Where the faculty of nose will arise, will the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) arise there? Yes.
Or, where the faculty of equanimity will arise, will the faculty of nose there also arise?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the faculty of equanimity will arise there, but the faculty of nose will not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the faculty of equanimity and the faculty of nose will arise there.
Where the faculty of nose will arise, will the faculty of faith ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind there also arise? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty will arise, will the nose faculty also arise there?
In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind faculty will arise there, but the nose faculty will not arise there.
In the sense-sphere realm, both the mind faculty and the nose faculty will arise there.
(Based on the faculty of smell.
Where the female faculty will arise, will the male faculty also arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the male faculty will arise, will the female faculty also arise there? Yes …pe….
Wherever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise, there the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will arise? Yes.
Or else, wherever the life-faculty will arise, there the male faculty will arise?

In the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the life-faculty will arise there, but the male faculty will not arise there. In the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), both the life-faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
Wherever the masculinity faculty will arise, there the mental joy faculty will arise? Yes.
Or, wherever the mental joy faculty will arise, there the masculinity faculty will arise?

In the fine-material sphere, the mental joy faculty will arise there, but the masculinity faculty will not arise there. In the sense-sphere realm, both the mental joy faculty and the masculinity faculty will arise there.
Where the male faculty (purisindriya) will arise, will the equanimity faculty (upekkhindriya) also arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, where the equanimity faculty will arise, will the male faculty also arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the equanimity faculty will arise there, but the male faculty will not arise there. In the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the equanimity faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
Where the male faculty will arise, there will the faith faculty ... pe ... the understanding faculty ... pe ... the mind faculty arise? Yes.
Or else, where the mind faculty will arise, there will the male faculty arise?
In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind faculty will arise there, but the male faculty will not arise there.
It will arise. In the sense-sphere plane, both the mind-faculty and the masculinity faculty will arise there.
(Based on the masculinity faculty.
Wherever the life-faculty will arise, will the joy-faculty arise there?
In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will arise there, but the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) will not arise there.
In the fourfold and fivefold planes of existence, both the life-faculty and the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, wherever the mental joy faculty will arise, will the life-faculty also arise there? Yes.
Wherever the life-faculty will arise, will there the equanimity-faculty …pe… faith-faculty …pe… understanding-faculty …pe… mind-faculty arise?

In the case of non-percipient beings, the life-faculty will arise there, but the mind-faculty will not arise there. In the four-aggregate and five-aggregate planes, both the life-faculty and the mind-faculty will arise.
Or, where the mind-faculty will arise, will the life-faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the life-faculty. Where the joy-faculty will arise, will the equanimity-faculty ...
pe ... the faith-faculty ... pe ... the understanding-faculty ... pe ... the mind-faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind-faculty will arise, will the joy-faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the joy-faculty.)
Wherever the faculty of equanimity will arise, will there the faculty of faith ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind arise? Yes.
Or else, wherever the faculty of mind will arise, will there the faculty of equanimity arise? Yes. (Based on the faculty of equanimity.
Wherever the faculty of faith will arise, will there the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind arise? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty will arise, will the faith faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the faith faculty.
Where the understanding faculty will arise, will the mind faculty arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty will arise, will the understanding faculty arise there? Yes. (Based on the understanding faculty.)
10.2.1.3.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-puggalokāsa) For whomsoever the eye-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the ear-faculty also arise for that person at that same place? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the ear-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the eye-faculty also arise for that person at that same place? Yes.
For whom and where the eye faculty will arise, for them will the nose faculty arise there?
For those of the fine-material sphere, the eye faculty will arise there, but the nose faculty will not arise for them there.
For those of the sense-sphere, both the eye faculty and the nose faculty will arise there.
Or again: For whomsoever the nose-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the eye-faculty also arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the female-faculty also arise for that person at that place? [No.
For those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and for those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna.
For those [beings], the eye-faculty will arise there, but the female faculty will not arise there for them.
For others among the sense-sphere beings, both the eye-faculty and the female faculty will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the female faculty will arise in a certain place, will the eye-faculty also arise there for that person? Yes.
For whomver the eye-faculty will arise there, will the masculinity-faculty also arise for them there?
For those in the fine-material sphere and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in that very state,
will attain final nibbāna— there the eye-faculty will arise for them, but the masculinity-faculty will not arise for them there.
For other sense-sphere beings, both the eye faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the male faculty will arise in a certain place, will the eye faculty also arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye faculty will arise in a certain place, will the life faculty also arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the eye-faculty also arise for them there?

For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the life-faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty will not arise for them there. For those in the fivefold sensual plane, both the life-faculty and [the eye-faculty] will arise there.
And the eye-faculty will arise.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty will arise in a certain place, will the joy-faculty also arise for them in that same place?
For those who are born with eyes and, having arisen in a state of equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna, the eye-faculty will arise in them in that place.

[For some] the eye-faculty will arise there, but the faculty of mental joy will not arise for them there. For others, those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-faculty and the faculty of mental joy will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy will arise there, will the eye-faculty also arise for them there? Yes.
For whom and where the eye-faculty will arise, for them will the equanimity-faculty arise there?

For those who are born with eyes and, having arisen with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna, the eye-faculty will arise for them there, but the equanimity-faculty will not arise for them there. For others among those in the five-aggregate realm...
For those persons, both the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty will arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise there, will the eye faculty also arise for them there?
For those non-percipient beings (arūpa), the equanimity faculty will arise there, but the eye faculty will not arise for them there.
It will arise. For those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the equanimity faculty and the eye faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the eye faculty will arise at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for one in whom the mind faculty will arise at a certain place, will the eye faculty arise for them at that same place?
For those non-material beings, the mind-faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty will not arise for them there.
For those of the five-aggregate realm, both the mind-faculty and the eye-faculty will arise there.
(Based on the eye-faculty.)
For whomsoever the nose-faculty will arise there, for that person will the female-faculty arise there?

For those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna, the nose-faculty will arise there, but the female-faculty will not arise there for them. For others among the sense-sphere beings...
In those [beings], both the nose-faculty and the female-faculty will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the female-faculty will arise in a certain place, will the nose-faculty also arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty will arise in a certain place, will the male-faculty also arise for that person in that same place?
In the case of those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in that very state, will attain final nibbāna, the nose faculty will arise there for them,
but the male faculty will not arise there for them. For others among the sense-sphere beings,
both the nose faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the male faculty will arise at a certain place, will the nose faculty arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose faculty will arise at a certain place, will the life faculty arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the life faculty will arise at a certain place, will the nose faculty arise for that person at that place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the life-faculty will arise there,
but the nose-faculty will not arise for them there. For those belonging to the sense-sphere, both the life-faculty and the nose-faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the joy-faculty also arise for them at that same place?

For those who possess a nose and, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna there—the nose-faculty will arise for them at that place, but the joy-faculty will not arise for them there.
For others, namely those of the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), [both will arise].
The nose faculty will arise and the mental joy faculty will also arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will arise at a certain place, will the nose faculty also arise for them at that same place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the mental joy faculty will arise there, but the nose faculty will not arise for them there.
It will arise. For those sense-sphere beings, both the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) and the faculty of nose (*ghānindriya*) will arise there.
For whomsoever the faculty of nose will arise there, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for them there?
For those who possess the faculty of nose and, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna, the faculty of nose will arise there.

[For some] the nose faculty will arise there, but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there. For others, those belonging to the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the nose faculty and the equanimity faculty will arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise there, will the nose faculty also arise for them there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the equanimity faculty will arise there,
but the nose faculty will not arise for them there. For those belonging to the sense-sphere, both the equanimity faculty and the nose faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty will arise there, for that person the faith-faculty … pe … wisdom-faculty … pe … mind-faculty will arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will arise there, for that person the nose-faculty will arise there?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind-faculty will arise there, but for them the nose-faculty will not arise there.
The nose faculty will arise. For those sense-sphere beings, both the mind faculty and the nose faculty will arise there. (Based on the nose faculty.
For whomsoever the female faculty will arise at a certain place, will the male faculty also arise for that person at that same place?
In the case of those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna, the female faculty (itthindriya) will arise there,
but the male faculty (purisindriya) will not arise there. In the case of others among the sense-sphere beings (kāmāvacara),
both the female faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the male faculty (purisindriya) will arise at a certain place, will the female faculty (itthindriya) arise for that person at that place?

For those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna, the male faculty will arise for them there, but the female faculty will not arise for them there.
For others among the sensuous-sphere beings (kāmāvacara), [both will arise].
In those [beings], both the male faculty and the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the female faculty will arise in a certain place, will the life-faculty also arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise in a certain place, will the female faculty also arise for that person in that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, and for those men who will take only a few more births in that very state and then attain final Nibbāna,
the life-faculty will arise there, but the female faculty will not arise there for them.
For others of the sense-sphere, both the life-faculty and the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty will arise in a certain place, will the joy faculty also arise for them in that same place? For those women who,
having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna,
the femininity faculty will arise for them in that place, but the joy faculty will not arise for them there.
In other sense-sphere beings (kāmāvacara), both the femininity faculty and the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will arise in a certain place, will the femininity faculty also arise for them in that same place? [It will not.
For those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and for those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy.
For those who will attain final Nibbāna there, the faculty of mental joy will arise there,
but the female faculty will not arise there for them. For others among the sense-sphere beings, both the faculty of mental joy and the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty will arise therein, for that person will the equanimity faculty arise therein? For those women who,
having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna—
therein the femininity faculty will arise for them, but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them therein.
In other sense-sphere beings (*kāmāvacara*), both the femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) and the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise in a certain place, will the femininity faculty also arise for them there? [It will not.

For those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), those in the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in that same state, will pass away with equanimity...
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn there, the equanimity faculty will arise there,
but the femininity faculty will not arise for them there. For others among the sense-sphere beings,
both the equanimity faculty and the femininity faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty will arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise in a certain place, will the femininity faculty arise for that person in that same place? [No.
For those in the fine-material sphere, those in the immaterial sphere, and those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the mind faculty will arise there, but the femininity faculty will not arise for them there.
For others among the sense-sphere beings, both the mind faculty and the femininity faculty will arise there.
(Based on the femininity faculty.)
For whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise in a certain place, for that person will the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arise in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life faculty will arise in a certain place, for that person will the male faculty arise in that same place? [No;

for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), those of the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state [of womanhood], [will pass away].
For those who will attain final Nibbāna there, the life-faculty will arise there, but the male faculty will not arise there for them.
For others among the sense-sphere beings, both the life-faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the male faculty will arise in a certain place, will the faculty of mental joy arise for him there?
In those men who, having manifested a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna,

the masculinity faculty will arise there, but the joy faculty will not arise there for them. For others among the sense-sphere beings, both the masculinity faculty and the joy faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will arise at a certain place, will the faculty of masculinity (purisindriya) arise for them there?
For those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), and for those women who, having shown only a few more existences in this very state,
will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna— mental joy will arise for them there, but the faculty of masculinity will not arise for them there.
The male faculty will arise. For others among those of the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the mental joy faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the male faculty will arise in a certain place, will the equanimity faculty also arise for that person in that same place?
In those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with joy and attain final Nibbāna,
the male faculty will arise there, but the equanimity faculty will not arise there. In others among the sense-sphere beings, both the male faculty and the equanimity faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will arise at a certain place, will the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) also arise for them there?
For those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), those in the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for those women who, having seen only a few more existences in this very state,
will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna— equanimity faculty will arise for them there.
And yet, the male faculty will not arise in them there. In other sense-sphere beings, both the equanimity faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the male faculty will arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise in that same place for him? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise at a certain place, will the masculinity faculty arise for them there? For those of the fine-material sphere,
those of the immaterial sphere, and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state,
will attain final Nibbāna— for them the mind faculty will arise there, but the masculinity faculty will not arise for them there.
It will arise. For others among those belonging to the sense-sphere, for them there both the mind-faculty and the masculinity faculty will arise there.
(Based on the masculinity faculty.
For whomsoever the life-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the joy-faculty also arise for that person at that place?
For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after this consciousness—
for them, there, the life-faculty will arise, but the mental joy-faculty will not arise. For others,
namely those of the four-constituent and five-constituent beings, for them there, both the life-faculty and the mental joy-faculty will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will arise at a certain place, will the faculty of life (*jīvitindriya*) arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the faculty of life will arise at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for that person at that place?
[It will not. For one whose final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise immediately after this consciousness, and for non-percipient beings...
In those [beings], the life-faculty will arise there, but the equanimity-faculty will not arise there for them.
For others—namely, those of the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms—both the life-faculty and the equanimity-faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty will arise there, will the life-faculty also arise there for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the life-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the faith-faculty … pe … wisdom-faculty … pe … mind-faculty arise for them at that same place?
For non-percipient beings, the life-faculty will arise there, but the mind-faculty will not arise for them there.
For those of the four-constituent and five-constituent realms, both the life-faculty and [the other faculties] will arise there.
And the mind-faculty will arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the life-faculty arise for that person at that place? Yes. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whomsoever the joy-faculty will arise at a certain place, will the equanimity-faculty arise for that person at that place?
For those whose consciousness immediately following will arise as a final consciousness associated with mental joy,
the faculty of mental joy will arise there for them, but the faculty of equanimity will not arise there for them.
For others— namely, those of the four-constituent and five-constituent beings— the faculty of mental joy will arise there, and the faculty of equanimity will also arise there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will arise at a certain place, will the faculty of mental joy arise for them there?

For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after the present consciousness, the faculty of equanimity will arise for them there, but the faculty of mental joy will not arise for them there. For others...
For those belonging to the four-constituent (catuvokāra) and five-constituent (pañcavokāra) realms, will both the faculty of equanimity and the faculty of mental joy arise there?
If for a person, at a certain plane, the faculty of mental joy will arise, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arise for that person at that plane? Yes.
Or conversely, if for a person, at a certain plane, the faculty of mind will arise, will the faculty of mental joy arise for that person at that plane?
For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after this consciousness,
the mind faculty will arise therein, but the joy faculty will not arise therein for them. For others— namely,
those of the four-constituent and five-constituent beings— the mind faculty and the joy faculty will both arise therein.
(With the faculty of mental joy as the basis.

For whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will arise at a certain place, will the faculty of faith ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will arise at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity arise for that person at that place?
For those whose consciousness immediately following it will arise as a final consciousness associated with mental joy,
the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise there, but the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise for them there.
For others— namely, those in the fourfold and fivefold aggregates— the mind faculty and the equanimity faculty will both arise there.
(With equanimity faculty as the basis.
For whomsoever the faith faculty will arise at a certain place, will the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise at a certain place, will the faith faculty arise for that person at that place? Yes. (With faith faculty as the basis.)
For whomsoever the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) will arise in a particular [person], will the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) also arise for that person in that same [person]? Yes.

Or rather, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will arise in a particular [person], will the faculty of wisdom also arise for that person in that same [person]? Yes. (Based on the faculty of wisdom. 10.2.1.3.4.
Negative Person (*Paccanīkapuggala*)
For whom the eye faculty will not arise, for that person will the ear faculty not arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the ear faculty will not arise, for that person will the eye faculty not arise? Yes.
For whom the eye faculty will not arise, for that person will the nose faculty not arise? Yes.
Or again, for whom the nose faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna there, the nose faculty will not arise, but it is not that the eye faculty will not arise for them.
[This also applies to] those in their final existence and those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere...
For those who will attain final Nibbāna, neither the nose faculty nor the eye faculty will arise.
If the eye faculty will not arise for someone, will the female faculty not arise for that person? Yes.
Or conversely, if the female faculty will not arise for someone, will the eye faculty not arise for that person? Yes.

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), will attain final nibbāna there, and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna—for them, the female faculty (itthindriya) will not arise;

yet it is not the case that the eye faculty (cakkhundriya) will not arise for them. [This also applies to] those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika) and those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), will attain final nibbāna there.

For those persons, neither the femininity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise. For whom the eye faculty will not arise, will the masculinity faculty not arise for them? Yes. Or, for whom the masculinity faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise for them? Yes.
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), will attain final nibbāna there, and for those women who, in this very same female state,
will manifest only a few more existences before attaining final nibbāna— the male faculty (purisindriya) will not arise, but the eye faculty (cakkhundriya) will not fail to arise for them.
This is also the case for those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika) and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), will attain final nibbāna there.
For them, neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty will arise.
For one in whom the eye faculty will not arise, will the life faculty not arise?
For those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna, the eye faculty will not arise; yet [the life faculty will arise].
For them, the life-faculty will not arise. For those in their final existence, neither the eye-faculty nor the life-faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise, will the eye-faculty not arise for them? Yes.
For whom the eye-faculty will not arise, for that person will the mental joy faculty not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the mental joy faculty will not arise, for that person will the eye-faculty not arise?
For those who are born with eyes and, having arisen in a state of equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna, the mental joy faculty will not arise.

And yet, the eye faculty will not arise for them. For those in their final existence and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there, neither the joy faculty nor the eye faculty will arise.
For one whose eye faculty will not arise, will the equanimity faculty not arise?
For those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there, the eye faculty will not arise,
but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them. For those in their final existence,
neither the eye faculty nor the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or again, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those who possess eyes and, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final nibbāna, the equanimity faculty will not arise, but the eye faculty will not fail to arise for them.
For those in their final existence, both the equanimity faculty...
The eye faculty will not arise, and the ear faculty will also not arise.
For one for whom the eye faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?
For those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there, the eye faculty will not arise; yet [the mind faculty will arise].
For them, the mind faculty will not arise. For those in their final existence, neither the eye faculty nor the mind faculty will arise.
Or else, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise for them? Yes, it will. (Based on the eye faculty.)
For whom the nose faculty will not arise, for them the female faculty will not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the female faculty will not arise, for them the nose faculty will not arise?
For those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna—for them the female faculty [will not arise].
It will not arise, yet the nose faculty will not necessarily not arise for them. For those in their final existence and for those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there,
neither the female faculty nor the nose faculty will arise.
For whom the nose-faculty will not arise, for them the masculinity-faculty will not arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the masculinity-faculty will not arise, for them the nose-faculty will not arise?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna—for them the masculinity-faculty [will not arise].
It will not arise, yet the nose faculty will not necessarily not arise for them. For those in their final existence and for those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there,
neither the male faculty nor the nose faculty will arise.
For whom the nose-faculty will not arise, for them the life-faculty will not arise?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there, the nose-faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise for them.
For those in their final existence, the nose-faculty...
[If] the life-faculty will not arise, will the nose-faculty also not arise for that person?
Or conversely, if the life-faculty will not arise for someone, will the nose-faculty also not arise for that person? Yes.
If the nose-faculty will not arise for someone, will the mental joy-faculty also not arise for that person?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna there, the nose faculty will not arise,

but it is not the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise for them. For those in their final existence and those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there,
neither the nose faculty nor the mental joy faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise, will the faculty of the nose (*ghānindriya*) not arise for them?

For those who possess a nose and, having been reborn with equanimity (*upekkhā*), will attain final Nibbāna, the faculty of mental joy will not arise, but the faculty of the nose will not fail to arise for them.
[This is also the case] for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm (*arūpa*), [will attain final Nibbāna].
For those who will attain final nibbāna, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of the nose will arise.
For whom the faculty of the nose will not arise, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for them?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna, the faculty of the nose will not arise.

And yet, the equanimity faculty will not fail to arise for them. For those in their final existence and for those who, with a mind of joy, will be reborn in the fine-material sphere and there attain final Nibbāna, neither the nose faculty nor the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or else, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, will the nose faculty not arise for them?
For those who, being endowed with a nose, will be reborn with mental joy and will attain final nibbāna,

the faculty of equanimity will not arise, but the faculty of the nose will not fail to arise for them. For those in their final existence and those who, being endowed with mental joy, will be reborn in the fine-material sphere and will attain final nibbāna, neither the faculty of equanimity nor the faculty of the nose will arise.
For whom the nose faculty will not arise, for them will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there, the nose faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them.
For those in their final existence, both the nose faculty and … [the mind faculty] … will not arise.
[Will] the mind faculty not arise?
And [will] the nose faculty not arise for that person? Or conversely, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, will the nose faculty not arise for that person? Yes. (Based on the nose faculty.
For whom the femininity faculty will not arise, will the masculinity faculty not arise for that person? Yes.
For those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna, the female faculty will not arise;
yet it is not the case that the male faculty will not arise for them.
For those in their final existence, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna, the female faculty will not arise...
[Will] the masculinity faculty not arise?
Or, for whom the masculinity faculty will not arise, will the femininity faculty not arise for them?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna—for them, the masculinity faculty [will not arise].
It will not arise, yet for them the female faculty will not necessarily not arise. For those in their final existence and those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there,
neither the male faculty nor the female faculty will arise.
For whom femininity-faculty will not arise, for them life-faculty will not arise?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those males who, after manifesting only a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final Nibbāna—for them femininity-faculty will not arise, but [life-faculty will arise]. No.
For them, the life-faculty will not arise. For those in their final existence, neither the female faculty nor the life-faculty will arise.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise, will the female faculty not arise for them? Yes.
For whom the female faculty will not arise, for them the mental joy faculty will not arise? For those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those males who, after appearing in a few more existences in that very state,
will be reborn with mental joy and then attain final Nibbāna— for them the female faculty will not arise.
Yet the faculty of mental joy will not fail to arise in them. For those in their final existence who, having been reborn in the formless realm,
will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those men who, after showing a few more births in this very state,
will be reborn with equanimity and then attain final Nibbāna— neither the female faculty nor the faculty of mental joy will arise in them.
Or again, for whom the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will not arise, will the faculty of femininity (itthindriya) not arise for them? For those women who,
having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity (upekkhā) and attain final nibbāna,
the faculty of mental joy will not arise, but the faculty of femininity will not fail to arise for them.
For those in their final existence, and for those who will be reborn in the formless realm and attain final Nibbāna there, and for those men who,
having shown a few more births in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna—
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the female faculty will arise in them.
For whom the femininity faculty will not arise, for them the equanimity faculty will not arise?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna;
and for those men who, after showing a few more existences in this very same state, will be reborn with equanimity and then attain final nibbāna—for them, the femininity faculty [will not arise].
It will not arise, yet for them the equanimity faculty will not fail to arise. For those in their final existence, and for those men who,
having manifested only a few more births in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna,
neither the femininity faculty nor the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or, for whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise, will the femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) not arise for them?

For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*) and attain final Nibbāna—for them the equanimity faculty will not arise, but it is not that the femininity faculty will not arise for them. [This is so] for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*).
And for those persons who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with joy and attain final Nibbāna,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the femininity faculty will arise.
For one in whom the femininity faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those men who,
after experiencing only a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final Nibbāna— the female faculty will not arise in them,
but the mind faculty will not fail to arise in them. For those in their final existence, neither the female faculty nor [the mind faculty] will arise.
And the mind-faculty will not arise.
Or, for one in whom the mind-faculty will not arise, will the femininity-faculty not arise? Yes. (Based on the femininity-faculty.
For one in whom the masculinity-faculty will not arise, will the life-faculty not arise?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who, in this very same state,
will display a few more existences and then attain final Nibbāna— the masculinity faculty will not arise,
but it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise for them. For those in their final existence, neither the masculinity faculty nor...
[If] the life-faculty will not arise, will the masculinity-faculty also not arise?
Or conversely, for one in whom the life-faculty will not arise, will the masculinity-faculty also not arise? Yes.
For one in whom the masculinity-faculty will not arise, will the joy-faculty also not arise? Yes.

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna there; and for those women who, after experiencing several more existences in that very same female state, will be reborn with mental joy and attain final nibbāna—neither the male faculty nor the joy faculty will arise in them.
[However,] this does not mean that the joy faculty will not arise in them. This applies also to those in their final existence and to those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere...
And for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna—
neither the male faculty nor the joy faculty will arise in them. Or, conversely, for whomsoever the joy faculty will not arise, will the male faculty also not arise in him?

For those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna, the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will not arise;
yet it is not the case that the male faculty (purisindriya) will not arise for them.

[This is also the case] for those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika), for those who will be reborn in the formless realm and attain final Nibbāna, and for those women who, by this very state...
Having shown some who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn with equanimity by means of existence, [it is asked:
for them, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the male faculty will arise.
For whom the male faculty will not arise, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for them?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna there;

and for those women who, after experiencing a few more births in that very same female state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna—the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise in them, but the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will not fail to arise in them. This is so for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*).
And for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with joy and attain final Nibbāna—
will neither the masculinity faculty nor the equanimity faculty arise for them? Or conversely, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, will the masculinity faculty also not arise for them?
For those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with joy and attain final Nibbāna,
the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise, but the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not fail to arise for them.
[This applies] to those in their final existence and to those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with joy...
For those who, having been reborn, will attain final Nibbāna, neither the equanimity faculty nor the masculinity faculty will arise.
For whomsoever the masculinity faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them? [Answer:

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final Nibbāna, and for those women who, by this very state of existence, [will attain final Nibbāna]… pe… [the mind faculty will not arise].
For those who will attain final nibbāna after showing a certain number of existences, the male faculty will not arise,
but the mind faculty will not fail to arise for them. For those in their final existence,
neither the male faculty nor the mind faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise, will the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) not arise for him? Yes. (Based on the masculinity faculty.
For whomsoever the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will not arise, will the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise for him? Yes.
