Or, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise, will the life faculty not arise for him?
For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after this consciousness, the faculty of mental joy will not arise,
but it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise for them. For those possessing the final consciousness,
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the life-faculty will arise.
For whom the life-faculty will not arise, for them the equanimity-faculty will not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the equanimity-faculty will not arise, for them the life-faculty will not arise?
For those whose final consciousness associated with joy will arise immediately after their current consciousness, for them the equanimity-faculty...

It will not arise, yet for them the life-faculty (jīvitindriya) will not necessarily not arise. For those possessing their final consciousness, neither the equanimity-faculty (upekkhindriya) nor the life-faculty will arise.
For one whose life-faculty will not arise, will the faith-faculty (saddhindriya)… pe… the understanding-faculty (paññindriya)… pe… the mind-faculty (manindriya) not arise? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise, will the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise for them? Yes. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whomsoever the mental joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) will not arise, will the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) not arise for them?
For those whose final consciousness immediately following that [present] consciousness will arise associated with equanimity, the mental joy-faculty...
It will not arise for them, yet the equanimity faculty (upekkhindriya) will not necessarily fail to arise for them.

For those possessing their final consciousness, neither the joy faculty (somanassindriya) nor the equanimity faculty will arise. Or conversely, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, will the joy faculty also not arise for them?
For those whose consciousness immediately following it will arise as a final consciousness associated with mental joy, the faculty of equanimity will not arise,
but the faculty of mental joy will not fail to arise for them. For those possessing the final consciousness,
neither the faculty of equanimity nor the faculty of mental joy will arise.

For whom the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise, for them will the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) …pe… the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) …pe… the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) not arise?

For those whose final consciousness immediately following [this] state of consciousness will be associated with equanimity (*upekkhā*), the faculty of mental joy will not arise, but it is not the case that the faculty of mind will not arise for them. [This is so] for those possessing the final consciousness.

For those persons, neither the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) nor the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) will arise. Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will not arise, will the faculty of mental joy also not arise for them? Yes. (Based on the faculty of mental joy.

For whomsoever the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise, will the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) … pe … the faculty of mind not arise for them?
For those whose consciousness immediately following will arise as a final consciousness associated with joy, the faculty of equanimity will not arise,
but it is not the case that the mind-faculty will not arise for them. For those possessing the final consciousness,
neither the faculty of equanimity nor the mind-faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise, will the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) not arise for them? Yes. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whomsoever the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) will not arise, will the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) ... [and so on] ... the mind faculty not arise for them? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty not arise for them? Yes. (Based on the faith faculty.)
For whom the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) will not arise, for that person the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) will not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the faculty of mind will not arise, for that person the faculty of wisdom will not arise? Yes. (Based on the faculty of wisdom. 10.2.1.3.5.
Negative Plane (Paccanīka-Okāsa)
Where the eye faculty will not arise, will the ear faculty not arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the ear faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the eye faculty will not arise, will the nose faculty not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the nose faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the nose faculty will not arise there, but the eye faculty will not fail to arise there. In non-percipient beings and the immaterial sphere (arūpa), neither the nose faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
Where the eye faculty will not arise, will the female faculty …pe… the male faculty not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the male faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise there?
In the fine-material sphere, the male faculty will not arise there, but the eye faculty will not fail to arise there.
In non-percipient beings and in the immaterial sphere, neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
Where the eye-faculty will not arise, will the life-faculty there not arise? It will arise.
Or else, where the life-faculty will not arise, will the eye-faculty there not arise? There is none.
Where the eye-faculty will not arise, will the mental joy-faculty there not arise? Yes.
Or, where the faculty of mental joy will not arise, will the faculty of the eye not arise there? Yes.
Where the faculty of the eye will not arise, will the faculty of equanimity not arise there?

In the formless realm, the faculty of the eye will not arise, but it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity will not arise there. Among non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of the eye nor the faculty of equanimity will arise.
Or again: Wherever the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise, will the faculty of eye (*cakkhundriya*) not arise there? Yes.
Wherever the faculty of eye will not arise, will the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) …pe… the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) …pe… the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) not arise there?

In the formless realm (*arūpa*), the faculty of eye will not arise there, but the faculty of mind will not fail to arise there. In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the faculty of eye nor the faculty of mind will arise there.
Or, where the mind faculty will not arise, will the eye faculty not arise there? Yes. (Based on the eye faculty.
Where the nose faculty will not arise, will the femininity faculty … pe … the masculinity faculty not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the masculinity faculty will not arise, will the nose faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the nose faculty will not arise, there the life faculty will not arise? It will arise.
Or else, where the life faculty will not arise, there the nose faculty will not arise? There is none.
Where the nose faculty will not arise, there the mental joy faculty will not arise?
In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the nose-faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the mental joy faculty (somanassindriya) will not arise there.
In non-percipient beings (asaññasatta) and in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), neither the nose-faculty nor the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, where the mental joy faculty will not arise, will the nose-faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the nose faculty will not arise, will the equanimity faculty not arise there?
In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise there.
In the case of non-percipient beings, neither the nose faculty nor the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or again, where the equanimity faculty will not arise, will the nose faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the nose faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise there?
In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty will not arise there, but the mind faculty does not [fail to] arise there.
It will not arise. In the case of non-percipient beings, neither the nose faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, where the mind faculty will not arise, will the nose faculty not arise there? Yes, it will. (Based on the nose faculty.
Where the female faculty will not arise, will the male faculty not arise there? Yes, it will.
Or, where the male faculty will not arise, will the female faculty not arise there? Yes.
…pe… Where the male faculty will not arise, will the life faculty not arise there? It will arise.
Or, where the life faculty will not arise, will the male faculty not arise there? There is none.
Where the male faculty will not arise, will the mental joy faculty not arise there?
In the fine-material sphere, the male faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise there.
In non-percipient beings and in the immaterial sphere, neither the male faculty nor the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or again, where the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will not arise, will the faculty of masculinity (purisindriya) not arise there? Yes.
Where the faculty of masculinity will not arise, will the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) not arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the faculty of masculinity will not arise there, but it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity will not arise there.
It will not arise. In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the male faculty (*purisindriya*) nor the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will arise there.
Or, conversely: where the equanimity faculty will not arise, will the male faculty not arise there? Yes.
Where the male faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise there?
In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the masculinity faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise there.
In non-percipient beings, neither the masculinity faculty nor the mind faculty will arise.
Or, conversely, where the mind faculty will not arise, will the masculinity faculty not arise there? Yes. (Based on the masculinity faculty.)
Where the life-faculty will not arise, will the mental joy-faculty not arise there? None.
Or else, where the mental joy-faculty will not arise, will the life-faculty not arise there? It will arise.
Where the life-faculty will not arise, will the equanimity-faculty … pe … the faith-faculty … pe … the understanding-faculty … pe … the mind-faculty not arise there? None.
Or, where the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise, will the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise there? It will arise. (Based on the life faculty.

Where the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) will not arise, will the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) … pe … the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty will not arise, will the mental joy faculty not arise there? Yes. (Based on the mental joy faculty.)
Where the faculty of equanimity will not arise, will the faculty of faith ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind not arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, where the faculty of mind will not arise, will the faculty of equanimity not arise there? Yes. (Based on the faculty of equanimity.
Where the faculty of faith will not arise, will the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty will not arise, will the faith faculty not arise there? Yes. (Based on the faith faculty.
Where the wisdom faculty will not arise, will the mind faculty not arise there? Yes.
Or, where the mind faculty will not arise, will the wisdom faculty not arise there? Yes. (Based on the wisdom faculty.)
10.2.1.3.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa) For whom the eye faculty will not arise at a certain place, for that person will the ear faculty not arise at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the ear faculty will not arise at a certain place, for that person will the eye faculty not arise at that place? Yes.
For whom the eye-faculty will not arise at a certain place, for that person the nose-faculty will not arise at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the nose-faculty will not arise at a certain place, for that person the eye-faculty will not arise at that place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the nose-faculty will not arise there, but the eye-faculty will not [necessarily] fail to arise for them there.

It will not arise. For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the nose faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
If, for a certain person, the eye faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the female faculty also not arise for that person in that place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the femininity faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the eye faculty not arise for that person at that place?
For those in the fine-material sphere and for those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state,
will attain final nibbāna— there the femininity faculty will not arise for them, but it is not the case that the eye faculty will not arise for them there.

For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the femininity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the masculinity faculty also not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the masculinity faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the eye faculty not arise for that person at that place?

For those in the fine-material sphere and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna—there the masculinity faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the eye faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in the five-aggregate plane who are in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless plane—
the male faculty will not arise there, and the eye faculty will also not arise there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the life faculty not arise for that person in that same place?
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the eye faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them there. For those in their final existence,
neither the eye faculty nor the life faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the eye-faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the mental-joy faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mental-joy faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the eye-faculty not arise for that person at that place?
For those who possess eyes and, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final nibbāna there, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the eye-faculty will not arise for them there. For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence,
and for non-percipient beings and those in the formless realm, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the eye-faculty will arise there.
For whom the eye faculty will not arise in a certain place, for them the equanimity faculty will not arise in that same place?
For those non-percipient beings (arūpa), the eye faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika) and for non-percipient beings, neither the eye faculty nor...
[Will] the equanimity faculty not arise?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the eye faculty not arise for them there?
For those who are possessed of eyes and, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna—there, for them, the equanimity faculty [will not arise].
It will not arise, yet for those persons, the eye faculty will not fail to arise there.
For those final-existence beings in the realm of non-percipient beings, neither the equanimity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for that person in that same place?
For those beings in the formless realm, the eye faculty will not arise there; yet it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in their final existence and for non-percipient beings, neither the eye faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.

Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise in a certain place, will the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) not arise for that person in that place? Yes. (Based on the eye-faculty.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) will not arise in a certain place, will the female-faculty (*itthindriya*) not arise for that person in that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the female-faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the nose-faculty not arise for that person in that place?
For those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna, the female faculty (*itthindriya*) will not arise there;
yet, the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) will not fail to arise for them there.

For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), neither the female faculty nor the nose faculty will arise there.
For whom, where the nose-faculty will not arise, for that person there, the male-faculty will not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where the male-faculty will not arise, for that person there, the nose-faculty will not arise?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna—there, for them, the male-faculty [will not arise].

It will not arise, yet it is not the case that the nose faculty will not arise for them there. For those final-existence beings in the sense sphere, and for those in the fine-material sphere and immaterial sphere, neither the male faculty nor the nose faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the life faculty not arise for them there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them there. For those in their final existence,
neither the nose faculty nor the life faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the nose-faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the mental joy-faculty not arise for that person at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere, the nose-faculty will not arise there, but the mental joy-faculty does not [necessarily] fail to arise for them there.

It will not arise. For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the nose faculty nor the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the nose faculty also not arise for them there?
For those who are noseless and will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna there, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the faculty of the nose will not arise for them there. For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence,
and for non-percipient beings and those in the formless realm, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of the nose will arise there.
For whom the nose faculty will not arise at a certain place, for them the equanimity faculty will not arise at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in their final existence and for non-percipient beings, [the nose faculty will not arise] there...
The nose faculty will not arise and the equanimity faculty will also not arise. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the nose faculty also not arise for them there?
For those who possess a nose and, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna, the equanimity faculty [will not arise] for them there.
It will not arise, yet for those persons, the nose faculty will not fail to arise there.
For those in their final existence and for non-percipient beings, neither the equanimity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for that person in that place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them there. For those in their final existence and for non-percipient beings,
neither the nose faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise in a certain place, will the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) not arise for them there? Yes. (Based on the nose-faculty.
For whomsoever the female-faculty (*itthindriya*) will not arise in a certain place, will the male-faculty (*purisindriya*) not arise for them there?
For those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna, the female-faculty [will not arise] for them there.
[It is] not that it will not arise, yet for them there it is not the case that the male faculty will not arise.
For those in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms, neither the female faculty nor the male faculty will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the male faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the female faculty also not arise for him there?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna, the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise therein,
but the female faculty (*itthindriya*) will not fail to arise therein either. For those in their final existence in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*),
and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), neither the male faculty nor the female faculty will arise therein.
For whom the femininity faculty will not arise at a certain place, for that person will the life faculty not arise at that place?
For those in the fine-material sphere, those in the immaterial sphere, and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state,
will attain final nibbāna— there the femininity faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them there.
For those who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), neither the femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) nor the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will arise there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the life faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the femininity faculty also not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) also not arise for them in that same place?
For those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state,
will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna— there, the female faculty (itthindriya) will not arise, but the joy faculty (somanassindriya) will not fail to arise for them there.

[This is also the case] for those in their final existence in the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), for those in the immaterial realm (arūpa), and for those men...
Having shown some [beings] to undergo existence by this very state and then, having been reborn with equanimity, to attain final nibbāna—
will the femininity faculty not arise and the joy faculty also not arise for them there?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the joy faculty will not arise there, will the femininity faculty also not arise for them there?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there;
yet, for them, the female faculty will not fail to arise there.
[This is so] for those in their final existence in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, for those in the formless realm, and for those men...
Having shown some [beings] who, by this very state, will manifest existence and then, having arisen with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna— for them,
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of femininity will arise there.
For whomsoever the faculty of femininity will not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for that person in that place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state,
will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna— femininity-faculty will not arise in them there,
but equanimity-faculty will not fail to arise in them there. [This applies to] those in their final existence and to non-percipient beings, and to those men...
Having shown several existences by this very state and being reborn with joy, they will attain final nibbāna;
for them, neither the female faculty nor the equanimity faculty will arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the female faculty also not arise for them there?
For those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with joy and attain final Nibbāna, the faculty of equanimity will not arise there;
yet it is not that the female faculty will not arise for them there.
[This is also the case] for those in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state...

For those who, having been reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), will attain final Nibbāna there, neither the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) nor the femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) will arise.

For whomsoever the femininity faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise for them in that same place?

For those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, and for those men who will take only a few more births in that very state before attaining final Nibbāna, the femininity faculty will not arise there;
yet the mind faculty will not fail to arise for them there.
For those in their final existence and for non-percipient beings, neither the femininity faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.

Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, will the femininity-faculty (*itthindriya*) not arise for them there? Yes, it will not. (Based on the femininity-faculty.
For whomsoever the masculinity-faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, will the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise for them there?

[It will not] for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), for those in the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state...
For those who will attain final Nibbāna there, the male faculty will not arise,
but it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them there. For those in their final existence,
neither the male faculty nor the life faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the masculinity-faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the masculinity-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the mental joy-faculty not arise for that person at that place?
[It will not arise] for those of the fine-material sphere, and for those women who, having shown only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy.
For those who will attain final Nibbāna there, the masculinity faculty will not arise; yet it is not the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise for them there.

This applies to those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, to non-percipient beings, to those in the formless realm, and to those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and then attain final Nibbāna.
In those persons, neither the male faculty nor the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, in whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the male faculty also not arise in that person in that place?
[Answer: Those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there, but it is not the case that the male faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, for those in the formless realm, and for those women who,
having shown only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna— [for these], the faculty of mental joy will not arise there.
In that case, neither the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) nor the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise.
For whomsoever the male faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) also not arise for them in that same place? [It will not.
For those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), those in the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state...
For those who will be reborn with equanimity and will attain final Nibbāna there, the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise there;
yet, the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will not fail to arise for them there.

This is also the case for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), and for those women who, having shown only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy and will attain final Nibbāna.
In those persons, neither the male faculty nor the equanimity faculty will arise there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the male faculty also not arise for that person in that same place?
[Answer: Those males who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the equanimity faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the masculinity faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those women who, having shown only a few more existences in this very state,
will be reborn with mental joy and attain final Nibbāna— for them, the equanimity faculty [will not arise] there...
The male faculty will not arise, and the female faculty will also not arise.
For whomsoever the male faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for that person in that same place?
[Answer: For those in the fine-material sphere, those in the immaterial sphere, and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, [will pass away].
For those who will attain final Nibbāna there, the male faculty will not arise,
but the mind faculty will not fail to arise for them there. For those in their final existence and for non-percipient beings,
neither the male faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.

Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, will the masculinity-faculty (*purisindriya*) not arise for that person at that place? Yes. (Based on the masculinity-faculty.
For whomsoever the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, will the mental-joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mental-joy-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the life-faculty not arise for that person at that place?

In one whose consciousness immediately following [the present moment] will arise as the final consciousness associated with equanimity, or in those non-percipient beings, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise there for them.
For those possessing the final consciousness, neither the faculty of mental joy nor [the life-faculty] will arise there.
And the life-faculty will not arise.
For whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the equanimity-faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the life-faculty not arise for that person at that place?
For those whose consciousness immediately following it will arise as a final consciousness associated with joy, and for those non-percipient beings, the faculty of equanimity will not arise there;
yet, for them, the life-faculty will not fail to arise there.
For those possessing the final consciousness, neither the faculty of equanimity nor [the life-faculty] will arise there.
And the life-faculty will not arise.
For whomsoever, wherever the life-faculty will not arise, for that person there, will the faith-faculty … pe … wisdom-faculty … pe … mind-faculty not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever, wherever the mind-faculty will not arise, for that person there, will the life-faculty not arise?
For non-percipient beings, the mind-faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise for them there.
For those possessing their final consciousness, neither the mind-faculty nor the life-faculty will arise there. (Based on the life-faculty.)
For whom the faculty of mental joy will not arise in a certain place, for them will the faculty of equanimity not arise in that same place?
For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after their present consciousness,
the faculty of mental joy will not arise in that [consciousness], but it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity will not arise in them there.
For those who possess their final consciousness and for non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of equanimity will arise therein. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of mental joy also not arise for them there?

For those whose consciousness immediately following it will arise as a final consciousness associated with mental joy (*somanassa*), the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise therein;
yet, for them, the faculty of mental joy will not fail to arise therein.
For those possessing a final consciousness and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the faculty of equanimity nor [the faculty of mental joy] will arise therein.
And the faculty of mental joy will not arise.
For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy will not arise at a certain place, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind not arise for them at that same place?
For those whose final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after their present consciousness, for them at that place—
The faculty of mental joy will not arise, but it is not the case that the faculty of mind will not arise for them there.
For those possessing their final consciousness and for non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of mind will arise there.

Or rather, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, will the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) not arise for them there? Yes. (Based on the faculty of mental joy.

For whomsoever the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, will the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the mind-faculty not arise for them there?
For those whose final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise immediately after that state of consciousness, for them there—

The faculty of equanimity will not arise for them, but it is not the case that the mind-faculty will not arise for them there. For those possessing their final consciousness and for non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of equanimity nor the mind-faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity also not arise for them there? Yes, it will. (Based on the faculty of equanimity.)
For whomsoever the faculty of faith will not arise in a certain place, for that person the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind will not arise in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will not arise in a certain place, for that person the faculty of faith will not arise in that same place? Yes. (Based on the faculty of faith.
For whomsoever the faculty of wisdom will not arise in a certain place, for that person the faculty of mind will not arise in that same place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise at a certain place, will the wisdom faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes. (Based on the wisdom faculty.
10.2.1.4. Chapter on the Present and the Past. 10.2.1.4.1. Positive Person.
For whom the eye faculty arises, for that person did the ear faculty arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the ear faculty had arisen, for that person does the eye faculty arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the ear faculty had arisen, but [the eye faculty does not arise].
And the eye-faculty arises for them. For those who are being reborn with eyes, the ear-faculty had arisen and the eye-faculty arises.
For whom the eye-faculty arises, had the nose-faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or alternatively, for whom the nose faculty had arisen, does the eye faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without the eye faculty, the nose faculty had arisen, but the eye faculty does not arise for them.
For those being reborn who possess the eye faculty, both the nose faculty and...
For whom the eye-faculty had arisen, the eye-faculty also arises.
For whom the eye-faculty arises, had the femininity-faculty …pe… masculinity-faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or else, for whom the masculinity-faculty had arisen, does the eye-faculty arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without the eye-faculty, the male faculty had arisen,
but the eye-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with the eye-faculty, both the male faculty and the eye-faculty have arisen.
For whom the eye-faculty arises, for that person did the life-faculty arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the life-faculty had arisen, for that person does the eye-faculty arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the life-faculty had arisen.
And yet, the eye-faculty does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with eyes, the life-faculty had arisen and the eye-faculty also arises.
For one in whom the eye-faculty arises, had the mental joy-faculty …pe… the equanimity-faculty arisen? Yes.
Or alternatively, for whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) had arisen, does the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the equanimity faculty had arisen, but the eye faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn who possess eyes, both the equanimity faculty and...
For whom the eye-faculty had arisen, the eye-faculty also arises.
For whom the eye-faculty arises, has the faith-faculty … pe … the understanding-faculty … pe … the mind-faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or else, for whom the mind-faculty had arisen, does the eye-faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away who are without the eye-faculty, and for those being reborn [in a realm] without the eye-faculty, the mind-faculty had arisen, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them.
For those being reborn with the eye-faculty, both the mind-faculty had arisen and the eye-faculty arises. (Based on the eye-faculty.)
For whom the nose faculty arises, for that person did the female faculty …pe… the male faculty arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the male faculty had arisen, for that person does the nose faculty arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the male faculty had arisen, but [the nose faculty does not arise].
And the nose faculty arises for them. For those who are being reborn as beings possessing a nose, the male faculty had arisen and the nose faculty arises.
For whomsoever the nose faculty arises, had the life faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty had arisen, does the nose-faculty arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the life-faculty had arisen, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn who possess a nose, both the life-faculty and...
[For whom] the nose-faculty had arisen, the nose-faculty arises.
For whom the nose-faculty arises, has the faculty of mental joy …pe… the faculty of equanimity arisen for them? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the faculty of equanimity had arisen, does the nose-faculty arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those who are being reborn without a nose, the faculty of equanimity had arisen,
but the faculty of the nose does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with a nose, both the faculty of equanimity had arisen and the faculty of the nose arises.
For whom the nose faculty arises, for that person does the faith faculty …pe… the understanding faculty …pe… the mind faculty arise? Yes.
Or else, for whom the mind faculty had arisen, for that person does the nose faculty arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the mind faculty had arisen, but [the nose faculty does not arise].
And the nose faculty arises for them. For those who are being reborn with a nose, the mind faculty had arisen and the nose faculty also arises. (Based on the nose faculty.
For one in whom the female faculty arises, had the male faculty arisen for him? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) had arisen, does the female faculty (*itthindriya*) arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those women being reborn, the male faculty had arisen, but the female faculty does not arise for them.
For those women being reborn, both the male faculty and the female faculty have arisen.
And the femininity faculty arises.
For whom the femininity faculty arises, had the life faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or, conversely, for whom the life faculty had arisen, does the femininity faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away who are not being reborn as females, the life-faculty had arisen,
but the female faculty does not arise for them. For females being reborn, both the life-faculty had arisen and the female faculty arises.

For whomsoever the female faculty (*itthindriya*) arises, for that person does the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) ... pe ... the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the mind faculty (*manindriya*) arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty has arisen, for that person does the female faculty arise?
For all those passing away and for those women being reborn, the mind faculty has arisen, but the female faculty does not.
And the female faculty arises in them. In females who are being reborn, the mind faculty had arisen and the female faculty also arises. (Based on the female faculty.
For one in whom the male faculty arises, had the life faculty arisen for him? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) had arisen, does the masculinity-faculty (*purisindriya*) arise for them?
For all those passing away and for non-males being reborn, the life-faculty had arisen, but the masculinity-faculty does not arise for them. For males being reborn, both the life-faculty and...

If the masculinity faculty has arisen for someone, does the mind faculty also arise for that person? Yes. Or, conversely, if the mind faculty has arisen for someone, does the masculinity faculty arise for that person? Yes. If the masculinity faculty has arisen for someone, does the joy faculty … pe … the equanimity faculty … pe … the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty also arise for that person? Yes.
Or, conversely, if the mind faculty has arisen for someone, does the masculinity faculty arise for that person? Yes.
For all those who are passing away, the mind faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen, but the male faculty (*purisindriya*) does not arise for them.
For those males who are being reborn, both the mind faculty and the male faculty have arisen. (Based on the male faculty.)
Does mental joy faculty (somanassindriya) arise for one in whom life faculty (jīvitindriya) arises? Yes.
Or rather, does life faculty arise for one in whom mental joy faculty has arisen?
For all those passing away and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the cessation of consciousness, mental joy faculty has arisen.

And yet, the life-faculty does not arise for them. For all those who are being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness, both the joy-faculty has arisen and the life-faculty arises.
For one in whom the life-faculty arises, has the equanimity-faculty … pe … faith-faculty … pe … understanding-faculty … pe … mind-faculty arisen? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty had arisen, does the life-faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence, the mind-faculty had arisen, but the life-faculty does not arise for them.
For all those being reborn and for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness during the course of existence...
For them, the mind-faculty had arisen and the life-faculty arises. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whom the joy-faculty arises, for that person had the equanimity-faculty arisen? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the equanimity-faculty had arisen, for that person does the joy-faculty arise?
In all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy,

in those who have attained cessation, and in those non-percipient beings, the faculty of equanimity has arisen, but the faculty of mental joy does not arise for them. For those being reborn with mental joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy, [the faculty of equanimity has arisen, but the faculty of mental joy does not arise].
The faculty of equanimity had arisen and the faculty of mental joy arises.
For one in whom the faculty of mental joy arises, had the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arisen? Yes.
Or else, for one in whom the faculty of mind had arisen, does the faculty of mental joy arise?
In all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy,

and in those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings, the mind faculty has arisen, but the faculty of mental joy does not arise for them. However, for those being reborn with mental joy,
and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy, [the mind faculty arises].
The mind faculty had arisen and the joy faculty also arises. (Based on the joy faculty.
For whom the equanimity faculty arises, had the faith faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or, for whom the faith faculty had arisen, does the equanimity faculty arise for them?
In all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity,
and in those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings, the faculty of faith had arisen, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise for them. For those being reborn with equanimity,
and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity, both the faculty of faith and...
[For whom] the equanimity faculty has arisen, the equanimity faculty also arises.
For whom the equanimity faculty arises, does the understanding faculty …pe… the mind faculty arise for them? Yes.
Or, for whom the mind faculty has arisen, does the equanimity faculty arise for them?
In all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity,
in those who have attained cessation, and in non-percipient beings— the mind faculty has arisen, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with equanimity,
and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity— the mind faculty and...
The faculty of equanimity has arisen and the faculty of equanimity also arises. (Based on the faculty of equanimity.
For whom the faculty of faith arises, for that person has the faculty of wisdom arisen? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the faculty of wisdom has arisen, for that person does the faculty of faith arise?
In all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of consciousness dissociated from faith,

in those who have attained cessation, and in non-percipient beings, the faculty of wisdom had arisen, but the faculty of faith does not arise for them. For those with roots of cause who are being reborn,
and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness associated with faith, both the faculty of wisdom and [the faculty of faith] arise.
Faith-faculty had arisen and faith-faculty also arises.
For whom faith-faculty arises, had mind-faculty arisen for them? Yes.
Or else, for whom mind-faculty had arisen, does faith-faculty arise for them?
In all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith,
in those who have attained cessation, and in non-percipient beings— the mind faculty (manindriya) has arisen, but the faith faculty (saddhindriya) does not arise for them.

For those with roots of cause (sahetuka) at the moment of rebirth, and during the course of existence (pavatta) at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith— the mind faculty and...
The faculty of faith had arisen and the faculty of faith also arises. (Based on the faculty of faith.
For whom the faculty of wisdom arises, for that person had the faculty of mind arisen? Yes.
Or else, for whom the faculty of mind had arisen, for that person does the faculty of wisdom arise?
In all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of consciousness dissociated from knowledge,
and in those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings, the mind faculty (*manindriya*) has arisen, but the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) does not arise.

In those associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness associated with knowledge, [the mind faculty has arisen and the wisdom faculty arises].
The mind faculty had arisen and the wisdom faculty arises. (Based on the wisdom faculty. 10.2.1.4.2.

10.2.1.4.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-puggalokāsa) For whom, and in what [sphere], does the eye-faculty arise;
for that same person, and in that same [sphere], had the ear-faculty arisen?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the eye-faculty arises there, but the ear-faculty had not arisen there for them.
The ear faculty had arisen. For those others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty and the ear faculty arise there.
Or, conversely, for one in whom the ear faculty had arisen at a certain place, does the eye faculty arise there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm who are without the eye faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm,
the ear faculty had arisen there, but the eye faculty does not arise there for them. For those being reborn with the eye faculty, both the ear faculty and the eye faculty have arisen there.
For whom and in what [plane] the eye-faculty arises, for them has the nose-faculty arisen there?
For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the eye-faculty arises there, but the nose-faculty has not arisen there for them.
For those possessing eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, the eye-faculty [arises] there...
Does the nose faculty arise for that person at that plane? Or, conversely, for whomsoever the nose faculty had arisen at a certain plane, does the eye faculty arise for them at that same plane?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those being reborn into the sense-sphere realm, the nose faculty [had arisen] at that plane.

[It] had arisen, yet the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. For those possessing eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), the nose-faculty had arisen and the eye-faculty also arises there.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty arises there, for that person had the femininity-faculty …pe… masculinity-faculty arisen there?
For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the eye-faculty arises there,
but the male faculty had not arisen for them there. For those with eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere,
both the eye-faculty arises there and the male faculty had arisen for them there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*) who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes—the masculinity faculty had arisen for them there, but the eye faculty does not arise for them there. [However, this is not the case] for those with eyes being reborn in the sense-sphere...
For those being reborn there, the male faculty had arisen and the eye faculty arises.
For whomsoever the eye faculty arises there, had the life faculty arisen for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the eye faculty arises there, but for them the life faculty had not [previously] arisen there.
The life-faculty had arisen. For those others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-faculty and the life-faculty arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the life-faculty had arisen at a certain place, does the eye-faculty arise there for that person?

For all those passing away who are without eye-faculty, and for those being reborn there who are without eye-faculty, the life-faculty had arisen there, but the eye-faculty does not arise there. For those being reborn there with eye-faculty,
both the life-faculty had arisen there and the eye-faculty arises there.
For whom, and where, the eye-faculty arises, for them has the joy-faculty arisen there?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the eye-faculty arises there, but the joy-faculty has not arisen there for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, the eye-faculty arises there...
Does the eye faculty arise for that person, and the joy faculty have arisen for them?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the joy faculty has arisen at a certain place, does the eye faculty arise for that person at that same place?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, the joy faculty [has arisen] there.
[It] had arisen, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with eyes, both the faculty of mental joy and the eye-faculty arise there.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty arises there, had the faculty of equanimity arisen for him there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the eye faculty arises there,
but the equanimity faculty had not arisen for them there. For others who are being reborn with eyes,
both the eye faculty arises there and the equanimity faculty had arisen for them there.
Or conversely, for whomver equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) who are without eyes, and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*):
for them, equanimity faculty had arisen there, but eye faculty does not arise there. [However, it does arise] for those with eyes.
For those being reborn there, the faculty of equanimity had arisen and the faculty of eye also arises.
For whomsoever the faculty of eye arises there, had the faculty of faith arisen for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the faculty of eye arises there, but for them the faculty of faith had not [previously] arisen there.
The faculty of faith had arisen. For those others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-faculty and the faculty of faith arise therein.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of faith had arisen in a certain place, does the eye-faculty arise therein for that person?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without the eye faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane or in the formless plane,
the faculty of faith had arisen there, but the eye faculty does not arise there for them. For those being reborn with the eye faculty, both the faculty of faith and the eye faculty have arisen there.
For whom and where the eye-faculty arises, for them does the understanding-faculty ... pe ... the mind-faculty arise there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the eye-faculty arises there, but the mind-faculty had not arisen for them there.
For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-faculty and [the mind-faculty arise there].

Does the mind faculty arise for that person at that plane where the mind faculty had arisen? Or conversely, for those persons at whom plane the mind faculty had arisen, does the eye faculty arise for them at that plane?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm who are not to obtain the eye faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or in the formless realm—at those planes, [the eye faculty does not arise].
The mind faculty had arisen for them, but the eye faculty does not arise for them there.
For those who are being reborn with eyes, the mind faculty had arisen and the eye faculty also arises there.
(Based on the eye faculty.)
For whomsoever the nose-faculty arises at a certain place, does the female-faculty ... pe ... or the male-faculty arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the male-faculty had arisen at a certain place, does the nose-faculty arise for them at that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, the male-faculty [had arisen] at that place.

[It was] arisen for them, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn as possessing a nose, the male faculty had arisen and the nose-faculty arises there for them.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty arises there, had the life-faculty arisen for that person there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) arise for them there?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the life-faculty had arisen there, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn who possess a nose, [the nose-faculty arises] there.
The life-faculty had arisen and the nose-faculty arises.
For whomsoever, wherever the nose-faculty arises, for that person there, had the mental joy-faculty arisen? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever, wherever the mental joy-faculty had arisen, for that person there, does the nose-faculty arise?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara),
the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) had arisen there, but the faculty of the nose (ghānindriya) does not arise there for them.
For those being reborn with a nose, both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of the nose arise there.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty arises at a certain place, for that person has the equanimity-faculty arisen at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty has arisen at a certain place, for that person does the nose-faculty arise at that place?

[It does not] for those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without a nose, nor for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, nor for those of the fine-material sphere, nor for those of the immaterial sphere.
In those persons, the faculty of equanimity had arisen there, but the faculty of nose does not arise there for them.
For those who are being reborn with a nose, the faculty of equanimity had arisen there and the faculty of nose also arises there.
For whomsoever the faculty of nose arises there, has the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arisen there for them? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
the mind-faculty had arisen there, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those beings being reborn among those lacking a nose, the mind-faculty had arisen there and the nose-faculty also arises there. (Based on the nose-faculty.
For whomsoever the female-faculty arises at a certain place, had the male-faculty arisen for them at that same place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the masculinity faculty had arisen at a certain place, does the femininity faculty arise for them at that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the masculinity faculty had arisen there, but the femininity faculty does not arise for them there.
For those females being reborn, [the femininity faculty arises].
In that case, for whom the male faculty (*purisindriya*) had arisen and the female faculty (*itthindriya*) arises:
for whomsoever the female faculty arises at a certain place, had the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arisen for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty had arisen at a certain place, does the female faculty arise for them at that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for females being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms—

the life-faculty had arisen there for them, but the female-faculty does not arise there for them. For females being reborn, the life-faculty had arisen there for them and the female-faculty also arises there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty arises at a certain plane, has the joy faculty arisen for them at that same plane? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the joy faculty has arisen at a certain plane, does the femininity faculty arise for them at that same plane?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or the fine-material-sphere realm—[for these, the femininity faculty does not arise].
In that case, mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) had arisen for them, but femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) does not arise for them there.
For women who are being reborn, both mental joy faculty had arisen and femininity faculty arises there.

For whomsoever femininity faculty arises there, has equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) … pe … faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … mind faculty (*manindriya*) arisen for them there? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the femininity-faculty (*itthindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for non-females being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
the mind-faculty had arisen there, but the femininity-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those females who are being reborn there, both the mind faculty and the female faculty have arisen for them there.
(Based on the female faculty.
For whomsoever the male faculty arises there, has the life faculty arisen for him there? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty had arisen at a certain place, does the masculinity-faculty arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, as well as for those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere—
the life-faculty had arisen for them there, but the masculinity-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those males who are being reborn, both the life-faculty and the masculinity-faculty have arisen there.
For whomsoever the masculinity-faculty arises in a particular place, has the joy-faculty arisen for them in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the joy-faculty has arisen in a particular place, does the masculinity-faculty arise for them in that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) and for those males being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara),
the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) had arisen there, but the male faculty (purisindriya) does not arise there for them.
For those males being reborn [in the sense-sphere realm], both the faculty of mental joy and the male faculty have arisen there.
For whomsoever the masculinity faculty arises at a certain place, has the equanimity faculty arisen for that person at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty has arisen at a certain place, does the masculinity faculty arise for that person at that place?

[It does not] for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not males, nor for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, nor for those of the fine-material sphere, nor for those of the immaterial sphere.
In those [beings], the equanimity faculty had arisen there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise there for them.
For males who are being reborn, both the equanimity faculty had arisen there and the masculinity faculty arises there.
For whomsoever the masculinity faculty arises there, has the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arisen there for that person? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the masculinity-faculty (*purisindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for non-males being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
the mind-faculty had arisen there, but the masculinity-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those males being reborn, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) and the male faculty (*purisindriya*) have arisen there.
(Based on the male faculty.
For whomsoever the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises at a certain place, has the joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) arisen for them at that same place?

At the moment of arising of the rebirth-consciousness of those born in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the life-faculty (jīvitindriya) arises there;
but the mental joy-faculty (somanassindriya) had not arisen for them there.
For others, at the moment of arising of consciousness during the course of existence while being reborn into the four- or five-aggregate realms, [the life-faculty arises there].
Does the life-faculty arise and the mental joy-faculty have arisen?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever and wherever the mental joy-faculty has arisen, does the life-faculty arise there for them?
For those passing away from the four- or five-aggregate planes, and during the cessant phase of consciousness in the course of existence, the mental joy-faculty [has arisen] there for them.
[The life faculty] had arisen for them, but the life faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn in the four- or five-aggregate planes,
at the moment of the arising of consciousness during the course of existence, both the mental joy faculty and the life faculty have arisen and are arising for them there.
For whom and in what [plane] does the life-faculty arise, for that same person and in that same plane had the equanimity-faculty arisen?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings, the life-faculty arises there, but the equanimity-faculty had not arisen for them there. For others, in the fourfold and fivefold planes...
For those being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness,
the life faculty arises and the equanimity faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty has arisen there, does the life faculty arise there for them?
For those passing away from the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states, at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence,
the equanimity faculty had arisen therein, but the life faculty does not arise therein for them. For those being reborn into the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states,
at the moment of the arising of consciousness during the course of existence, the equanimity faculty had arisen therein for them.
And the life-faculty arises.
For whomsoever the life-faculty arises at a certain place, has the faith-faculty … pe … the understanding-faculty … pe … the mind-faculty arisen at that same place for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings, the life-faculty arises at that place [but the other faculties have not].
It arises, but the mind faculty had not previously arisen for them there. For others— those being reborn into the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms—
and during the phase of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence, both the life faculty and the mind faculty arise for them there,
and the mind faculty had also previously arisen.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the four- or five-aggregate states, and during the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, the mind-faculty had arisen for them there, but the life-faculty does not arise for them there. [This applies to] those passing away from the four- or five-aggregate states.

For those who are being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness, the mind-faculty had arisen and the life-faculty arises there. (Based on the life-faculty.

For whomsoever the joy-faculty arises in a certain place, does the equanimity-faculty ... pe ... the faith-faculty ... pe ... the understanding-faculty ... pe ... the mind-faculty arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) arise for them there?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from joy, the mind-faculty had arisen there, but the joy-faculty does not arise for them there. [Regarding] joy...

For those being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen and the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) arises therein. (Based on the mental joy faculty.
For whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arises therein, had the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) arisen therein for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the equanimity faculty (upekkhindriya) arises there,

but the faith faculty (saddhindriya) had not previously arisen for them there. For others who are being reborn with equanimity, at the moment of the arising of an equanimity-associated consciousness during the course of existence (pavatta),
both the equanimity faculty and the faith faculty arise there, and the faith faculty had also previously arisen for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of faith has arisen at a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity arise for them at that same place?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, the faculty of faith has arisen for them at that place, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise for them at that place. Regarding equanimity...
For those beings being reborn, and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity,
the faculty of faith had arisen and the faculty of equanimity arises there.
For one in whom the faculty of equanimity arises at a certain place, has the faculty of wisdom …pe… the faculty of mind arisen there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the equanimity faculty (upekkhindriya) arises there,

but the mind faculty (manindriya) had not previously arisen there for them. For others who are being reborn with equanimity, at the moment of the arising of an equanimity-associated consciousness during the course of existence (pavatta),
both the equanimity faculty and the mind faculty arise there, and the mind faculty had also previously arisen there.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise for them there?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, the mind-faculty had arisen there, but the equanimity-faculty does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those being reborn with equanimity.

At the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity during the course of existence, the mind faculty had arisen and the equanimity faculty arises for those persons there. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whomsoever the faith faculty arises at a certain place, had the wisdom faculty arisen for that person at that place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the faculty of faith arises there,

but the faculty of wisdom has not arisen for them there. For others who are reborn with roots-cause (sahetuka), at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith during the course of existence (pavatta),
both the faculty of faith and the faculty of wisdom arise there, and the faculty of wisdom has also arisen for them there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) had arisen at a certain place, does the faculty of faith (saddhindriya) arise for them there?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith—the faculty of wisdom had arisen for them there, but the faculty of faith does not arise for them there. [This is so] for those possessed of roots (sahetuka).
For those who are being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith,
both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of faith have arisen there.
For one in whom the faculty of faith arises at a certain place, has the faculty of mind arisen there for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the faculty of faith (saddhindriya) arises there,
