but the faculty of mind (manindriya) had not previously arisen for them there. For others who are reborn with roots (sahetuka), at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith during the course of existence (pavatta),
both the faculty of faith and the faculty of mind arise there, and the faculty of mind had also previously arisen for them there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) arise there for them?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith, the mind-faculty had arisen there, but the faith-faculty does not arise there for them. [This is so] for those with roots-cause (*sahetuka*).

For those being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) and the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) have arisen there. (Based on the faith faculty.
For whomsoever the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arises at a certain place, has the mind faculty arisen for them at that same place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises there,

but the faculty of mind (manindriya) had not previously arisen for them there. For others— those being reborn associated with knowledge (ñāṇasampayutta)— and during the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge in the course of existence (pavatta),
both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of mind arise there for them.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen at a certain place, does the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arise for them there?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge, the mind faculty had arisen there, but the wisdom faculty does not arise for them there. However, for those being reborn who are associated with knowledge...

In the case of one whose consciousness is associated with knowledge at the moment of its arising during the course of existence, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) and the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) have arisen therein, and the wisdom faculty also arises there.
(Based on the wisdom faculty. 10.2.1.4.4.
Negative Person (*paccanīka-puggala*).
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, for that person did the ear faculty not arise? It had arisen.
Or else, for whom the ear faculty did not arise, for that person does the eye faculty not arise? There is no such case.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, for that person did the nose faculty not arise? It had arisen.
Or, for whom the nose faculty had not arisen, does the eye faculty not arise for them? None.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, had the femininity faculty … pe … the masculinity faculty not arisen for them? It had arisen.
Or, for whom the masculinity faculty had not arisen, does the eye faculty not arise for them? None.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, for that person did the life faculty not arise? It had arisen.
Or rather, for whom the life faculty did not arise, for that person does the eye faculty not arise? There is none.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, for that person did the mental joy faculty … pe … the equanimity faculty not arise? It had arisen.
Or, for whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) had not arisen, does the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) not arise for them? None.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise, has the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) …pe… the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) …pe… the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arisen for them? It has arisen.
Or, for whom the mind faculty had not arisen, does the eye faculty not arise for them? None …pe….
For whom the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) does not arise, for that person did the faculty of mind (manindriya) not arise? It had arisen.
Or else, for whom the faculty of mind did not arise, for that person does the faculty of wisdom not arise? There is no such case.
10.2.1.4.5. Negative Spatial Analysis (Paccanīka-okāsa).
Where the eye-faculty does not arise, there the ear-faculty has not arisen? …pe… 10.2.1.4.6.
Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa):
For whom, where the eye-faculty does not arise, for that person, there the ear-faculty has not arisen?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, the eye-faculty does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the ear-faculty had not arisen for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, and for non-percipient beings and those in the formless plane, neither the eye-faculty nor the ear-faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the ear faculty had not arisen at a certain place, does the eye faculty not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the ear faculty had not arisen there, yet the eye faculty does not fail to arise for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), and for those in the formless realms (arūpa), [the eye faculty does not arise].
In that case, the ear faculty had not arisen and the eye faculty does not arise.
For whom, where the eye faculty does not arise, has the nose faculty not arisen there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise there.

It does not arise [for them], yet for those persons, the nose faculty had not previously arisen there. For those passing away from the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), and for those in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), neither the eye faculty nor the nose faculty had previously arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the nose faculty had not previously arisen there, does the eye faculty not arise there for that person?
For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the nose faculty had not arisen there,
but it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise there for them. For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the nose faculty nor the eye faculty has arisen there.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise at a particular place, for that person the female faculty … pe … male faculty has not arisen at that place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the eye faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the male faculty has not arisen for them there. For those passing away from the fine-material sphere … [and so on].
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, neither the eye faculty nor the masculinity faculty arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the masculinity faculty has not arisen at a certain place, does the eye faculty not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the masculinity faculty has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them there.

In that case, the eye-faculty does not arise. For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither the masculinity faculty nor the eye-faculty has arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty does not arise in a certain place, has the life-faculty not arisen for them in that same place?
For all those passing away who are without eye-faculty and for those being reborn [there] without eye-faculty, the eye-faculty does not arise there,
but it is not the case that the life-faculty had not arisen there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes,
neither the eye-faculty nor the life-faculty arises there, nor had the life-faculty arisen there.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, does the eye-faculty not arise for them there?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the life-faculty had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, both the life-faculty and...
The eye faculty did not arise and it does not arise.
For whom, where the eye faculty does not arise, for them there, has the mental joy faculty not arisen?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, the eye faculty [does not arise] there.

[For some] the eye faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the joy faculty had not arisen for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), and for those in the formless realm (arūpa), the eye faculty does not arise there and the ear faculty also had not arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the joy faculty had not arisen at a certain place, does the eye faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) had not arisen there,

but it is not the case that the eye-faculty (cakkhundriya) does not arise there for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), and for those in the formless realms (arūpa),
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the eye-faculty arises there.
For whom the eye faculty does not arise at a certain place, for that person did the equanimity faculty not arise there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for those in the formless realm—the eye faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty did not arise there for them. [This is so] in the case of the Pure Abodes.
For those attaining final nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, the eye faculty does not arise there, and the equanimity faculty has also not arisen there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty has not arisen there, does the eye faculty not arise there for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the equanimity faculty has not arisen there, yet it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them there.
In that case, the eye faculty does not arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the equanimity faculty nor the eye faculty had arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty does not arise in a certain place, has the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arisen for them in that same place?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or in the formless realms,

the eye-faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the mind-faculty had not arisen for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the eye-faculty nor the mind-faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, does the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) not arise there for them?
For those reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-faculty had not arisen there, yet the eye-faculty does not fail to arise there for them.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), [the mind-faculty had not arisen there, and the eye-faculty does not arise there].
The mind-faculty had not arisen, and the eye-faculty does not arise. (Based on the eye-faculty.
For whom, where the nose-faculty does not arise, does the female-faculty … pe … male-faculty not arise?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, the nose-faculty [does not arise] there.

It does not arise, yet for those persons, the male faculty had not previously arisen there. For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, neither the nose faculty nor the male faculty has arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the male faculty had not arisen at a certain place, has the nose faculty not arisen for them there? Yes.
For whom the nose faculty does not arise at a certain place, for them did the life faculty not arise at that place?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the life faculty did not arise for them there. For those of the Pure Abodes, both the nose faculty and...
Does the life-faculty not arise and also not arise previously?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty did not arise previously at a certain place, does the nose-faculty not arise there for him? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty does not arise at a certain place, did the mental joy faculty not arise there for him previously? Yes.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the nose-faculty (ghānindriya) does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) has not previously arisen for them there.

For those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), and those in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), neither the nose-faculty nor the faculty of mental joy arises there, nor has the faculty of mental joy previously arisen for them there.
Or conversely: For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, does the faculty of nose (*ghānindriya*) not arise for them at that place? Yes.

For whomsoever the faculty of nose does not arise at a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) … pe … the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) … pe … the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) not arise for them at that place? [It does not.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*).
In those [beings], the nose faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the mind faculty has not arisen there for them.
For the beings of the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose faculty nor the mind faculty has arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mind faculty has not arisen in a certain place, does the nose faculty not arise there for him? Yes, it does. (Based on the nose faculty.)
For whom the female faculty does not arise at a certain place, for that person did the male faculty not arise there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the female faculty does not arise there;
yet, for them, the male faculty had not previously failed to arise there. [This is also the case] for those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere.
In those [beings], neither the female faculty nor the male faculty has arisen there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the male faculty has not arisen in a certain place, has the female faculty not arisen for that person in that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the female faculty does not arise in a certain place, has the life-faculty not arisen for that person in that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for women being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms, the femininity faculty does not arise there;
yet, it is not the case that the life faculty has not arisen there for them.
For those of the Pure Abodes, neither the femininity faculty nor the life faculty has arisen there.
Or again: For whomsoever, wherever the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) had not arisen, for that person there, does the female-faculty (*itthindriya*) not arise? Yes.
For whomsoever, wherever the female-faculty does not arise, for that person there, had the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arisen?

[It was not so] for those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), nor for women being reborn in the sense-sphere, nor for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*). For these, [the female-faculty does not arise, yet the joy-faculty had previously arisen].
In that case, the female faculty does not arise, yet for them the mental joy faculty had not failed to arise there.
For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the female faculty nor the mental joy faculty had arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mental joy faculty had not arisen in a certain place, has the female faculty not arisen for them there? Yes.

For whomsoever the femininity faculty does not arise at a certain place, for that person at that place, does the equanimity faculty … pe … the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the fine-material-sphere realm, or the immaterial-sphere realm— for them, the femininity faculty does not arise there,
but it is not the case that the mind faculty did not arise for them there.
For the beings of the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the female faculty (itthindriya) nor the mind faculty (manindriya) arises there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty did not arise in a certain place, does the female faculty not arise for them there? Yes, it does not. (Based on the female faculty.
For whomsoever the male faculty (purisindriya) does not arise in a certain place, did the life faculty (jīvitindriya) not arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the fine-material-sphere realm, or the immaterial-sphere realm—
the male faculty does not arise there, yet it is not the case that the life faculty had not previously arisen for them there.
For those pure-abode beings, neither the male faculty nor the life faculty has arisen there.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty had not arisen at a certain place, does the masculinity-faculty not arise for him there? Yes.
For whomsoever the masculinity-faculty does not arise at a certain place, had the joy-faculty not arisen for him there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere or the fine-material sphere—[for these, the joy-faculty had not arisen].
In that case, the male faculty does not arise, yet it is not the case that the mental joy faculty has not arisen for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the male faculty nor the mental joy faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mental joy faculty has not arisen in a certain place, does the male faculty not arise for him there? Yes.

For whom the male faculty does not arise at a certain place, for that person at that place, does the equanimity faculty ... pe ... the faith faculty ... pe ... the understanding faculty ... pe ... the mind faculty not arise?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the fine-material-sphere realm, or the immaterial-sphere realm—for them, the male faculty does not arise at that place, but it is not the case that the mind faculty did not arise for them at that place.
For those in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the male faculty nor the mind faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty has not arisen in a certain place, does the male faculty not arise for them there? Yes. (Based on the male faculty.
For whomsoever the life faculty does not arise in a certain place, has the mental joy faculty not arisen for them there?
For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent planes at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence,

the life-faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the joy-faculty had not previously arisen for them there. For those pure-abode beings at the moment of the cessation of the rebirth-consciousness,
and for those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings, neither the life-faculty nor the joy-faculty arises there, and the joy-faculty had also not previously arisen for them there.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) had not arisen at a certain place, does the faculty of life (jīvitindriya) not arise for them there?

For those in the pure abodes (suddhāvāsa) at the moment of the arising of the rebirth-consciousness, and for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the faculty of mental joy does not arise there;
yet, it is not the case that the faculty of life had not previously arisen for them there. For those in the pure abodes...

At the moment of the dissolution of the rebirth-consciousness, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, the faculty of mental joy has not arisen there, and the life-faculty does not arise there.

For whomsoever the life-faculty does not arise in a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity … pe … the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the mind-faculty not arise for them in that same place?
For those passing away from the four- or five-aggregate planes at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence,

the life-faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the mind-faculty had not previously arisen there for them. For those pure-abode beings at the moment of the cessation of the rebirth-consciousness, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, neither the life-faculty nor the mind-faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, does the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise there for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*) and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the mind-faculty had not arisen there;
yet, for them, the life-faculty does not fail to arise there. [This is] regarding the rebirth-consciousness of those in the Pure Abodes.
At the moment of dissolution, for those non-percipient beings passing away, the mind faculty had not arisen there, and the life faculty does not arise there. (Based on the life faculty.

For whomsoever the joy faculty does not arise at a certain place, does the equanimity faculty … pe … the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them at that place?
In all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from joy,

the faculty of joy does not arise there, yet it is not the case that the mind-faculty has not arisen there for them. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of joy nor the mind-faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely: For whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, does the joy-faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise for them there? Yes. (Based on the joy-faculty.
For whomsoever the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) does not arise at a certain place, had the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) not arisen for them there?

[It was not so] for all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness dissociated from equanimity; for them, there [it was not so].
The faculty of equanimity does not arise for them there, but the faculty of faith has not failed to arise for them there.
At the moment of the cessation of the rebirth-consciousness of those born in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), and for those non-percipient beings (asaññasatta),
neither the faculty of equanimity nor the faculty of faith has arisen there.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of faith had not arisen at a certain place, does the faculty of equanimity not arise for them there?
For those beings being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the faculty of faith had not arisen there, yet the faculty of equanimity does not fail to arise for them there.
At the moment of the dissolution of the rebirth-consciousness of those in the Pure Abodes, and for non-percipient beings...
For them, neither the faculty of faith nor the faculty of equanimity had arisen there.
For whomsoever the faculty of equanimity does not arise in a certain place, for that person has the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind not arisen there?
[It is so] for all at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those with a consciousness dissociated from equanimity at the moment of its arising; for them, in that place—
The equanimity faculty does not arise for them there, but the mind faculty had not failed to arise for them there either.
For those in the pure abodes at the moment of the cessation of the rebirth-consciousness, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the mind faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, does the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) not arise there for them?
For those beings being reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-faculty had not arisen there, yet the equanimity-faculty does not fail to arise there for them.
[This is also the case] at the moment of the dissolution of the rebirth-consciousness of those born in the Pure Abodes, and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*).
For them, neither the mind faculty (*manindriya*) had arisen there, nor does the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise there. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whom the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) does not arise at a certain place, for that person does the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise there?

For all [beings] at the moment of the cessation of consciousness, and for those with a consciousness dissociated from faith at the moment of its arising—at these, for them, [the faculties do not arise].
The faculty of faith does not arise, but it is not the case that the faculty of mind has not arisen for them there.
At the moment of the cessation of the rebirth-consciousness of the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta),
neither the faculty of faith nor the faculty of mind has arisen there.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) had not arisen at a certain place, does the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-faculty had not arisen there, yet the faith-faculty does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is also the case] at the moment of dissolution of the rebirth-consciousness of those in the Pure Abodes, and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*).
For them, the mind faculty had not arisen there, and the faith faculty does not arise there. (Based on the faith faculty.
For whom the wisdom faculty does not arise at a certain place, for that person had the mind faculty not arisen at that place?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those with consciousness dissociated from knowledge at the moment of its arising—for them, the wisdom faculty [does not arise] there.

[It is] not that it does not arise, yet for them the mind faculty (manindriya) had not previously arisen there. For those in the pure abodes (suddhāvāsa) at the moment of the dissolution of the rebirth-consciousness, and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the wisdom faculty (paññindriya) arises nor had the mind faculty previously arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mind faculty had not previously arisen in a certain place, does the wisdom faculty not arise for him there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the mind faculty had not arisen there, yet the wisdom faculty does not fail to arise there for them.

At the moment of the dissolution of the rebirth-consciousness of those born in the Pure Abodes, and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind faculty nor the wisdom faculty has arisen there, nor does the wisdom faculty arise there. (Based on the wisdom faculty.)
10.2.1.5. Chapter on the Present and Future (Paccuppannānāgatavāra) 10.2.1.5.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye faculty arises, will the ear faculty arise for that person?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn in the formless realm—
at the moment of their rebirth, the eye faculty arises for them, but the ear faculty will not arise for them.
For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty arises and the ear faculty will arise.
Or again, for whom the ear faculty will arise, does the eye faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without the eye faculty, the ear faculty will arise, but the eye faculty does not arise for them.
For those being reborn who possess the eye faculty, both the ear faculty and...
The eye faculty will arise and the eye faculty is arising.
For whom the eye faculty is arising, will the nose faculty arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms...
For those who will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the eye faculty arises,
but the nose faculty will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty arises and the nose faculty will arise.
Or again, for whom the nose faculty will arise, does the eye faculty arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without the eye faculty, the nose faculty will arise, but the eye faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn who possess the eye faculty, both the nose faculty and...
The eye-faculty will arise and the eye-faculty is arising.
For whom the eye-faculty is arising, will the femininity-faculty arise for them?
For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere...
For those persons who will attain final Nibbāna, and for those men who will attain final Nibbāna after manifesting only a few more existences in that same state,
the eye faculty arises at the moment of rebirth, but the female faculty will not arise for them.
For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty arises and the female faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the femininity faculty will arise, does the eye faculty arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the femininity faculty will arise, but the eye faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn who possess eyes, both the femininity faculty and...
The eye faculty will arise and the eye faculty is arising.
For whom the eye faculty is arising, will the masculinity faculty arise for them? (The same as above.
For whom the eye faculty is arising, will the life faculty arise for them?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the eye faculty arises,
but the life faculty will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes,
both the eye faculty arises and the life faculty will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise, does the eye-faculty arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without the eye-faculty, the life-faculty will arise, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with the eye-faculty, both the life-faculty and...
Will the faculty of eye arise for that person? For whom the faculty of eye arises, will the faculty of mental joy arise for them?
For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those possessing eyes who are reborn with equanimity...
For those who will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the eye faculty arises,
but the mental joy faculty will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty arises and the mental joy faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will arise, does the eye-faculty (cakkhundriya) arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the faculty of mental joy will arise, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with eyes, both the faculty of mental joy and...
The eye faculty will arise and the eye faculty is arising.
For whom the eye faculty is arising, will the equanimity faculty arise for them?
For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those possessing eyes who are being reborn with mental joy.
For those who will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the eye faculty arises,
but the equanimity faculty will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty arises and the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or again, for whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will arise, does the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the equanimity faculty will arise, but the eye faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with eyes, both the equanimity faculty and...
Will the eye faculty arise for that person? For whom the eye faculty arises, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for them?
For those beings who are final-existence individuals (*pacchimabhavika*) being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the eye faculty arises, but [the other faculties do not].
And for them, the mind faculty will arise. For those others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty arises and the mind faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise, does the eye faculty arise for that person?
For all those passing away who are without the eye-faculty and for those being reborn [in a realm] without the eye-faculty, the mind-faculty will arise, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them.
For those being reborn with the eye-faculty, both the mind-faculty will arise and the eye-faculty arises. (Based on the eye-faculty.)
For whom nose-faculty arises, will femininity-faculty arise for them?
For those entering the womb of the final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
will attain final nibbāna there, and for those males who, after experiencing a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final nibbāna.
For those beings who are being reborn, the nose faculty arises, but the female faculty will not arise for them.
For others who are being reborn with a nose, both the nose faculty arises and the female faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the female faculty will arise, does the nose faculty arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the female faculty will arise,
but the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a nose, both the female faculty will arise and the nose faculty arises.
For whom nose-faculty arises, will masculinity-faculty arise for them?
For those entering existence in the sense-sphere plane as final-existence beings, for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial planes,
will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who, after experiencing only a few more existences in this very female state, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those beings being reborn [in the sense-sphere], the nose-faculty arises, but the male-faculty will not arise for them.
For others who are being reborn with a nose, both the nose-faculty arises and the male-faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the male-faculty will arise, does the nose-faculty arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the male faculty will arise, but the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a nose,
both the male faculty will arise and the nose faculty arises.
For whom the nose-faculty arises, will the life-faculty arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-faculty arises, but the life-faculty will not arise for them.
For others who are being reborn with a nose, both the nose-faculty and...
Does the life-faculty arise for that person, and will it also arise? Or conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise, does the nose-faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the life-faculty will arise.
And yet, the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with a nose, both the life faculty will arise and the nose faculty arises.
For one in whom the nose faculty arises, will the mental joy faculty arise?
For those undergoing final existence in the sense sphere who are being reborn, and for those possessing a nose who will be reborn with equanimity and attain final nibbāna there,
at the moment of rebirth the nose faculty arises, but the mental joy faculty will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn possessing a nose, both the nose faculty and...

Does the nose faculty arise for that person for whom the mental joy faculty will arise? For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without the nose faculty, the mental joy faculty will arise.
And yet, the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a nose faculty, both the mental joy faculty will arise and the nose faculty arises.
For one in whom the nose faculty arises, will the equanimity faculty arise?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those possessing a nose who,
having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna— while they are being reborn, the nose-faculty arises,
but the equanimity-faculty will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn possessing a nose, both the nose-faculty and...

Does the nose faculty arise for that person for whom the equanimity faculty will arise? For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the equanimity faculty will arise.
And yet, the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with a nose, both the equanimity faculty will arise and the nose faculty arises.
For one in whom the nose faculty arises, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise?
For those who are destined for their final existence and are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the nose faculty arises,
but the mind faculty will not arise for them. For others who possess a nose and are being reborn,
both the nose faculty arises and the mind faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, does the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the mind-faculty will arise, but the nose-faculty does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a nose, both the mind-faculty and...
The nose faculty will arise and the nose faculty is arising. (Based on the nose faculty.
For whom the female faculty arises, will the male faculty arise for them?
For women in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those women [bound for] the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere...

For those women who, having been reborn, will attain final nibbāna, and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna— at the moment of their rebirth,
the female faculty arises in them, but the male faculty will not arise in them. For other women at the moment of their rebirth, both the female faculty and...
Does the female faculty arise for that person, and will the male faculty also arise? Or conversely, for whomsoever the male faculty will arise, does the female faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away, and for women being reborn, the male faculty will arise.
And yet, the female faculty does not arise for them. For those females who are being reborn, both the male faculty will arise and the female faculty arises.
For one in whom the female faculty arises, will the life faculty arise?
For those women who are in their final existence and are being reborn, the femininity faculty arises,
but the life faculty will not arise for them. For other women who are being reborn, both the femininity faculty arises and the life faculty will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will arise, does the female faculty (*itthindriya*) arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those females being reborn, the life-faculty will arise, but the female faculty does not arise for them.
For those females being reborn, both the life-faculty and...
Will the femininity faculty arise for that person? For one in whom the femininity faculty arises, will the joy faculty arise?
[Answer: For women in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those women who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those females who are being reborn, the female faculty arises, but the mental joy faculty will not arise for them.
For other females who are being reborn, both the female faculty arises and the mental joy faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will arise, does the female faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away, and for those being reborn who are not females, the faculty of mental joy will arise,
but the female faculty does not arise for them. For those females being reborn, both the faculty of mental joy and the female faculty will arise.
For whom the femininity faculty arises, will the equanimity faculty arise for them?
For women in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those women who, having been reborn with mental joy,
will attain final Nibbāna— at the moment they are being reborn, the femininity faculty arises for them, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them.
The equanimity faculty will arise. For those other women who are being reborn, both the femininity faculty arises and the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise, does the femininity faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away, and for those being reborn who are not females, the equanimity faculty will arise,
but the female faculty does not arise for them. For those females being reborn, both the equanimity faculty will arise and the female faculty arises.
For whom the femininity faculty arises, will the faith faculty …pe… the understanding faculty …pe… the mind faculty arise for them?
For women in their final existence who are being reborn, the femininity faculty arises, but the mind faculty will not arise for them.
For other women who are being reborn, both the femininity faculty and [the other faculties] arise.
The mind-faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will arise, does the femininity-faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those women being reborn, the mind-faculty will arise, but [the femininity-faculty does not].
And the femininity faculty arises for them. For those females who are being reborn, both the mind faculty will arise and the femininity faculty arises. (Based on the femininity faculty.
For whom the masculinity faculty arises, will the life faculty arise for them?
For those males who are to undergo their final existence at the moment of rebirth, the male faculty arises,
but the life faculty will not arise for them. For other males undergoing rebirth, both the male faculty and the life faculty will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise, does the masculinity-faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those men being reborn, the life-faculty will arise, but the masculinity-faculty does not arise for them. For those men being reborn, both the life-faculty and...
[For whom] the masculinity faculty arises, will the joy faculty arise for them?

For men in their final existence at the moment of rebirth, and for those men who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna— [for these, the masculinity faculty arises, but the joy faculty will not arise].

For those who are being reborn as males, the masculinity faculty arises, but the joy faculty will not arise for them. For other males who are being reborn, both the masculinity faculty arises and the joy faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the joy faculty will arise, does the masculinity faculty arise for that person?
For all those passing away who are not males being reborn, the faculty of mental joy will arise,
but the male faculty does not arise for them. For males being reborn, both the faculty of mental joy will arise and the male faculty arises.
For whom the masculinity faculty arises, will the equanimity faculty arise for them?
For men in their final existence at the moment of rebirth, and for those men who, having been reborn with mental joy,
will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth— the masculinity faculty arises for them, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them.
The equanimity faculty will arise. For those other males who are being reborn, both the masculinity faculty arises and the equanimity faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise, does the masculinity faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away, and for those males being reborn, the equanimity faculty will arise,
but the male faculty does not arise for them. For those males being reborn, both the equanimity faculty will arise and the male faculty arises.
For whom the male faculty arises, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise for them?
For men who are final-existence beings at the moment of rebirth-linking, the male faculty arises, but the mind faculty will not arise for them.
For other men at the moment of rebirth-linking, both the male faculty and [the mind faculty arise].
Does the mind faculty arise for that person, and will the masculinity faculty also arise? Or, conversely, for whomsoever the masculinity faculty will arise, does the mind faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for all males being reborn, the mind faculty will arise, but [the masculinity faculty does not necessarily arise].
And the male faculty arises in them. In males who are being reborn, both the mind faculty will arise and the male faculty arises. (Based on the male faculty.
For whom the life faculty arises, will the mental joy faculty arise in them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, and at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise,

the life-faculty arises for them, but the joy-faculty will not arise for them. [This is so] for others who are being reborn, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of consciousness.
In those persons, both the life-faculty arises and the mental joy-faculty will arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mental joy-faculty will arise, does the life-faculty arise in them?
In all those passing away, and at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence, the mental joy-faculty will arise.

And yet, the life-faculty does not arise for them. For all those who are being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness, both the joy-faculty will arise and the life-faculty arises.
For one in whom the life-faculty arises, will the equanimity-faculty arise?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, and at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise,

the life-faculty arises for them, but the equanimity-faculty will not arise for them. For others, it is at the moment of rebirth and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of consciousness.
For those persons, both the life-faculty arises and the equanimity-faculty will arise.
Or rather, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty will arise, does the life-faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away, and at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness during the course of existence, the equanimity-faculty will arise for them.

And yet, the life-faculty does not arise for them. For all those who are being reborn, and during the phase of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence, both the equanimity faculty and the life-faculty will arise.
For one in whom the life-faculty arises, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the life faculty arises for them, but the mind faculty will not arise for them.
For others at the moment of rebirth-linking and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of consciousness,
both the life faculty arises and the mind faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise, does the life faculty arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those in the process of existence at the moment of the cessation of consciousness, the mind faculty will arise, but the life faculty does not arise for them.
For all those being reborn and for those in the process of existence at the moment of the arising of consciousness...
For them, the mind-faculty will arise and the life-faculty is arising. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whom the joy-faculty arises, for that person will the equanimity-faculty arise?
At the moment of the arising of the final consciousness associated with joy, and for that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with joy [arises]...
At the moment of arising of that consciousness, the faculty of mental joy arises for them,

but the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them. For others who are reborn with mental joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy,
both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of equanimity arise.
Or again, for whom the equanimity faculty will arise, does the joy faculty arise for them?
For all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness dissociated from joy,
and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings— the equanimity faculty will arise for them, but the joy faculty does not arise for them.
For those being reborn with mental joy, at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy during the course of existence,
both the faculty of equanimity will arise and the faculty of mental joy arises.
For one in whom the faculty of mental joy arises, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arise?
At the moment of the arising of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, the faculty of mental joy arises for them,

but the faculty of mind will not arise for them. For others who are being reborn with mental joy, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy, both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of mind will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, does the joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) arise for them?
For all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from joy,
and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings— the mind faculty will arise for them, but the joy faculty does not arise for them.

For those being reborn with mental joy, at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy during the course of existence, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise and the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) arises. (Based on the mental joy faculty.

For whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arises, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) ... pe ... the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) ... pe ... the mind faculty (*manindriya*) arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, the faculty of equanimity arises for them,
but the mind-faculty will not arise for them. For others— those being reborn with equanimity and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity—
the faculty of equanimity arises and the mind-faculty will also arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, does the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise for them?
For all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity,
and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings— the mind faculty will arise, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them.

For those being reborn with equanimity, at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity during the course of existence, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise and the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arises. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whom the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) arises, does the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) ... [and so on] ... the mind faculty arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the faculty of faith arises for them, but the mental faculty will not arise for them.
For others who are born with roots, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with faith,
both the faculty of faith and the mental faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise, does the faith faculty arise for them?
For all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith,
and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings— the mind faculty will arise for them, but the faith faculty does not arise for them.

For those being reborn with roots and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith, the mind faculty will arise and the faith faculty also arises. (Based on the faith faculty.
For whom the wisdom faculty arises, will the mind faculty arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the faculty of wisdom arises for them, but the faculty of mind will not arise for them.
For others who are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge,
both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of mind will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, does the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arise for them?
For all those at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness dissociated from knowledge,
and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings— the mind faculty will arise, but the wisdom faculty does not arise for them.

For those who are being reborn associated with knowledge, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge, the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise and the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) arises. (Based on the wisdom faculty. 10.2.1.5.2.
Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa)
Where the eye-faculty arises, will the ear-faculty arise there?
…pe… 10.2.1.5.3. Positive Person-Location (Anulomapuggalokāsa):
For whom, where the eye-faculty arises, will the ear-faculty arise there?
For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm as beings in their final existence, the eye faculty arises there,
but the ear faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are attaining rebirth with eyes,
both the eye faculty arises there and the ear faculty will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the ear faculty will arise at a certain place, does the eye faculty arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, the ear faculty will arise there, but the eye faculty does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those being reborn who possess eyes.
In those [beings], both the ear faculty will arise and the eye faculty arises there.
For whom the eye faculty arises there, will the nose faculty arise there for them?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) and for those being reborn in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), [the nose faculty will not arise] there.

The eye-faculty arises, but the nose-faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm possessing eyes, both the eye-faculty arises and the nose-faculty will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-faculty will arise there, does the eye-faculty arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without the eye-faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm,

the nose-faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty does not arise there for them. For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who possess the eye-faculty, both the nose-faculty and the eye-faculty will arise there for them.
For whom and in what [state] the eye-faculty arises, for them will the female-faculty arise there?
For those entering existence in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm, for those entering existence in the fine-material-sphere realm, and for those men who,
having manifested only a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final Nibbāna— upon their entering existence, [the female-faculty will not arise].
In that case, the eye faculty arises, but the female faculty will not arise for them there.
For others who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) possessing eyes, both the eye faculty and the female faculty arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the female faculty will arise there, does the eye faculty arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without the eye-faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm,

the female faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who possess the eye-faculty, both the female faculty and the eye-faculty will arise there.
For whom, wherever the eye-faculty arises, will the male-faculty arise there?
For those entering the final existence in the sense-sphere realm, for those entering the fine-material-sphere realm, and for those women who,
having manifested only a few more existences in that very state, will attain final nibbāna— when they are being reborn, for them...
In that case, the eye-faculty arises, but the male-faculty will not arise for them there.
For others who are possessed of eyes and are being reborn in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the eye-faculty arises and the male-faculty will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the male-faculty will arise in a certain place, does the eye-faculty arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without the eye-faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm,

the male faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who possess the eye-faculty, both the male faculty and the eye-faculty will arise there.
For whom and where the eye-faculty arises, for them will the life-faculty arise there?

For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-faculty arises there, but the life-faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are being reborn with eyes...
In those [beings], both the eye faculty arises and the life faculty will arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the life faculty will arise there, does the eye faculty arise for them there?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the life faculty will arise there.
And yet, the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with eyes, the life-faculty will arise and the eye-faculty also arises there.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty arises there, will the faculty of mental joy arise for him there?

For those destined for their final existence who are reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those possessing eye-faculty who will be reborn with equanimity and subsequently attain final Nibbāna— at the moment of their rebirth, the eye-faculty arises in them there,
but the faculty of mental joy will not arise in them there. [This is] for others who possess eye-faculty and are being reborn.
In those cases, both the eye faculty arises there and the mental joy faculty will arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will arise in a certain place, does the eye faculty arise there for them?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane who are not to obtain the eye faculty, the mental joy faculty [will arise] there.
[Will] the faculty of mental joy arise for them there, but the faculty of the eye does not arise for them there?
For those who are being reborn with eyes, the faculty of mental joy will arise and the faculty of the eye also arises there.
For whomsoever the faculty of the eye arises there, will the faculty of equanimity arise for him there?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those possessing eye-faculty who, having been reborn with mental joy,
will attain final Nibbāna— while they are being reborn, the eye-faculty arises in them there,
but the equanimity-faculty will not arise in them there. For others who are being reborn possessing eye-faculty...
In that case, for whom the eye-faculty arises, will the equanimity-faculty also arise?
Or conversely, for whom the equanimity-faculty will arise in a certain place, does the eye-faculty arise there for them?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere without eye-faculty, and for those in the formless realm—for these, the eye-faculty does not arise there.
The faculty of equanimity will arise, but the faculty of eye does not arise for them there.
For those who are being reborn with eyes, the faculty of equanimity will arise and the faculty of eye also arises there.
For whomsoever the faculty of eye arises there, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arise for them there?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the eye faculty arises there,
but the mind faculty will not arise there for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye faculty and the mind faculty arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise at a certain place, does the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*) who are without eyes, and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*), the mind-faculty will arise there, but the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those with eyes.
For those being reborn there, the mind-faculty will arise and the eye-faculty also arises. (Based on the eye-faculty.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty arises there, will the female-faculty arise for them there?
For those final-existence beings being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those men who, by that very state...
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being shown existence, the nose faculty arises at the moment of rebirth,
but the female faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are reborn with a nose, both the nose faculty and the female faculty arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the female faculty (*itthindriya*) will arise at a certain place, does the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*) who are without the nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without the nose—the female faculty will arise for them there, but the nose faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn with the nose...
For them, the femininity faculty will arise there and the nose faculty arises there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty arises there, will the masculinity faculty arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those women who, by this very state of existence, [will attain parinibbāna] after some time...
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being shown existence [in the intermediate state], as they are being reborn there, the nose faculty arises;
yet the male faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are being reborn with a nose, both the nose faculty and the male faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will arise at a certain place, does the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*) who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose—the male faculty will arise for them there, but the nose faculty does not arise for them there. [However,] for those being reborn with a nose...
In those [beings], the male faculty will arise there and the nose faculty arises there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty arises there, will the life faculty arise for them there?
For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara), the nose faculty arises there.
And yet, the life-faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are being reborn with a nose, the nose-faculty arises and the life-faculty will also arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise there, does the nose-faculty arise for them there?

For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the life-faculty will arise there, but the nose-faculty does not arise there for them. For those being reborn with a nose,
both the life-faculty will arise there and the nose-faculty arises there.
For whom and in what [state] does the nose faculty arise, will the mental joy faculty arise for them in that same state?
For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those possessing the nose faculty who, having been reborn with equanimity,
will attain final nibbāna— while they are being reborn, the nose faculty arises in them, but the mental joy faculty will not arise.
In those [beings], the faculty of mental joy will arise there. In others who are being reborn with a nose, the faculty of the nose arises there and the faculty of mental joy will also arise.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy will arise there, does the faculty of the nose arise there for that person?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or the fine-material-sphere realm,
the faculty of mental joy will arise there, but the faculty of the nose does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn with a nose, both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of the nose will arise there.
For whomver the nose faculty arises at a certain place, will the equanimity faculty arise for them at that same place?
For those final-existence beings being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those possessing a nose who, having been reborn with mental joy,
will attain final Nibbāna— while they are being reborn, the nose faculty arises for them at that place, but [the equanimity faculty will not].
The equanimity faculty will arise in them there. In others who possess the nose-faculty at the moment of rebirth, both the nose-faculty arises and the equanimity faculty will arise there.
Or conversely, for one in whom the equanimity faculty will arise there, does the nose-faculty arise there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial realms—

the faculty of equanimity will arise there, but the faculty of the nose does not arise for them there. For those being reborn with a nose, both the faculty of equanimity and the faculty of the nose will arise there.
For whom and where the nose faculty arises, for them and there will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise?

For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere plane who are being reborn, the nose faculty arises there, but the mind faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are being reborn with a nose, [both arise].
In those cases, both the nose faculty arises and the mind faculty will arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise there, does the nose faculty arise there for them?

[It does not] for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, nor for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, nor for those of the fine-material sphere, nor for those of the immaterial sphere.
In those persons, the mind faculty will arise there, but the nose faculty does not arise there for them.
For those who are being reborn with a nose, both the mind faculty and the nose faculty will arise there for them.
(Based on the nose faculty.)
For whomsoever the femininity faculty arises in a certain place, will the masculinity faculty arise for that person in that same place?
For women in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those women who will display only a few more existences in this very state before attaining parinibbāna,
as they are being reborn, the femininity faculty arises in them in that place.
And yet, the male faculty will not arise for them there. For other women who are being reborn there, both the female faculty arises and the male faculty will arise.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the male faculty will arise there, does the female faculty arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not women, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm,
the male faculty will arise there, but the female faculty does not arise there for them. For women being reborn, both the male faculty and the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the female faculty arises at a certain place, will the life faculty arise for them at that same place?

For women who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) at the moment of rebirth-linking, the female faculty arises there, but the life faculty will not arise for them there. For other women at the moment of rebirth-linking...
In that case, does the female faculty arise and the life faculty also arise?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the life faculty will arise in a certain place, does the female faculty arise for them there?

[It is not so] for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, nor for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, nor for those of the fine-material sphere, nor for those of the immaterial sphere.
For those persons, the life-faculty will arise there, but the female faculty does not arise for them there.
For women who are being reborn, both the life-faculty and the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the female faculty arises there, will the joy-faculty arise for that person there?
For those women who are in their final existence and are being reborn, and for those women who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna— while they are being reborn,
the female faculty arises in them there, but the joy faculty will not arise in them there. For other women who are being reborn, both the female faculty and [the joy faculty] arise in them there.
...and the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will arise.
Or, in whomsoever the faculty of mental joy will arise at a certain place, does the female faculty (itthindriya) arise in that person at that place? [It does not.
For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), for females being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara).
In that case, the faculty of mental joy will arise, but the faculty of femininity does not arise for them there.
For women at the moment of rebirth, both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of femininity will arise there.
For one in whom the faculty of femininity arises in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity also arise for them in that same place?

For those women who are in their final existence and are being reborn, and for those women who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna—at the moment of their rebirth, the female faculty arises in them there, but the equanimity faculty will not arise in them there.
For other women who are being reborn... [the female faculty arises, but] the equanimity faculty will not arise in them there.
In that case, does the femininity faculty arise and the equanimity faculty also arise?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will arise at a certain place, does the femininity faculty arise for them there? [It does not.
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial realms.
For those [beings], the faculty of equanimity will arise there, but the female faculty does not arise for them there.
For women who are being reborn, the faculty of equanimity will arise and the female faculty also arises there.
For whomsoever the female faculty arises there, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arise for him there?
For women who are destined for their final existence and are being reborn there, the female faculty arises therein,
but the mind faculty will not arise for them there. For other women who are being reborn there,
both the female faculty arises and the mind faculty will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise at a certain place, does the femininity-faculty (*itthindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for non-females being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
the mind-faculty will arise there, but the femininity-faculty does not arise for them there.
In the case of females being reborn there, for them both the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise and the female-faculty (*itthindriya*) arises.
(Based on the female-faculty.
For whomsoever the male-faculty (*purisindriya*) arises there, will the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arise for them there?
For those males who are to have their final existence and are being reborn there, the male faculty arises there,
but the life faculty will not arise for them there. For other males who are being reborn there, both the male faculty and the life faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise at a certain place, does the masculinity-faculty arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, as well as for those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere—
the life-faculty will arise for them there, but the masculinity-faculty does not arise for them there.
For those males being reborn, both the life-faculty and the male-faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the male-faculty arises at a certain place, will the joy-faculty arise for him at that same place?
[Answer: For males in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those males who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those who are being reborn there, the male faculty arises, but the faculty of mental joy will not arise for them there. For other males who are being reborn there,
both the male faculty and the faculty of mental joy will arise.
Or again, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will arise at a certain place, does the faculty of masculinity (purisindriya) arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere as well as those of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara),
the faculty of mental joy will arise there, but the faculty of masculinity does not arise for them there.
For those males being reborn, the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will arise there and the male faculty (purisindriya) arises.
For one in whom the male faculty arises at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) arise for them at that same place?
[Yes,] for males in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those males who, having been reborn with mental joy...
For those who will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the male faculty arises there,
but the equanimity faculty will not arise there for them. For other males at the moment of rebirth,
both the male faculty arises there and the equanimity faculty will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will arise at a certain place, does the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for non-males being reborn into the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
