the equanimity faculty will arise there, but the masculinity faculty does not arise for them there.
For those males being reborn there, the faculty of equanimity will arise and the male faculty arises.
For one in whom the male faculty arises at a certain place, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the mental faculty arise for him at that same place?
For those males who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) being reborn there, the male faculty arises.
And yet, the mind faculty will not arise for them there. For other males who are being reborn, both the male faculty and the mind faculty arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise there, does the male faculty arise for that person there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for males being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms—
the mind faculty will arise there for them, but the male faculty does not arise there for them.
For males being reborn [in the sense-sphere realm], both the mind faculty and the male faculty will arise there for them.
[It] arises. (Based on the faculty of masculinity.
For whomsoever the life-faculty arises at a certain place, will the joy-faculty arise for that person at that same place?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, and for that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with equanimity [arises]...
At the moment of the arising of that consciousness, for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*),
the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises there, but the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise for them there.
For others— those being reborn in the fourfold or fivefold planes— at the moment of the arising of consciousness during the course of existence (*pavatta*), for them there...
Does the life-faculty arise and the mental joy-faculty also arise?
Or, conversely, in whomsoever the mental joy-faculty will arise at a certain place, does the life-faculty arise for them there?

For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent realms, and during the phase of the cessation of consciousness in the course of existence, the mental joy-faculty [will arise] for them there.
[The mental faculty] will arise, but the life-faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms,
and during the phase of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence, both the joy-faculty and the life-faculty arise for them there.
For whom and where the life-faculty arises, for that person and in that place, will the equanimity-faculty arise?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness; at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with joy will arise;
and for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings—at these persons and in this place [the equanimity-faculty will not arise].
The life-faculty arises, but the equanimity-faculty will not arise for them there. For others—
those being reborn into the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms— and during the phase of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence,
both the life-faculty and the equanimity-faculty arise there for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will arise at a certain place, does the life-faculty arise for them there?

For those passing away from the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states, and during the dissolution phase of consciousness in the course of existence, the faculty of equanimity will arise for them there, but the life-faculty does not arise for them there. [This applies to] those of the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states.
For those being reborn and for those during the arising phase of consciousness in the course of existence,
the faculty of equanimity will arise and the faculty of life also arises there.
For whomsoever the faculty of life arises there, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arise for them there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm (*asaññasatta*),
the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises there, but the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise there for them. For others— those being reborn in the four- or five-aggregate realms—
at the moment of arising of consciousness during the course of existence (*pavatta*), both the life-faculty and [the mind-faculty] arise there for them.
And the mind-faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will arise at a certain place, does the life-faculty arise for them at that place?
For those passing away from the four-aggregate or five-aggregate states, and during the dissolution-moment of consciousness in the course of existence, the mind-faculty arises for them at that place.

[The mind faculty] will arise, but the life faculty does not arise for them there. For those being reborn in the four-aggregate or five-aggregate realms, and during the phase of the arising of consciousness in the course of existence, both the mind faculty and the life faculty arise for them there. (Based on the life faculty.)
For whom, and where, the faculty of mental joy arises, will the faculty of equanimity arise for them there?

At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with mental joy; and at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise—for these, the faculty of mental joy arises there.
And the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there. For others who are reborn with mental joy,
and during the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy while in the course of existence,
both the mental joy faculty and the equanimity faculty arise for them there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will arise at a certain place, does the faculty of mental joy arise for them there?

For all beings at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy—the faculty of equanimity will arise for them there, but the faculty of mental joy does not arise for them there. [End of section on] mental joy.
For those being reborn and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with mental joy,
the faculty of equanimity will arise and the faculty of mental joy arises there.
For one in whom the faculty of mental joy arises at a certain place, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind arise there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with joy, the faculty of joy arises in them there,
but the faculty of mind will not arise in them there. In others who are being reborn with joy,
and during the course of existence at the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with joy, both the faculty of joy and...
Does the mind faculty arise, and will the mental joy faculty also arise?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise at a certain place, does the mental joy faculty arise for that person at that place?

[Answer: For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy, [the mental joy faculty does not arise] there.
The mind faculty will arise for them, but the joy faculty does not arise for them there.

For those who are reborn with joy, at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with joy during the course of existence, both the mind faculty and the joy faculty will arise for them there. (Based on the joy faculty.)
For whom and where the equanimity faculty arises, for them and there will the faith faculty ... pe ... the understanding faculty ... pe ... the mind faculty arise?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, the equanimity faculty arises for them there, but the mind faculty will not arise for them there.
For others who are being reborn with equanimity, during the course of existence...
At the moment of arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity, both the faculty of equanimity and the faculty of mind arise therein for them.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will arise therein, does the faculty of equanimity arise therein for them?

For all [beings] at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, [the faculty of mind will arise, but the faculty of equanimity does not].
The mind faculty will arise for them, but the equanimity faculty does not arise for them there.

For those being reborn with equanimity, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with equanimity, both the mind faculty and the equanimity faculty arise for them there. (Based on the equanimity faculty.)
For whom and where the faculty of faith arises, for them does the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind arise there?

At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the faculty of faith arises for them there, but the faculty of mind will not arise for them there. For others who are born with roots of goodness and during the course of existence when a consciousness associated with faith is present...
At the moment of arising, both the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) and the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) arise for them there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the faculty of mind will arise there, does the faculty of faith arise for them there?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those whose consciousness is dissociated from faith at the moment of its arising, [the faculty of mind will arise there, but the faculty of faith does not].
The mind faculty will arise, but the faith faculty does not arise for them there.

For those being reborn with a root-cause, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with faith, both the mind faculty and the faith faculty will arise for them there. (Based on the faith faculty.)
For whom and where the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) arises, for them will the faculty of mind (manindriya) arise there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the faculty of wisdom arises for them there, but the faculty of mind will not arise for them there.
For others who are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and during the course of existence for those whose consciousness is associated with knowledge...
At the moment of arising, both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of mind arise for them there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will arise there, does the faculty of wisdom arise for them there?
For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those with consciousness dissociated from knowledge at the moment of its arising—the faculty of mind arises for them there.
[In some cases] the mind faculty will arise there for them, but the wisdom faculty does not arise there for them.

For those who are associated with knowledge at the moment of rebirth, and during the course of existence at the moment of the arising of a consciousness associated with knowledge, both the mind faculty and the wisdom faculty will arise there for them. (Based on the wisdom faculty.)
10.2.1.5.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the eye faculty does not arise, will the ear faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise.
And yet, the ear faculty will not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these,
neither the eye faculty arises nor will the ear faculty arise.
Or, for whom ear-faculty will not arise, for that person does eye-faculty not arise?
For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth—
for these, ear-faculty will not arise, but eye-faculty does not [fail to] arise for them.

It does not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those who will attain final Nibbāna after being reborn in the formless plane—at the moment of their death—the ear faculty will not arise and the eye faculty does not arise.
For one in whom the eye faculty does not arise, will the nose faculty not arise?
For all those passing away who are not to obtain the eye-faculty at rebirth, the eye-faculty does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the nose-faculty will not arise for them. [This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the immaterial plane, and for those passing away after having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial plane and there attaining final Nibbāna. For these, the eye-faculty does not arise... [and so on].
The eye faculty does not arise and the nose faculty will not arise.
Or, for whom the nose faculty will not arise, does the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms...
For those who will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the nose faculty will not arise,

but it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death— for these, [the nose faculty will not arise].
The nose faculty will not arise and the eye faculty does not arise.
For one for whom the eye faculty does not arise, will the female faculty not arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise.
And yet, the female faculty will not arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those men who,
after experiencing a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final Nibbāna— for these, at the moment of death, both the eye faculty and...
Does the femininity faculty not arise and will it not arise?
Or, for whom the femininity faculty will not arise, does the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn into the fine-material or immaterial realms...

For those persons who will attain final Nibbāna by that very same state after having manifested only a few more existences, the female faculty (*itthindriya*) will not arise at the moment of rebirth; yet, the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) does not fail to arise for them.

[This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), for those in their final existence in the formless realm (*arūpa*), and for those [who have reached the end] in the fine-material realm (*rūpāvacara*).

For those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn in the formless realm, and for those men who will attain final nibbāna after manifesting only a few more existences in this very state— when they are passing away,
neither the female faculty nor the eye faculty arises.

For whom the eye faculty does not arise, will the masculinity faculty not arise for them? For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise, yet it is not the case that the masculinity faculty will not arise for them.
[This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm.
And for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there; and for those women who,
after experiencing only a few more existences in this very same female state, will attain final nibbāna— for them, at the moment of death,
the eye faculty does not arise and the male faculty will not arise.
Or, for whom the masculinity faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise, does the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) not arise for them?

[It does not arise] for those undergoing final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm; for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna there;
and for those women who, after manifesting only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final nibbāna.
For those beings who are being reborn, the male faculty will not arise; yet it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them.

[This is true] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for those who will be reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms and there attain final nibbāna, and for those women who, in this very state, will undergo several more existences.
For those who will attain final Nibbāna after having been shown [the path], at the moment of their passing away,
neither the masculinity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise.
For one in whom the eye faculty does not arise, will the life faculty not arise?
For all those passing away who are not to obtain the eye-faculty at rebirth, the eye-faculty does not arise,
but it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
neither the eye-faculty nor the life-faculty will arise.
Or, for whom the life-faculty will not arise, does the eye-faculty not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the life-faculty will not arise, but the eye-faculty does not fail to arise for them.
[This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those final-existence beings in the formless realm.
For them, neither the life-faculty nor the eye-faculty will arise.
For one in whom the eye-faculty does not arise, will the faculty of mental joy not arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye-faculty does not arise.
And yet, the faculty of mental joy will not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
and for those who, having been reborn in a state of equanimity, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these,
neither the eye-faculty arises nor will the faculty of mental joy arise.
Or, for whom the faculty of mental joy will not arise, does the faculty of the eye not arise for them?

For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those with eyes who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna—while they are being reborn, the faculty of mental joy will not arise; [but the faculty of the eye does arise]. No.
And for them, the eye faculty does not arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
and for those who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final nibbāna— at the moment of their death,
neither the joy faculty nor the eye faculty arises.

For whom the eye faculty does not arise, will the equanimity faculty not arise for them? For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye faculty does not arise, yet it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them.
[This excludes] those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and those in their final existence in the formless realm.

For those who, having been reborn with the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*), will attain final nibbāna (*parinibbāyissanti*), at the moment of their death, neither the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) arises nor will the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise. Or conversely:
for whom the equanimity-faculty will not arise, does the eye-faculty not arise for them?
For those undergoing their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those possessing eye-faculty who, having been reborn with mental joy,
will attain final nibbāna— at the moment of their rebirth, the equanimity faculty will not arise for them,

but the eye-faculty does not fail to arise for them. [This is the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those undergoing their final existence in the formless realm.
And for those who, having been reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), will attain final nibbāna (*parinibbāyissanti*) at the time of their passing away,
the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise and the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) does not arise.
For one in whom the eye-faculty does not arise, will the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding-faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) not arise?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-faculty, the eye-faculty does not arise,
yet it is not the case that the mind-faculty will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
neither the eye-faculty nor the mind-faculty will arise.
Or again, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, does the eye faculty not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the mind faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them.
[It is not so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, nor for those final-existence beings in the formless realm.
For them, neither will the mind-faculty arise nor does the eye-faculty arise. (Based on the eye-faculty.
For whom the nose-faculty does not arise, will the female-faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose-faculty does not arise; [for them, the female-faculty will not arise]. No.
and the female faculty will not arise for them. [This applies to] those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm;
those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms; those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna there;
and those men who, after experiencing a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final nibbāna at the time of their death.
For them, neither the nose faculty nor the female faculty arises.
Or, for whomsoever the female faculty will not arise, does the nose faculty not arise for them?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms...
For those persons who will attain final Nibbāna and those who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna— at the moment of their rebirth-linking,
the femininity faculty will not arise for them, but the nose faculty does not fail to arise for them.

This applies to those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and to those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*).
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there, and for those men who,
after experiencing only a few more existences in that very same state, will attain final nibbāna— for them, at the moment of death,
neither the female faculty nor the nose faculty arises.
For whom the nose faculty does not arise, will the male faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose faculty does not arise, yet it is not the case that the male faculty will not arise for them.
[This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms.
For those in their final existence, for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna there, and for those women who,
after experiencing only a few more existences in that very same female state, will attain final nibbāna— for these, as they are passing away,
neither the nose faculty nor the male faculty arises.
Or conversely, for whom the male faculty will not arise, does the nose faculty not arise for them?
For those entering the womb in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm; for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there;
and for those women who, after experiencing only a few more existences in this very female state, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those beings who are being reborn there, the male faculty will not arise, but the nose faculty does not fail to arise for them.
[This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
and for those women who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna right there.
For those who will attain final nibbāna after having manifested a certain number of existences by way of rebirth, at the moment of their death,
neither the masculinity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise.
For one in whom the nose faculty does not arise, will the life faculty not arise?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the nose faculty does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, neither the nose faculty nor the life faculty will arise.
Or, for whom the life-faculty will not arise, does the nose-faculty not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings at the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, the life-faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the nose-faculty does not arise for them.
[This is also the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere, and for those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere.
For those in their final existence, the life-faculty will not arise and the nose-faculty does not arise.

For whom the nose-faculty does not arise, will the mental joy faculty not arise for them? For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose-faculty does not arise; [but it is] not [the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise].
And the faculty of mental joy will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm,
for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, and for those who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final nibbāna— when they are passing away—
the nose faculty does not arise and the faculty of mental joy will also not arise.
Or conversely, for whom the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise, does the faculty of nose (*ghānindriya*) not arise for them?

For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those who possess a nose and, having been reborn with equanimity (*upekkhā*),
will attain *parinibbāna* at the moment of rebirth— for these, the faculty of mental joy will not arise, but [the faculty of nose] does not [not arise].
And the nose faculty does not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres,
and for those who, having been reborn in a state of equanimity, will attain final nibbāna— while they are passing away—
the joy faculty will not arise and the nose faculty does not arise.
For whom the nose faculty does not arise, will the equanimity faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose faculty does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms.
For those in their final existence and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna— when they are passing away—
the nose faculty does not arise and the equanimity faculty will not arise.
Or conversely, for one in whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, does the nose faculty not arise?

For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the sense sphere, and for those who possess a nose and will attain final Nibbāna after being reborn with mental joy, at the moment of rebirth, the equanimity faculty will not arise;
yet the nose faculty does not fail to arise for them. [This is also the case] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense sphere, the fine-material sphere, and the immaterial sphere.
For those in their final existence and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final nibbāna, at the moment of death,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise.
For one in whom the nose faculty does not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?
For all those passing away who are not to be reborn with a nose, the nose faculty does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, neither the nose faculty nor the mind faculty will arise.
Or else, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, does the nose faculty not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the sense sphere, the mind faculty will not arise, but it is not the case that the nose faculty does not arise for them.
[This is also the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere.
For those in their final existence, neither the mind-faculty nor the nose-faculty will arise.
(Based on the nose-faculty.
For one in whom the female faculty does not arise, will the male faculty not arise?
For all those who are passing away and for those women being reborn, the female faculty does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the male faculty will not arise for them. [This applies to] those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, and those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there.
And for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna— when they pass away,
neither the female faculty nor the male faculty arises for them.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the male faculty will not arise, does the female faculty not arise for that person?

For those women who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavikā*) at the moment of rebirth, and for those women who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) or the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
will attain final Nibbāna there, and for those women who will attain final Nibbāna after manifesting only a few more existences in this very same female state—
at the time of their rebirth, the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise in them; yet it is not that [the female faculty does not arise].
The femininity faculty does not arise in them. [This applies to] those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere,
those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, and those women who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial sphere,
will attain final Nibbāna after manifesting only a few more existences in that very state as they pass away.
For those [beings], neither the male faculty nor the female faculty will arise.
For whom the female faculty does not arise, will the life faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for females being reborn, the female faculty does not arise; [but] for them... [the life faculty will arise].

And for them, the life-faculty will not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, neither the female faculty nor the life-faculty arises.
Or else, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise, does the female faculty not arise for them?
For women in their final existence who are being reborn, the life-faculty will not arise,
yet the female faculty does not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
neither the life-faculty nor the female faculty will arise.
For whom the femininity faculty does not arise, will the joy faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for females being reborn, the femininity faculty does not arise, yet the joy faculty will not fail to arise for them.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere...

For those in the formless realm who are in their final existence, and for those who will be reborn with equanimity and attain final Nibbāna there, at the moment of death, neither the female faculty nor the joy faculty arises. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the joy faculty will not arise, does the female faculty not arise for them?

For those women who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavikā*) at the moment of rebirth, and for those women who, having been reborn with equanimity (*upekkhā*), will attain *parinibbāna*, the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise at the moment of rebirth;
yet, the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not fail to arise for them.

This is the case for those attaining *parinibbāna* in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*).
For those who will be reborn with equanimity and will attain final Nibbāna, at the time of their death,
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the female faculty will arise.
For one in whom the female faculty does not arise, will the faculty of equanimity not arise?
For all those passing away who are not being reborn as females, the female faculty does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them. [This is true] for those passing away who are attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final nibbāna while passing away.
For them, neither the femininity faculty nor the equanimity faculty arises.
Or rather, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, does the femininity faculty not arise for them?
For women in their final existence at the moment of rebirth, and for those women who, having been reborn with mental joy...
For those who will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the equanimity faculty will not arise, but the femininity faculty does not cease for them.
This is the case for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death.
For those persons, neither the equanimity faculty nor the femininity faculty will arise.
For one in whom the femininity faculty does not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?
For all those passing away and for females being reborn, the femininity faculty does not arise; [but] it is not [the case that] for them … [the mind faculty will not arise].

And for them, the mind faculty will not arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, neither the femininity faculty nor the mind faculty will arise.
Or, conversely, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, does the femininity faculty not arise for them?
For women who are in their final existence and are being reborn, the mind-faculty will not arise,
yet the female faculty does not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
neither the mind-faculty nor the female faculty will arise.
(Based on the femininity faculty.
For whom the masculinity faculty does not arise, will the life faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for non-males being reborn, the masculinity faculty does not arise.

And yet, their life-faculty will not fail to arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, neither the masculinity faculty nor the life-faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise, does the masculinity faculty not arise for them?
For those men who are in their final existence and are being reborn, the life-faculty will not arise,

but it is not the case that the male faculty does not arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
neither the life-faculty nor the male faculty will arise.
For whom the male faculty does not arise, for them will the joy faculty not arise?
For all those passing away and for non-males being reborn, the male faculty does not arise;
yet it is not the case that the joy faculty will not arise for them. [This is also true] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere...
For those final-existence beings in the formless realm, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn with equanimity,
at the time of their death, neither the male faculty nor the joy faculty arises. Or conversely, for whomsoever the joy faculty will not arise, does the male faculty not arise for them?

For those men in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those men who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna while being reborn, the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise;
yet it is not the case that the male faculty (*purisindriya*) does not arise for them.

[This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*) who [are reborn] with equanimity...
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn, at the moment of their death,
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the male faculty will arise.
For one in whom the male faculty does not arise, will the faculty of equanimity not arise?
For all those passing away who are not men reborn [as men], the masculinity faculty does not arise;
yet it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them.

[This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those who are passing away, neither the masculinity faculty nor the equanimity faculty arises. Or, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise, does the masculinity faculty not arise for them?
For men in their final existence at the moment of rebirth, and for those men who, having been reborn with mental joy...
For those who will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the equanimity faculty will not arise;

yet it is not the case that the masculinity faculty does not arise for them. [This is true] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial realms, and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death.
For them, neither the equanimity faculty nor the masculinity faculty will arise.
For one in whom the masculinity faculty does not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?
For all those passing away and for non-masculine beings being reborn, the masculinity faculty does not arise.

And yet, the mind faculty will not fail to arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, neither the masculinity faculty nor the mind faculty arises.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise, does the masculinity faculty not arise for them?
For those men who are in their final existence and are being reborn, the mind-faculty will not arise,

but it is not the case that the masculinity faculty does not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms,
neither the mind-faculty nor the masculinity faculty will arise.
(Based on the faculty of masculinity.
For whom the life-faculty does not arise, will the mental joy-faculty not arise for them?
For all those passing away, and at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness during the course of existence, the life-faculty does not arise.
And yet, the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) will not fail to arise for them. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness,
and at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness immediately preceding the final consciousness associated with equanimity (upekkhā),
for those persons, neither the life-faculty (jīvitindriya) arises nor will the faculty of mental joy arise.
Or again, for whom the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise, does the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise for them?

At the moment of arising of the final consciousness; at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with equanimity (*upekkhā*) will arise—for those [beings], the faculty of mental joy will not arise.
And yet, the life-faculty does not fail to arise for them. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness,
and at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness immediately preceding the final consciousness associated with equanimity which is about to arise,
for those persons the faculty of mental joy will not arise and the life-faculty does not arise.
For whom the life-faculty does not arise, for that person will the equanimity-faculty not arise?

For all those passing away and for those during the course of existence at the moment of the cessation of consciousness, the life-faculty does not arise, but it is not the case that the equanimity-faculty will not arise for them. At the moment of the cessation of the final consciousness... [of] whichever consciousness...
For one in whom the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise immediately after this [present] moment, at the moment of the dissolution of that consciousness,
neither the life-faculty arises nor will the equanimity-faculty arise. Or conversely,
for one in whom the equanimity-faculty will not arise, does the life-faculty not arise?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, and at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise,

the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them, but the life-faculty does not fail to arise for them. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, and at the moment of arising of that consciousness...
In one for whom the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise immediately after this, at the moment of that consciousness's dissolution,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the life faculty will arise.
For one in whom the life faculty does not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise?
For all those who are passing away, and at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence, the life-faculty does not arise,
yet the mind-faculty will not fail to arise for them. At the moment of the cessation of the final consciousness, however,
both the life-faculty and the mind-faculty do not arise for them.
Or again, for whom the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise, does the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the mind-faculty will not arise for them, but the life-faculty does not fail to arise for them.
At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, neither the mind-faculty nor the life-faculty will arise for them.
It does not arise. (Based on the life-faculty.
For one in whom the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) does not arise, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) not arise?

[Yes] for all at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those with consciousness dissociated from mental joy at the moment of its arising, and for those who have attained cessation (*nirodhasamāpanna*).
For non-percipient beings, the faculty of mental joy does not arise, yet it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them.
At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental joy; for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity;
and for that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise—[the faculty of mental joy does not arise].
At the moment of dissolution, neither the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises for them, nor will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise.
Or conversely: for whom the faculty of equanimity will not arise, does the faculty of mental joy not arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, and for that consciousness immediately preceding the final consciousness associated with mental joy...
At the moment of arising of that consciousness, the equanimity faculty will not arise for them,
yet the joy faculty does not fail to arise for them. [This is the case] at the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness associated with joy,
for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity, and for one whose consciousness immediately following it is the final consciousness associated with joy.
At the moment of the cessation of that consciousness, neither the equanimity faculty nor the joy faculty will arise for them.
For one in whom the joy faculty does not arise, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise? [Answer:
For all at the moment of the cessation of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from joy, and for those who have attained cessation.
In non-percipient beings, the faculty of mental joy does not arise, yet it is not the case that the mind-faculty will not arise for them.
At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, and for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity,
both the faculty of mental joy and the mind-faculty will not arise.
Or again, for whom the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise, for them does the mental pleasure faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise?

At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with mental pleasure, the mind faculty will not arise for them, but the mental pleasure faculty does not fail to arise for them. [This is also the case] at the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental pleasure.

For those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity, neither the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will arise, nor does the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) arise. (Based on the mental joy faculty.

For whom the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) does not arise, for them will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) …pe… the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) …pe… the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise?

In all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings, the faculty of equanimity does not arise; yet it is not the case that the mind-faculty will not arise for them.
[This is also the case] at the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, and for those possessing the final consciousness associated with joy.
For them, neither the equanimity faculty nor the mind faculty arises.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise, does the equanimity faculty not arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, for those [beings], the mind faculty will not arise.

And yet, the equanimity faculty does not fail to arise for them. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, and for those possessing the final consciousness associated with joy, neither the mind faculty will arise nor does the equanimity faculty arise.
(Based on the equanimity faculty.)
For whom the faculty of faith does not arise, for them the faculty of wisdom … pe … will the faculty of mind not arise?
For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith,
and for those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings— the faculty of faith does not arise for them, but it is not the case that the faculty of mind will not arise for them.
At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness, the faculty of faith does not arise and the faculty of mind will also not arise.
Or, for whom the faculty of mind will not arise, does the faculty of faith not arise for them?
At the moment of the arising of the final consciousness, the faculty of mind will not arise for them, but it is not the case that the faculty of faith does not arise for them.

It does not arise. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for those persons, both the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise and the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) does not arise. (Based on the faith faculty.
For whom the wisdom faculty (*paññindriya*) does not arise, will the mind faculty not arise for them?

In all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, in those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge, and in those who have attained cessation or are non-percipient beings, the faculty of wisdom does not arise; yet it is not the case that the faculty of mind will not arise for them.
At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness, however, for them both the faculty of wisdom and the faculty of mind will not arise.
Or again, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, does the wisdom faculty not arise for them?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the mind faculty will not arise for them, but the wisdom faculty does not fail to arise for them.
At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, neither the mind faculty nor the wisdom faculty will arise for them.
It does not arise. (Based on the faculty of wisdom. 10.2.1.5.5.
