10.2.1.5.6. Negative Person and Plane (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa) For whom, where the eye-faculty does not arise, will the ear-faculty not arise there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are not to obtain the eye-faculty, the eye-faculty [does not arise] there.

It does not arise for them there, yet the ear faculty will not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the eye faculty nor the ear faculty arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the ear faculty will not arise there, for that person does the eye faculty not arise there?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the ear faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm,
for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the ear faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
For whom the eye-faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the nose-faculty not arise for them at that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, the eye-faculty does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the nose-faculty will not arise for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna (parinibbāna) in the sense-sphere.

For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, the eye faculty does not arise there, and the nose faculty will also not arise. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the nose faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the eye faculty not arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) and those being reborn in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the nose-faculty (ghānindriya) will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the eye-faculty (cakkhundriya) does not arise for them there.

For those attaining final nibbāna (parinibbāna) in the sense-sphere realm, for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta) and those in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), the nose-faculty [will not arise] there...
The eye faculty will not arise and the eye faculty does not arise.
For whom, where the eye faculty does not arise, will the femininity faculty not arise there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes—the eye faculty [does not arise] there for them.
It does not arise, yet for them the femininity faculty will not fail to arise there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere,

for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, for those in the immaterial sphere, and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in that very state,
will attain final nibbāna— for these at the moment of death, the eye faculty does not [arise] there.

Does the eye faculty not arise for that person at that plane where the female faculty will not arise? Or conversely, for whomsoever the female faculty will not arise at a certain plane, does the eye faculty not arise for them at that plane? [It does not.

For those attaining rebirth in the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*) as final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*), for those attaining rebirth in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), and for those men...
Having manifested a few more existences by this very state, they will attain final Nibbāna;
for those who are being reborn there, the femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) will not arise, but the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) does not fail to arise for them there.

[This is the case] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), for those passing away from the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*), and for those men...
Having shown a few existences by this very state, they will attain final Nibbāna;
for those passing away from there, neither the femininity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise.
For one in whom the eye faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the masculinity faculty not arise in that person in that place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without the eye-faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the eye-faculty does not arise there; yet it is not the case that the male-faculty will not arise for them there.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, for those in the immaterial realm, and for those women who, in this very state, [pass away] after some time...
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being shown existence [in the intermediate state], as they pass away, neither the eye-faculty nor the masculinity faculty arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the masculinity faculty will not arise there, does the eye-faculty not arise there for them?
For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for those being reborn in the fine-material-sphere realm,
and for those women who will display a few more existences in that very same female state before attaining final Nibbāna— at the moment of their rebirth-linking,
the male faculty (purisindriya) will not arise therein; yet it is not the case that the eye-faculty (cakkhundriya) does not arise for them therein.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, for those in the immaterial sphere,
and for those women who will pass away after having manifested only a few more existences in that very female state— for all these at the moment of death,
neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty arises therein.
For whom the eye-faculty does not arise at a certain place, for that person will the life-faculty not arise at that place?
For all those who are passing away, and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye-faculty does not arise at that place;
yet it is not the case that the life-faculty will not arise for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm.
For those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), neither the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) nor the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the eye-faculty not arise for them there?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), the life-faculty will not arise there.

And yet, the eye-faculty does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the life-faculty nor the eye-faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the eye-faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the joy-faculty not arise for them at that same place?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without eye-faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane, the eye-faculty does not arise there; yet it is not the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise for them there.

[This is also the case] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for non-percipient beings, for those in the formless plane, and for those with eye-faculty who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those passing away from there, neither the eye-faculty nor the faculty of mental joy arises at that place.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy will not arise at a certain place, does the eye-faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those undergoing their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those with eyes who are reborn with equanimity—
For those who will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) does not arise for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm,
for non-percipient beings, for those in the formless realm, and for those with eyes who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death.
For them, neither the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will arise there, nor does the faculty of eye (*cakkhundriya*) arise there.
For whomsoever the faculty of eye does not arise there, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) not arise for them there? [It will not.

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) who are without eyes, and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*), for them there...
The eye faculty does not arise for them, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their last existence in the formless realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those possessing the eye faculty who,
having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these, the eye faculty does not arise there.
And the faculty of equanimity will not arise.
Or rather: for whom, wherever the faculty of equanimity will not arise, does the eye-faculty not arise there?
For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those with eyes who, having been reborn, possess mental joy.
For those who will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the equanimity faculty will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the eye faculty does not arise for them there.

[This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those possessing the eye faculty who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those passing away from there, neither the equanimity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise.
For whomsoever the eye faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them in that same place?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those non-percipient beings—in these cases, [the faculties do not arise].
The eye faculty does not arise for them there, but it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm,
for those in their last existence in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the eye faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, does the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) not arise for them there?
For those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), the mind-faculty will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the eye-faculty does not arise for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*).
For those beings in their final existence who are non-percipient beings, neither the mind-faculty nor the eye-faculty will arise there. (Based on the eye-faculty.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the female-faculty not arise for them at that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the female-faculty (*itthindriya*) will not arise for them there.

[This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), for those of the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those passing away from there, neither the nose-faculty nor the female-faculty arises at that place. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the female-faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the nose-faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those men who, by this very state [of existence], [will pass away...]
For those who will attain final nibbāna after having manifested [only] a few more existences, at the moment of their rebirth there, the femininity faculty will not arise;
yet, for them, the nose faculty does not fail to arise there.

This applies to those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara), to those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), to those in the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), and to those men who will attain final nibbāna after having manifested only a few more existences in that very same state.
For those passing away from there, neither the femininity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise.
For whomsoever the nose faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the masculinity faculty not arise for them in that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, the nose faculty does not arise in that place.
It does not arise, yet for them the masculinity faculty will not fail to arise there.

For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in the fine-material sphere, for those in the immaterial sphere, and for those women who, having appeared for some births in that very state,
will attain final nibbāna— when they are passing away— the nose faculty does not arise there, and the masculinity faculty will also not arise.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the masculinity faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the nose faculty not arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those women who, having appeared in this very state for a few more existences, will attain final nibbāna from that state—when they are being reborn—the masculinity faculty [will not arise] for them there.
It will not arise, yet for them the nose-faculty does not cease there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere, for those in the fine-material sphere,
for those in the immaterial sphere, and for those women who, having appeared for some births in this very state,
will attain final nibbāna— when they are passing away, for them neither the male faculty nor the nose-faculty ceases there.
For whom and where the nose faculty does not arise, for them and there will the life faculty not arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose faculty does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) and for those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara).
For those in the final existence in the formless realm (*arūpāvacara*), neither the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) nor the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arises there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the life faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the nose faculty not arise for them there?
For those in the final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), the life faculty will not arise there.

And yet, the nose-faculty does not arise there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara), and for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) or immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), neither the life-faculty nor the nose-faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) not arise for that person in that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, and for those of the fine-material sphere—the nose faculty does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise for them there.

[This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial realm.
For those who will be reborn in a state of equanimity and will attain final Nibbāna there, at the moment of death, neither the nose faculty nor the mental joy faculty arises in them. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the nose faculty not arise in them in that place?

For those undergoing their final existence who are being reborn in the sense sphere, and for those who possess a nose and are reborn with equanimity and will attain *parinibbāna* there, at the moment of rebirth the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise;

yet, the faculty of the nose (*ghānindriya*) does not fail to arise for them there. [This is also the case] for those attaining *parinibbāna* in the sense sphere and for those in the fine-material sphere...
For those beings in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, for those in the formless realm, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn with equanimity—
at the moment of their death, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of nose-sensitivity will arise there.
For one in whom the faculty of nose-sensitivity does not arise at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for them at that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) who are without a nose, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the nose-faculty does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the equanimity-faculty (upekkhindriya) will not arise for them there.

[This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna (parinibbāna) in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial spheres, and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta).

For those who, having been reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), will attain final Nibbāna, at the moment of their death, neither the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) arises there, nor will the equanimity-faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arise. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the nose-faculty not arise for them there?

For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those who possess a nose and will attain final Nibbāna after being reborn with mental joy—for them, at the moment of rebirth, the equanimity faculty will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the nose faculty does not arise there for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and those in the fine-material sphere...
For those in the formless realm who are in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn with mental joy—
at the moment of their death, neither the equanimity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise therein.
For one in whom the nose faculty does not arise therein, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise therein?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) who are without a nose, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the nose-faculty (*ghānindriya*) does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise for them there.

[This is also the case] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial spheres, and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*).
In those [beings], neither the nose faculty nor the mind faculty arises there.
Or, conversely, for whom the mind faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the nose faculty not arise there for them?
For those who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) possessing a nose and who are being reborn, the mind faculty will not arise there.

And yet, the nose-faculty does not fail to arise there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, and for non-percipient beings, neither will the mind-faculty arise nor will the nose-faculty arise there. (Based on the nose-faculty.)
For whom the female faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the male faculty not arise for them in that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the female faculty does not arise there;
yet, for them, the male faculty will not fail to arise there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm.

For those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, and for those women who will pass away after manifesting only a few more existences in that very state, at the moment of death, neither the female faculty nor the male faculty arises therein. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the male faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the female faculty not arise for them there?
For women who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavikā*) at the moment of rebirth, and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in this very state,
will attain final nibbāna— when they are being reborn, the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise there,

but the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not fail to arise there. [This is the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*).
For those in the formless realm and for those women who, having manifested only a few more existences in that very state, will attain final Nibbāna— when they are passing away,
neither the masculinity faculty nor the femininity faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the life faculty not arise for them in that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), for females being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not arise there;
yet, it is not the case that the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will not arise for them there.

For those attaining final nibbāna (*parinibbāna*) in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) in the fine-material and immaterial spheres, [the female faculty does not arise] there.
The femininity faculty does not arise and the life faculty will not arise.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the life faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the femininity faculty not arise there for them?
For women in their final existence who are being reborn, the life faculty will not arise there for them.

And yet, the female faculty does not arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, neither the life faculty nor the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the female faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the joy faculty not arise for that person in that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), for women being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) will not arise for them there.

[This is true] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere, and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*) and those of the immaterial realm (*arūpa*).
For those women who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna, at the time of their death,
neither the female faculty nor the joy faculty arises there. Or conversely,
for whomsoever the joy faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the female faculty not arise for them there?

For those women who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavikā*) at the moment of rebirth, and for those women who, having been reborn with equanimity (*upekkhā*), will attain *parinibbāna*, the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise at that time upon rebirth; yet, the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is so] for those attaining *parinibbāna* in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) and for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*).
For non-percipient beings, for those in the formless realm, and for those women who will be reborn with equanimity and attain final nibbāna there—
when they are passing away, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the female faculty will arise for them.
For one in whom the female faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for that person in that same place?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, for females being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms, the female faculty does not arise there;
yet, it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there.
[This is true] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial realms, and for non-percipient beings.

For those women who, having been reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*), will attain final Nibbāna, at the moment of their death, neither the female faculty (*itthindriya*) nor the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the female faculty not arise there for them?
For those women who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavikā*) at the moment of rebirth, and for those women who, having been reborn with mental joy (*somanassa*),
will attain final Nibbāna— while they are being reborn, the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise therein,

yet the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not fail to arise therein. [This is also the case] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) and the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*).
For those final-existence beings in the formless realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those women who, having been reborn with mental joy,
will attain final nibbāna— when they are passing away, neither the equanimity faculty nor the femininity faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not females, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the fine-material-sphere realm, or the immaterial-sphere realm—
the femininity faculty does not arise for them at that place, yet it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the femininity faculty nor the mind faculty arises there. Or conversely,
for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise in a certain place, does the femininity faculty not arise for them there?
For those women who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) at the moment of rebirth, the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise there,
but the female faculty (*itthindriya*) does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*),

and for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) or the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), as well as for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the mind-faculty nor the female faculty will arise there.
And the female faculty does not arise. (Based on the female faculty.
For whom, where the male faculty does not arise, will the life faculty not arise there?
[It is so] for those passing away from the sense-sphere who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, the fine-material sphere, or the immaterial sphere.
In those cases, the male faculty does not arise there, but it is not that the life faculty will not arise for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres,
neither the male faculty nor the life faculty will arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the masculinity-faculty not arise for them there?
For men who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) at the moment of rebirth, the life-faculty will not arise there, yet the masculinity-faculty does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is also the case] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara) and in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara).
For those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the life-faculty nor the masculinity faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the masculinity faculty does not arise in a certain place, will the joy-faculty not arise for them in that same place? [It will not.
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm or the fine-material realm.
In that case, the male faculty does not arise, yet it is not the case that the mental joy faculty will not arise for them there.

This is true for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, for those in the immaterial sphere, and for those males who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death. For these, the male faculty does not arise there.
The male faculty does not arise and the mental joy faculty will also not arise.
Or conversely, in whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the male faculty not arise for that person at that place?
[It does not. For men in their final existence at the moment of rebirth, and for those men who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those beings being reborn there, the faculty of mental joy will not arise; yet it is not the case that the male faculty does not arise for them there.

This is true for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara), for those in their final existence in the fine-material realm (rūpāvacara), for non-percipient beings, for those in the immaterial realm (arūpa), and for those males who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final nibbāna.
For those passing away from there, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of masculinity will arise.
For whomsoever the faculty of masculinity does not arise in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for them in that same place? [It will not.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), or the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara).
In those persons, the male faculty does not arise there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there.

[This is true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (kāmāvacara), for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) or the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), for non-percipient beings, and for those males who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death. For these persons, in that state:
The male faculty does not arise and the equanimity faculty will also not arise.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the male faculty not arise for that person at that place?
[It is so] for men in their final existence who are currently arising, and for those men who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those beings who are being reborn there, the equanimity faculty will not arise; yet it is not the case that the masculinity faculty does not arise for them there.

This is true for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms (*rūpāvacara* and *arūpāvacara*), for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), and for those males who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death.
In those cases, neither the equanimity faculty nor the masculinity faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the masculinity faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them at that place?
[It is so] for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not males, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the fine-material-sphere realm, or the immaterial-sphere realm.
In those cases, the male faculty does not arise there, but it is not that the mind faculty will not arise for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the male faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, does the masculinity-faculty (*purisindriya*) not arise for them there?
For men who are final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) at the moment of rebirth, the mind-faculty will not arise there, yet the masculinity-faculty does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is also the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*).

For those in the formless realm who are in their final existence and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind faculty nor the masculinity faculty will arise there. (Based on the masculinity faculty.
For whomsoever the life faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the joy faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those passing away from the four-constituent or five-constituent realms at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness during the course of existence, the life-faculty does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the faculty of mental joy will not arise for them there.
[This applies] at the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness, or for one whose final consciousness immediately following that [dissolution] will be associated with equanimity.
At the moment of the dissolution of that consciousness, for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, neither the life-faculty nor the joy-faculty arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the joy-faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the life-faculty not arise for them there?

At the moment of the arising of the final consciousness, and at the moment of the arising of that consciousness immediately preceding the final consciousness associated with equanimity which is about to arise, and for those beings born in the non-percipient realm— at these times,
the faculty of mental joy will not arise there, but it is not the case that the life-faculty does not arise there for them.
At the moment of the cessation of the final consciousness, at the moment of the cessation of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise,
and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings— at these times, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the life-faculty will arise there.
For whom and where the life-faculty does not arise, for them and there will the equanimity-faculty not arise?
For those passing away from the four- or five-aggregate planes, at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence, the life-faculty does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that for them the equanimity-faculty will not arise there. [This is so] for the final consciousness...
At the moment of dissolution of that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with joy will arise,
and at the moment of death of non-percipient beings— therein,
neither the life-faculty arises nor will the equanimity-faculty arise.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, does the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise for them there? [It does not.
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness; at the moment of arising of that consciousness immediately preceding the final consciousness associated with joy;
and for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings—at these times, for them, [the life faculty does not cease].
The equanimity faculty will not arise, but the life faculty does not fail to arise for them there.
At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, at the moment of dissolution of that consciousness after which the final consciousness associated with joy will arise,
and for those passing away from the plane of non-percipient beings— the equanimity faculty [will not arise] for them there.
The life-faculty will not arise and the life-faculty does not arise.
For whom, where the life-faculty does not arise, will the faith-faculty … pe … wisdom-faculty … pe … mind-faculty not arise there?
For those passing away from the four- or five-aggregate planes, at the moment of the cessation of consciousness during the course of existence, for them there the life-faculty [does not arise].

It does not arise, yet for those persons, the mind faculty will not fail to arise there. At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, neither the life faculty nor the mind faculty arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise there, does the life faculty not arise there for that person?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, for those being reborn in the realm of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*),
the mind faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise there, but the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) does not fail to arise for them there.
At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for those passing away from the realm of non-percipient beings, neither the mind faculty nor the life faculty will arise there.
It does not arise. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy does not arise at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for them at that same place? [Answer:
For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy—at that place for them...
The faculty of mental joy does not arise, yet it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them there.
At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental joy; for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity;
and for that consciousness immediately after which the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise.
At the moment of dissolution, for non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arises there, nor will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will not arise at a certain place, does the faculty of mental joy not arise for them there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, and for that consciousness immediately preceding the final consciousness associated with mental joy...
At the moment of arising of that consciousness, the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them there,
but the faculty of mental joy does not fail to arise for them there.

[This is the case] at the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity, and for one whose consciousness immediately following it is the final consciousness associated with mental joy.
At the moment of the cessation of that consciousness, and for those non-percipient beings,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the joy faculty will arise there.
For one in whom the joy faculty does not arise at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them at that place?

In all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from mental joy (*somanassa*), the faculty of mental joy does not arise therein;
yet it is not the case that the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) will not arise therein for them.

[This is also the case] at the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity (*upekkhā*), and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*). For these, therein—
The faculty of mental joy does not arise, and the faculty of mind will also not arise. Or conversely:
in whomsoever the faculty of mind will not arise at a certain place, in that person does the faculty of mental joy not arise at that place?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, in those persons the faculty of mind will not arise at that place.
And yet, the faculty of mental joy does not fail to arise for them there.

At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness associated with mental joy, and for those possessing the final consciousness associated with equanimity, and for non-percipient beings—the faculty of mind will not arise there, and the faculty of mental joy also does not arise. (Based on the faculty of mental joy.)

For whom and in what [state] the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) does not arise, for that person and in that state, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*), the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*), and the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, the equanimity faculty does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mind faculty will not arise for them there. [This is so] for one’s final consciousness associated with equanimity...
At the moment of dissolution, for those possessing the final consciousness associated with joy and for non-percipient beings,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the mind faculty arises there. Or conversely,
for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise at a certain place, does the equanimity faculty not arise for them there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, the mind-faculty will not arise for them there,

but the equanimity-faculty does not fail to arise for them there. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness associated with equanimity, for those possessing the final consciousness associated with joy, and for non-percipient beings, [the mind-faculty will not arise] there...
The mind faculty will not arise and the equanimity faculty does not arise. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whom, where the faith faculty does not arise, for that person there, will the understanding faculty ... pe ... the mind faculty not arise?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of the arising of a consciousness dissociated from faith—at these persons, in that place—[the faculties do not arise].
The faculty of faith does not arise for them there, but it is not the case that the faculty of mind will not arise for them there.
At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of faith nor the faculty of mind will arise for them there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the faculty of mind will not arise there, for that person does the faculty of faith not arise there?
At the moment of arising of the final consciousness, the mind faculty will not arise for them there, but the faith faculty does not fail to arise for them there.
At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind faculty nor the faith faculty arises for them there. (Based on the faith faculty.)
For whom and in what [state] the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) does not arise, for that person and in that state will the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) not arise?

For all [beings] at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, and for those with consciousness dissociated from knowledge at the moment of its arising, the faculty of wisdom does not arise therein;
yet, for them, the faculty of mind will not fail to arise therein. At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness...
For non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of wisdom nor the faculty of mind arises there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will not arise in a certain place, does the faculty of wisdom not arise for them there?
At the moment of the arising of the final consciousness, for those [beings], the faculty of mind will not arise there; yet it is not the case that for them [the faculty of wisdom] does not [arise].

Therein, the faculty of wisdom does not arise. At the moment of the dissolution of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind faculty nor the faculty of wisdom will arise there. (Based on the faculty of wisdom.
10.2.1.6. Chapter on the Past and Future.
10.2.1.6.1. Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye faculty has arisen, will the ear faculty arise for them?
For those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika) and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there, the eye faculty [has arisen].
[For some] the eye faculty had arisen, but the ear faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the eye faculty had arisen and the ear faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the ear faculty will arise, had the eye faculty arisen for them? Yes.
For whom the eye faculty has arisen, will the nose faculty arise for them?

For those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika) and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna there—the eye faculty has arisen for them, but the nose faculty will not arise for them. For others, however...
The eye faculty had arisen and the nose faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the nose faculty will arise, had the eye faculty arisen for them? Yes.

but the femininity faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the eye faculty and...

Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty will arise, had the eye-faculty arisen for them? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty had arisen, will the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arise for them?
For those in their final existence and for those who will be reborn in a state of equanimity and attain final Nibbāna there,
the eye faculty has arisen, but the mental joy faculty will not arise for them. For others, both the eye faculty has arisen and the mental joy faculty will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will arise, for that person did the faculty of the eye (*cakkhundriya*) arise? Yes.
For whomsoever the faculty of the eye arose, for that person will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise?
[It will not arise] for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) and for those who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain *parinibbāna*. For them, the faculty of the eye...
