For whomsoever the male faculty (purisindriya) had arisen in a certain place, will the faith faculty (saddhindriya), the understanding faculty (paññindriya), and the mind faculty (manindriya) arise for them in that same place?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) in the sense sphere (kāmāvacara), the male faculty had arisen there, but the mind faculty will not arise for them there. For others in the sense sphere, both the male faculty and [the other faculties]...
[The mind-faculty] had arisen and the mind-faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will arise at a certain place, had the masculinity-faculty arisen for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind-faculty will arise there, but the masculinity-faculty had not arisen for them there.
The male faculty had arisen. For those sense-sphere beings, will the mind faculty arise and the male faculty have arisen there? (Based on the male faculty.
For whomsoever the life faculty had arisen in a certain place, will the joy faculty arise for them in that same place?
For those possessing the final consciousness— namely, those for whom the final consciousness associated with equanimity will arise immediately after this consciousness—
and for non-percipient beings, the life-faculty had arisen there, but the mental joy-faculty will not arise there for them. For others,
namely those of the four-constituent and five-constituent realms, both the life-faculty and...
[The faculty of] mental joy had arisen [for them].
Or else, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy will arise at a certain place, had the faculty of life arisen for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the faculty of mental joy will arise there, but the faculty of life had not [previously] arisen for them there.
In that case, the life-faculty had arisen. For those others belonging to the four-aggregate or five-aggregate planes, the joy-faculty will arise and the life-faculty had also arisen there.
For one in whom the life-faculty had arisen at a certain place, will the equanimity-faculty arise there for him?
For those possessing the final consciousness, for whom the final consciousness associated with mental joy will arise immediately after this [present] consciousness,
and for non-percipient beings— among them, the life-faculty had arisen there,
but the equanimity-faculty will not arise there. For others, namely those of the four-constituent and five-constituent realms, among them both the life-faculty and...
[The life-faculty] had arisen and the equanimity-faculty will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty will arise in a certain place, had the life-faculty arisen for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the equanimity-faculty will arise there, but the life-faculty had not [previously] arisen for them there.
In that case, the life-faculty had arisen. For those others belonging to the four-aggregate or five-aggregate planes, will the equanimity-faculty arise and the life-faculty have arisen there?
For whomsoever the life-faculty had arisen in a certain plane, will the faith-faculty … pe … the understanding-faculty … pe … the mind-faculty arise for them in that same plane?
For those possessing the final consciousness and for non-percipient beings, the life-faculty had arisen there,
but the mind-faculty will not arise there for them. For others— those of the fourfold and fivefold aggregates—
the life-faculty had arisen there and the mind-faculty will also arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise at a certain place, has the life-faculty (*jīvitindriya*) arisen for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-faculty will arise there, but the life-faculty has not arisen for them there.
For others—those of the fourfold and fivefold aggregates—the mind-faculty [and the life-faculty] [arise there].
The life-faculty will arise and [the mind-faculty] has arisen. (Based on the life-faculty.
For whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) has arisen at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) arise for that person at that same place?
For those possessing the final consciousness, and for those whose final consciousness associated with mental joy arises immediately after a given consciousness...
For those [beings], the faculty of mental joy will arise there, but the faculty of equanimity will not arise there for them.
For others— namely, those in the four-constituent and five-constituent realms— both the faculty of mental joy and the faculty of equanimity will arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) will arise at a certain place, has the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) arisen for them there?
For those in the second moment of consciousness among the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the faculty of equanimity will arise there, but the faculty of mental joy has not arisen for them there.
For others—namely, those of the fourfold and fivefold aggregates—the same applies.
In those [beings], the equanimity faculty will arise there and the joy faculty has arisen there.
For one in whom the joy faculty has arisen at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty arise there?
For those possessing their final consciousness, the joy faculty has arisen there, but the mind faculty does not arise there for them.
The mind faculty will arise. For those others belonging to the four-aggregate or five-aggregate planes, both the joy faculty and the mind faculty had arisen there.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise in a particular plane, had the joy faculty arisen there for that person?
When the second consciousness of the Pure Abodes is occurring, the mind faculty will arise for them there, but the mental joy faculty has not arisen for them there.
For others—those of the four-constituent and five-constituent beings—the mind faculty will arise and the mental joy faculty has also arisen there. (Based on the mental joy faculty.)

For whomsoever the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) has arisen in a certain place, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*), the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*), and the mind faculty (*manindriya*) arise for them in that same place?
For those possessing their final consciousness, the equanimity faculty has arisen there, but the mind faculty will not arise for them there.
For others—those belonging to the fourfold or fivefold aggregates—the equanimity faculty [has arisen] there...
[It was] that the mind-faculty had arisen and will arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will arise at a certain place, had the equanimity-faculty arisen for them at that place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the mind-faculty will arise there, but for them the equanimity-faculty had not [previously] arisen there.

The equanimity faculty had arisen. For others—those belonging to the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms—the mind faculty will arise and the equanimity faculty had arisen there. (Based on the equanimity faculty.
For whomsoever the faith faculty had arisen in a certain place, will the understanding faculty ... pe ... the mind faculty arise for them in that same place?
For those possessing the final consciousness, the faculty of faith has arisen there,
but the faculty of mind will not arise there for them. For others— those of the four-constituent and five-constituent realms—
both the faculty of faith and the faculty of mind have arisen and will also arise there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will arise at a certain place, has the faith-faculty (*saddhindriya*) arisen for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-faculty will arise there, but the faith-faculty has not arisen for them there.
For others—those of the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms—the mind-faculty [will arise] there...
The faculty of faith will arise and the faculty of faith has arisen. (Based on the faculty of faith.
For whomsoever the faculty of wisdom has arisen at a certain place, will the faculty of mind arise for them at that same place?
For those possessing the final consciousness, the faculty of wisdom has arisen at that place, but the faculty of mind will not arise for them there.
The mind faculty will arise. For those others belonging to the four-aggregate and five-aggregate planes, both the understanding faculty had arisen and the mind faculty will arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind faculty will arise in a particular plane, had the understanding faculty arisen there for that person?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the mind faculty will arise there, but the wisdom faculty had not arisen for them there.
For others—those of the four-constituent and five-constituent beings—the mind faculty will arise there and the wisdom faculty had also arisen there. (Based on the wisdom faculty.)
10.2.1.6.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the eye-faculty had not arisen, will the ear-faculty not arise for them? None.
Or rather, for whom the ear-faculty will not arise, had the eye-faculty not arisen for them? It had arisen.
For one in whom the eye faculty has not arisen, will the nose faculty … pe … the femininity faculty … pe … the masculinity faculty not arise? None.
Or, for one in whom the masculinity faculty will not arise, has the eye faculty not arisen? It has arisen.
For one in whom the eye faculty has not arisen, will the life faculty not arise? None.
Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise, for that person did the eye-faculty not arise? It did arise.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty did not arise, for that person will the joy-faculty … pe … the equanimity-faculty not arise? There is none.
Or, for whomsoever the equanimity-faculty will not arise, for that person did the eye-faculty not arise? It did arise.

For whom the eye faculty (*cakkhundriya*) had not arisen, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise for them?
None. Or else, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, had the eye faculty not arisen for them? It had arisen. (Based on the eye faculty.

For whom the nose faculty … pe … the female faculty (*itthindriya*) … the male faculty (*purisindriya*) … the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) … the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) … [had not arisen] … pe … [will the others not arise for them? … pe … [None. Or else, for whom the mental joy faculty will not arise, had the nose faculty … pe … the female faculty … the male faculty … the life faculty … [not arisen for them? … pe … [It had arisen. (Based on the nose faculty … pe … the female faculty … the male faculty … the life faculty … the mental joy faculty.)
... [for whom] the equanimity faculty ... the faith faculty ... or the wisdom faculty had not arisen, will that person’s mind faculty not arise? None.
Or conversely, for whom the mind faculty will not arise, had that person’s wisdom faculty not arisen? It had arisen.
10.2.1.6.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa):
Where the eye-faculty has not arisen, will the ear-faculty not arise there? … [etc.
… 10.2.1.6.6. Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa)
For whomsoever the eye-faculty has not arisen at a certain place, will the ear-faculty not arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the ear-faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the eye-faculty not arisen for them at that same place?
For those in the final existence within the five-aggregate realm, the ear-faculty will not arise there, yet it is not the case that the eye-faculty has not arisen for them.

In that case, the eye faculty has not arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither will the ear faculty arise nor has the eye faculty arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty has not arisen in a certain place, will the nose faculty not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the nose faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the eye faculty not arisen for them at that place?

For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere, the nose faculty will not arise there, yet the eye faculty has not failed to arise for them there.
[This is not the case] for those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, or for those in the immaterial sphere.
In those [beings], neither the nose faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
For whom the eye faculty did not arise in a certain place, will the femininity faculty not arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the femininity faculty will not arise in a certain place, did the eye faculty not arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, for those in the fine-material-sphere realm, and for those men who, having manifested only a few more existences in that very state,
will attain final nibbāna— femininity faculty will not arise in them there,
but eye faculty had not failed to arise in them there. [This is also the case] for those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial-sphere realm.
In that case, for whom neither the femininity faculty nor the eye faculty will arise, [it is so].
For whom, in what [state], the eye faculty has not arisen, for that person, in that state, will the masculinity faculty not arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, in what [state], the masculinity faculty will not arise, for that person, in that state, has the eye faculty not arisen?

For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, for those in the fine-material-sphere realm, and for those women who will pass away after having manifested only a few more existences in that very state, the male faculty will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the eye faculty had not arisen for them there. [This also applies to] those in the Pure Abodes, non-percipient beings, and those in the immaterial-sphere realm.
For them, neither the male faculty nor the eye faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye faculty did not arise there, will the life faculty not arise for them there?
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the eye faculty did not arise there, yet for them the [life faculty] does not [not arise].
The life-faculty will not arise. For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the eye-faculty nor the life-faculty has arisen there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the eye-faculty not arisen for them in that place?
For those in their final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the life-faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the eye-faculty had not arisen there for them. For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
neither the life-faculty nor the eye-faculty will arise there, and [the eye-faculty] had not arisen there for them.
For whomsoever the eye-faculty has not arisen in a certain place, will the joy-faculty not arise for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the joy-faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the eye-faculty not arisen for that person in that same place?
For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, and for those possessing eyes who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there, but it is not the case that the eye-faculty has not arisen for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm,
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the eye-faculty has arisen there.
For whom the eye-faculty has not arisen at a certain place, will the equanimity-faculty not arise for them at that same place?
For those non-percipient beings (arūpa), the eye-faculty has not arisen there, yet it is not the case that the equanimity-faculty will not arise for them there.

[This is also true] for those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), for those in their final existence in the formless realm (arūpa), and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta). For these, at that place...
The eye faculty has not arisen, and the equanimity faculty will not arise.
Or, conversely, for whom the equanimity faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the eye faculty not arisen there for them?
[It is so] for those in the five-aggregate realm who are final-existence beings, and for those with eyes who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the equanimity faculty will not arise there, but the eye faculty has not failed to arise there for them.
For those in the Pure Abodes, for those in the formless realm in their final existence, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the eye faculty has arisen there.
For whom the eye-faculty has not arisen at a certain place, will the faith-faculty … pe … wisdom-faculty … pe … mind-faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those non-percipient beings (arūpa), the eye-faculty has not arisen there, yet it is not the case that the mind-faculty will not arise for them there.
For those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), for those in their final existence in the formless realm (arūpa), and for non-percipient beings, [the mind-faculty will not arise] there.
The eye faculty has not arisen and the mind faculty will not arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the eye faculty not arisen for them in that same place?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the mind faculty will not arise there, yet it is not the case that the eye faculty has not arisen for them.

In that case, the eye faculty had not arisen. For those in the Pure Abodes, for those in the formless realm in their final existence, and for non-percipient beings, neither will the mind faculty arise nor had the eye faculty arisen there. (Based on the eye faculty.
For whomsoever the nose faculty had not arisen in a certain place, will the female faculty not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or alternatively, for whomsoever the femininity faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the nose faculty not arisen for them at that place?

For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm and for those men who, having appeared for some births in this very state, will attain final nibbāna, the femininity faculty will not arise there; yet for them, the nose faculty has not [failed to] arise there.
It did not arise. For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, neither the femininity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty did not arise at a certain place, will the masculinity faculty not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, for that person has the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) not arisen there?
For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those women who, having seen only a few more existences in this very state,
will attain final nibbāna— there, the male faculty will not arise, but for them the nose faculty has not [previously] failed to arise there.
The nose faculty has not arisen. For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, neither the masculinity faculty nor the nose faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose faculty has not arisen in a particular place, will the life faculty not arise for them in that same place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty has not arisen there,
yet it is not the case that the life faculty will not arise for them there. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material and immaterial spheres,
neither the nose faculty nor the life faculty has arisen there, nor will the life faculty arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the nose-faculty not arisen for them there?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, the life-faculty will not arise there, yet the nose-faculty has not failed to arise for them there.
For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere...
In that case, the life-faculty will not arise and the nose-faculty has not arisen.
For whomsoever the nose-faculty has not arisen in a certain place, will the joy-faculty not arise for them in that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere, the nose-faculty has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the joy-faculty has not arisen for them there.

It will not arise. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither the nose faculty nor the mental joy faculty has arisen there, nor will it arise.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the nose faculty not arisen there for them?

For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those who possess a nose and will be reborn with equanimity (*upekkhā*) and attain *parinibbāna* there, the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise there;
yet, the faculty of the nose (*ghānindriya*) had not failed to arise for them there.

For final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), and those in the immaterial sphere (*arūpa*), both the faculty of mental joy and [the faculty of the nose]... [will not arise there].
The nose faculty will not arise and it has not arisen.
For whomsoever the nose faculty has not arisen at a certain place, will the equanimity faculty not arise for them there?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty has not arisen there, but for them [the equanimity faculty]... [will not arise].

In that case, the faculty of equanimity will not arise. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose-faculty nor the faculty of equanimity has arisen there, nor will the faculty of equanimity arise.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will not arise in a certain place, has the nose-faculty not arisen for them there?

For those in the sense-sphere who are in their final existence, and for those with a nose who will be reborn with mental joy and will attain *parinibbāna* there, the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) will not arise there, but the nose faculty (*ghānindriya*) had not failed to arise there for them.

For those in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, who are in their final existence, and for non-percipient beings, both the equanimity faculty and... [the nose faculty] do not arise there.
The nose faculty will not arise, and it has not arisen.
For whom, where the nose faculty has not arisen, will the faith faculty … pe … the wisdom faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise there?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose faculty has not arisen there, but for them [the other faculties] do not [not arise].

In that case, the mind faculty (manindriya) will not arise. For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), or among non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the nose faculty (ghānindriya) nor the mind faculty has arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the nose faculty not arisen there for them?
For those in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm, the mind-faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the nose-faculty has not arisen there for them.

For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind-faculty nor the nose-faculty will arise there, and the nose-faculty has not arisen there. (Based on the nose-faculty.)
For whomsoever the female faculty (*itthindriya*) has not arisen in a certain place, will the male faculty (*purisindriya*) not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the male faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the female faculty not arisen for them in that same place?

[It has not arisen] for those in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*) who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), and for those women who, having seen only a few more existences in this very state...
For those who will attain final nibbāna there, the male faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the female faculty has not arisen there for them. For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere,
neither the male faculty nor the female faculty will arise there, nor has the female faculty arisen there.
For whom the female faculty (*itthindriya*) has not arisen at a certain place, will the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) not arise for them at that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the female faculty has not arisen there, yet the life faculty will not fail to arise for them there.
[This is so] for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) within the fine-material and immaterial spheres.
In that case, there is one for whom neither the femininity faculty nor the life faculty had arisen.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the life faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the femininity faculty not arisen for them in that place?
For those in the final existence within the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), the life faculty will not arise in that place; yet, for them, [the femininity faculty] had not [necessarily] arisen.

In that case, the femininity faculty (*itthindriya*) had not arisen. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), neither the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) will arise nor has the femininity faculty arisen there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty had not arisen in a certain place, will the joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise for them in that same place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the femininity faculty had not arisen there, but the mental joy faculty will not fail to arise for them there.
For those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the femininity faculty nor the mental joy faculty had arisen there, nor will the mental joy faculty arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise in a certain place, has the faculty of femininity (*itthindriya*) not arisen for them there?
For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), and for those women who, having been reborn with equanimity (*upekkhā*),
will attain final Nibbāna— mental joy will not arise for them there, yet the faculty of femininity has not [failed to] arise for them there.

It had arisen. For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither the faculty of mental joy nor the female faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the female faculty had not arisen in a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity not arise for them in that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the femininity faculty had not arisen there,
yet the equanimity faculty will not fail to arise for them there. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere,
the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings, neither the femininity faculty nor the equanimity faculty had arisen there, nor will the equanimity faculty arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity will not arise at a certain place, has the faculty of femininity not arisen for them at that place?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm and for those women who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna—
there the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them, but it is not the case that the faculty of femininity had not arisen for them there.
For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the femininity faculty will arise there.
For whomsoever the femininity faculty has not arisen at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the femininity faculty had not arisen there,
but the mind faculty will not fail to arise for them there. For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the femininity faculty nor the mind faculty will arise there.
Or alternatively, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, has the femininity-faculty (*itthindriya*) not arisen for them there?

For those in the final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), the mind-faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the femininity-faculty has not arisen for them there.
For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*)...
For those [beings], neither will the mind-faculty arise there nor did the femininity-faculty arise there. (Based on the femininity-faculty.
For whom the masculinity-faculty did not arise at a certain place, will the life-faculty not arise for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the masculinity-faculty did not arise there, yet for them...

In that case, the life-faculty will not arise. For those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, neither the masculinity faculty nor the life-faculty has arisen there, and the life-faculty will not arise.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the life-faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the masculinity faculty not arisen for them there?
For those in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm, the life-faculty will not arise there,
but it is not the case that the male faculty had not arisen for them there. For those in the final existence in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere,
neither the life-faculty nor the male faculty will arise there, and neither had arisen for them there.
For whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) has not arisen at a certain place, will the joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise for them at that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the male faculty has not arisen there, yet it is not the case that the joy faculty will not arise for them there.
[This is so] for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), and for those in the immaterial sphere (*arūpa*). For them, at that place...
The male faculty had not arisen and the mental joy faculty will not arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mental joy faculty will not arise in a certain place, had the male faculty not arisen for that person in that place?
For those in the sense-sphere realm who are in their final existence, and for those males who, having been reborn with equanimity, will attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the faculty of mental joy will not arise there, but it is not the case that the male faculty had not arisen for them there.
For those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the male faculty will have arisen there.
For whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) has not arisen in a certain place, will the equanimity faculty (*upekkhindriya*) not arise for them there?

For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the male faculty has not arisen there, yet it is not the case that the equanimity faculty will not arise for them there.
[This is so] for those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) within the fine-material and immaterial spheres.
For non-percipient beings, neither the male faculty nor the equanimity faculty had arisen there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the equanimity faculty will not arise at a certain place, had the male faculty not arisen for them there?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm and for those males who, having been reborn with mental joy, will attain final Nibbāna.
For them, the equanimity faculty will not arise there, but the masculinity faculty had not failed to arise for them there.
For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the equanimity faculty nor the masculinity faculty had arisen there.

For whomsoever the male faculty (*purisindriya*) has not arisen at a certain place, will the faith faculty (*saddhindriya*) … pe … the understanding faculty (*paññindriya*) … pe … the mind faculty (*manindriya*) not arise for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) and the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), the male faculty has not arisen there;

yet, for them, the mind faculty will not fail to arise there. [This is so] for those in the final existence (*pacchimabhavika*) of the fine-material and immaterial spheres, and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*).
In those [beings], neither the masculinity faculty nor the mind faculty had arisen there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the masculinity faculty not arisen there for them?

For those in the final existence within the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), the mind faculty will not arise there; yet it is not the case that the masculinity faculty had not arisen for them there.

In that case, the male faculty (*purisindriya*) had not arisen. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither will the mind faculty (*manindriya*) arise nor had the male faculty arisen there. (Based on the male faculty.
For whomsoever the life faculty (*jīvitindriya*) had not arisen in a certain place, will the mental joy faculty (*somanassindriya*) not arise for them in that same place? It will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, has the faculty of life (*jīvitindriya*) not arisen for them there? It had arisen.

For whomsoever the faculty of life had not arisen at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity (*upekkhindriya*) …pe… the faculty of faith (*saddhindriya*) …pe… the faculty of wisdom (*paññindriya*) …pe… the faculty of mind (*manindriya*) not arise for them there? It will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the faculty of mind will not arise at a certain place, has the faculty of life not arisen for them there? It had arisen. (Based on the faculty of life.)
For whom the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) has not arisen at a certain place, will the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya) not arise for them at that same place?

For those in the second moment of consciousness among the Suddhāvāsa deities, the faculty of mental joy has not arisen there, yet it is not the case that the faculty of equanimity will not arise for them there.
For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the faculty of mental joy nor... [the faculty of equanimity] has arisen there.
[It is such that] the equanimity faculty has not arisen and will not arise.
Or, conversely, for whomver the equanimity faculty will not arise at a certain place, has the joy faculty not arisen there for them?
[Yes; for those possessing the final consciousness, and for one whose final consciousness associated with joy arises immediately after that [present] consciousness.
For those persons, will the equanimity faculty not arise there, while the joy faculty has not [previously] arisen for them there?
For non-percipient beings, neither the equanimity faculty nor the joy faculty will arise there, nor has the joy faculty arisen for them there.
For whomsoever the joy faculty has not arisen at a certain place, will the faith faculty … pe … the understanding faculty … pe … the mind faculty not arise for that person at that place?
When the second consciousness of the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) is occurring, the faculty of mental joy (somanassindriya) has not arisen for them there,
but it is not the case that the faculty of mind (manindriya) will not arise for them there. For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta),
neither the faculty of mental joy nor the faculty of mind has arisen, nor will it arise, for them there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, has the faculty of mental joy (*somanassindriya*) not arisen for them there?
For those possessing their final consciousness, the mind-faculty will not arise there, yet for them the faculty of mental joy has not failed to arise there.
For non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the mind-faculty nor [the faculty of mental joy] will arise there.
and the faculty of mental joy had not arisen. (Based on the faculty of mental joy.
For whom, wherever, the faculty of equanimity had not arisen, for them there, will the faculty of faith … pe … the faculty of wisdom … pe … the faculty of mind not arise?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the faculty of equanimity had not arisen there, but it is not the case that for them [the faculty of mind] will not arise.
In that case, the mind faculty will not arise. For those non-percipient beings, neither the equanimity faculty nor the mind faculty has arisen there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind faculty will not arise in a certain place, has the equanimity faculty not arisen for them there?
For those possessing the final consciousness, the mind faculty will not arise there, but it is not the case that the equanimity faculty had not arisen for them there.
For non-percipient beings, neither the mind faculty nor the equanimity faculty had arisen there. (Based on the equanimity faculty.)
For whom the faculty of faith has not arisen in a certain place, will the faculty of wisdom ... pe ... the faculty of mind not arise for them in that same place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the faculty of faith has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the faculty of mind will not arise for them there.
For non-percipient beings, neither the faculty of faith nor [the other faculties] have arisen there.
[It is] that the mind-faculty had arisen but will not arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind-faculty will not arise in a certain [state], has the faith-faculty not arisen for them in that [state]?
For those possessing the final consciousness, the mind-faculty will not arise in that [state], but it is not the case that the faith-faculty had not arisen for them in that [state].
The faculty of faith did not arise for them. For those non-percipient beings, neither will the mind-faculty arise nor did the faculty of faith arise there. (Based on the faculty of faith.
For whomsoever the faculty of wisdom did not arise at a certain place, will the mind-faculty not arise for that person at that place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) has not arisen there,
but it is not the case that the faculty of mind (manindriya) will not arise for them there. For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta),
neither the faculty of wisdom nor the faculty of mind has arisen there, nor will the faculty of mind arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-faculty (*manindriya*) will not arise at a certain place, has the wisdom-faculty (*paññindriya*) not arisen for them there?
For those possessing their final consciousness, the mind-faculty will not arise there, but it is not that the wisdom-faculty has not arisen for them there.
For non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the mind-faculty nor [the wisdom-faculty] will arise there.
And the faculty of wisdom had not arisen. (Based on the faculty of wisdom.
… [as above] … The Section on Occurrence is finished.
